Read the quick start and the relevant component page before generating code. Follow the documented props, events, slots, imports and styles. Do not substitute APIs from another component library.

# ActionSheet

### Intro

An action sheet pops up to give the user the ability to select options.
`ActionSheet` supports service and component calls. The service uses a separate application and mounts to body; the component uses its host application context and `popup-container`.
The function returns a `Promise`, on selection return `action`. Click modal close to return `close`.

## Basic examples

### Function Call

Example source: src/action-sheet/example/demos/function-call.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive, ref } from 'vue'
import { ActionSheet, Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const rawActions = [
  {
    name: 'Item 01',
    icon: 'user-circle-fill',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 02',
    icon: 'notebook',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 03',
    icon: 'wifi',
  },
]
const rawDisabledActions = [
  {
    name: 'Item 01',
    icon: 'user-circle-fill',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 02',
    icon: 'notebook',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 03',
    icon: 'wifi',
    disabled: true,
  },
]
const rawCustomStyleActions = [
  {
    name: 'Item 01',
    icon: 'user-circle-fill',
    color: 'var(--mp-color-success)',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 02',
    icon: 'notebook',
    color: 'var(--mp-color-warning)',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 03',
    icon: 'wifi',
    color: 'var(--mp-color-info)',
  },
]
const actions = reactive(rawActions)
async function createBasic() {
  const action = await ActionSheet({ actions: rawActions })

  action !== 'close' && Message(`${'您选择的是:'}${action.name}`)
}
async function modifyTitle() {
  const action = await ActionSheet({
    actions: rawActions,
    title: '选择一个你喜欢的吧',
  })
  action !== 'close' && Message(`${'您选择的是:'}${action.name}`)
}
async function disableAction() {
  const action = await ActionSheet({
    actions: rawDisabledActions,
  })

  action !== 'close' && Message(`${'您选择的是:'}${action.name}`)
}
async function customActionStyles() {
  const action = await ActionSheet({
    actions: rawCustomStyleActions,
  })

  action !== 'close' && Message(`${'您选择的是:'}${action.name}`)
}
function disableCloseOnClickAction() {
  ActionSheet({
    actions: [
      {
        name: 'Item 01',
        icon: 'user-circle-fill',
      },
      {
        name: 'Item 02',
        icon: 'notebook',
      },
      {
        name: 'Item 03',
        icon: 'wifi',
      },
    ],
    closeOnClickAction: false,
    onSelect: (action) => Message(`${'您选择的是:'}${action.name}`),
  })
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="['3vmin', '4vmin']">
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="createBasic">基本使用</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="modifyTitle">修改标题</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="disableAction">禁用选项</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="disableCloseOnClickAction">禁用点击选项时关闭动作面板 </mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="customActionStyles">自定义选项样式</mp-button>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive, ref } from 'vue'
import { ActionSheet, Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const rawActions = [
  {
    name: 'Item 01',
    icon: 'user-circle-fill',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 02',
    icon: 'notebook',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 03',
    icon: 'wifi',
  },
]
const rawDisabledActions = [
  {
    name: 'Item 01',
    icon: 'user-circle-fill',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 02',
    icon: 'notebook',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 03',
    icon: 'wifi',
    disabled: true,
  },
]
const rawCustomStyleActions = [
  {
    name: 'Item 01',
    icon: 'user-circle-fill',
    color: 'var(--mp-color-success)',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 02',
    icon: 'notebook',
    color: 'var(--mp-color-warning)',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 03',
    icon: 'wifi',
    color: 'var(--mp-color-info)',
  },
]
const actions = reactive(rawActions)
const disabledActions = reactive(rawDisabledActions)
const customStyleActions = reactive(rawCustomStyleActions)
const open = ref(false)
const show1 = ref(false)
const show2 = ref(false)
const show3 = ref(false)
const show4 = ref(false)
async function modifyTitle() {
  const action = await ActionSheet({
    actions: rawActions,
    title: '选择一个你喜欢的吧',
  })
  action !== 'close' && Message(`${'您选择的是:'}${action.name}`)
}
async function customActionStyles() {
  const action = await ActionSheet({
    actions: rawCustomStyleActions,
  })

  action !== 'close' && Message(`${'您选择的是:'}${action.name}`)
}
function disableCloseOnClickAction() {
  ActionSheet({
    actions: [
      {
        name: 'Item 01',
        icon: 'user-circle-fill',
      },
      {
        name: 'Item 02',
        icon: 'notebook',
      },
      {
        name: 'Item 03',
        icon: 'wifi',
      },
    ],
    closeOnClickAction: false,
    onSelect: (action) => Message(`${'您选择的是:'}${action.name}`),
  })
}
function handleSelect(action) {
  Message(`${'您选择的是:'}${action.name}`)
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="['3vmin', '4vmin']">
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="open = true">基本使用</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="show1 = true">修改标题</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="show2 = true">禁用选项</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="show3 = true">禁用点击选项时关闭动作面板</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="show4 = true">自定义选项样式</mp-button>
  </mp-space>

  <mp-action-sheet v-model:open="open" :actions="actions" @select="handleSelect" />
  <mp-action-sheet v-model:open="show1" title="选择一个你喜欢的吧" :actions="actions" @select="handleSelect" />
  <mp-action-sheet v-model:open="show2" :actions="disabledActions" @select="handleSelect" />
  <mp-action-sheet v-model:open="show3" :close-on-click-action="false" :actions="actions" @select="handleSelect" />
  <mp-action-sheet v-model:open="show4" :actions="customStyleActions" @select="handleSelect" />
</template>
```

### Disabled options

Set `disabled` on options to disable them.

```html
<script setup>
  import { ActionSheet, Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

  async function handleSelect() {
    const action = await ActionSheet({
      actions: [
        {
          name: 'Item 01',
          icon: 'user-circle-fill',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 02',
          icon: 'notebook',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 03',
          icon: 'wifi',
          disabled: true,
        },
      ],
    })

    action !== 'close' && Message(`Selected: ${action.name}`)
  }
</script>

<template>
  <mp-button status="primary" block @click="handleSelect">Disabled options</mp-button>
</template>
```

### Keep actions open after selection

`closeOnClickAction` prevents `ActionSheet` from closing automatically on selection, allowing repeated choices.
Since a `Promise` resolves only once, use `onSelect` to observe repeated user choices.

```html
<script setup>
  import { ActionSheet, Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

  async function handleSelect() {
    await ActionSheet({
      actions: [
        {
          name: 'Item 01',
          icon: 'user-circle-fill',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 02',
          icon: 'notebook',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 03',
          icon: 'wifi',
        },
      ],
      closeOnClickAction: false,
      onSelect: (action) => Message(`Selected: ${action.name}`),
    })
  }
</script>

<template>
  <mp-button status="primary" block @click="handleSelect">Keep actions open</mp-button>
</template>
```

### Custom option styles

Options accept style configuration; see the Action data structure for all fields.

```html

          name: 'Item 03',
```

## Keyboard and dialog name

Default actions use native buttons; disabled actions cannot be focused or selected. The title or title slot names the dialog, unless an explicit `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` overrides it. The visible cancel button requests closure through the close guard.

## Controlled state

When an action is selected, `close-on-click-action` requests an `open` update. A controlled parent that keeps `open=true` keeps the sheet `open`. Without `open`, `default-open` initializes internal state.

## Usage notes

### Closing from the title dropdown

`swipe-to-close` defaults to false. When enabled, the header can be dragged down to close; `swipe-threshold` defaults to 40 CSS px. Custom title slots use the surrounding header handle. Body options and header buttons do not initiate dragging. See Popup for gesture details.
`before-close` forwards to Popup. Overlay, Esc, route, dropdown and post-action `open` changes may be rejected asynchronously. Exceptions emit `close-error(error, reason)`. An action `select` event does not mean closing was approved.

## API

`open/defaultOpen` control current/initial uncontrolled panel visibility. Use `v-model:open` for two-way binding. defaultOpen is read once without initialization writeback.

### ActionSheet Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------ | -------- |
| `v-model:open` | Controlled visibility | _boolean_ | `-` |
| `default-open` | Initial uncontrolled visibility | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `before-close` | Close guard | _PopupBeforeClose_ | `-` |
| `swipe-to-close` | Enable downward swipe in the header | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `swipe-threshold` | Downward close threshold (CSS px) | _number_ | `40` |
| `actions` | Action list | _Actions_ | `[]` |
| `title` | Action sheet title | _string_ | `请选择` |
| `overlay` | Show overlay | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `overlay-class` | Custom overlay class | _string_ | `-` |
| `overlay-style` | Custom overlay style | _object_ | `-` |
| `lock-scroll` | Whether to disable scrolling penetration, scrolling the Dialog when disabled will not cause the body to scroll | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `close-on-click-action` | Whether to close the actions sheet when clicking action | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `overlay-closable` | Whether to click the overlay to close the action sheet | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `esc-to-close` | Whether to support keyboard ESC to close the action sheet | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `safe-area` | Whether to adapt to the bottom, left and right safe areas | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `popup-container` | The location of the action sheet to mount | _TeleportProps['to'] \| false_ | `body` |

### ActionSheet Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --------------- | -------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `update:open` | Request an update to visibility | `boolean` |
| `close-error` | Close guard error | `error: unknown, reason: PopupCloseReason` |
| `select` | Triggered when selecting an action sheet | `action: Action` |
| `open` | Triggered when opening an action sheet | `-` |
| `opened` | Triggered when an action sheet open-animation ends | `-` |
| `close` | Triggered when closing an action sheet | `-` |
| `closed` | Triggered when an action sheet close-animation ends | `-` |
| `click-overlay` | Triggered when clicking the overlay | `MouseEvent` |
| `key-escape` | Triggered when pressing ESC | `KeyboardEvent` |

### ActionSheet Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------ | --------- | ------ |
| `ActionSheet` | Show action sheet | _options_ | `Promise<ActionSheetActions \| void>` |
| `ActionSheet.close` | Close action sheet | _-_ | `-` |
| `ActionSheet.setDefaultOptions` | Set default option configuration | _options_ | `-` |
| `ActionSheet.resetDefaultOptions` | Reset default option configuration | _-_ | `-` |

### FunctionCall Options

The service sets `open=true` after creation and forces body as its mount target; its `open` and `popupContainer` options do not control initial visibility or mount location.

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |

| `actions` | Action list | _Actions_ | `[]` |
| `title` | Action sheet title | _string_ | `请选择` |
| `overlay` | Show overlay | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `overlayClass` | Custom overlay class | _string_ | `-` |
| `overlayStyle` | Custom overlay style | _object_ | `-` |
| `lockScroll` | Whether to disable scrolling penetration, scrolling the Dialog when disabled will not cause the body to scroll | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `closeOnClickAction` | Whether to close the actions sheet when clicking action | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `overlayClosable` | Whether to click the overlay to close the action sheet | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `escToClose` | Whether to support keyboard ESC to close the action sheet | _boolean_ | `true` |

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --------- | ------------ | ---- |

## Close guards

The guard signature is `beforeClose({ reason }, done, { signal, event })`.

Return true/false or `Promise<boolean>`; a normally resolved async void result allows closing. Call done() to allow or done(false) to reject; synchronous void waits for done. The first result wins. Pending requests are deduplicated; errors retain the sheet and restore temporary button state. The third context argument supplies `signal` and the optional original `event`. Closing, unmounting or replacing the hook invalidates stale results.

Synchronous logging-only hooks must explicitly return true; synchronous undefined means awaiting a callback. Earlier `Promise<void>` hooks without done now allow closing when their Promise resolves.

Popup reasons are overlay, escape, route, swipe, close, api and model. Rejecting an external open=false requests update:open(true). The component does not expose `requestClose()`; use an existing guarded close entry. Direct destruction does not wait for the hook.

Programmatic notification callbacks do not control task completion. Service selection/closing results settle independently of callback errors, and closing completion always releases the owned host. Exceptions still propagate through the caller or Vue error channel; returned Promises do not control loading or closing.
`ActionSheet.close()` requests closing and respects `beforeClose`. A veto retains the service owner so closing can be requested again. A new programmatic invocation replaces the previous singleton: it disposes the previous host and settles its result as `close`, without waiting for that `close` guard or synthesizing lifecycle notifications.

## CSS Variables

The following CSS variables support customization with [ThemeProvider](#/en-US/theme-provider).

<!-- component-css-variables:start -->

Use these variables to customize the component. Defaults may vary by the selector condition shown. Each variable applies to the corresponding size, variant and interaction states.

<div class="token-reference-table" style="max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;">

| Variable | Default / condition | Affected styles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--mp-action-sheet-action-item-color` | `#333` | `color` |
| `--mp-action-sheet-action-item-disabled-color` | `var(--mp-color-text-disabled)` | `color` |
| `--mp-action-sheet-action-item-height` | `48px` | `height`, `max-height` |
| `--mp-action-sheet-action-item-padding` | `0 18px` | `padding` |
| `--mp-action-sheet-background` | `#fff` | `background` |
| `--mp-action-sheet-border-radius` | `2px` | `border-radius` |
| `--mp-action-sheet-border-top` | `none` | `border-top` |
| `--mp-action-sheet-icon-margin` | `0 20px 0 0` | `margin` |
| `--mp-action-sheet-icon-size` | `24px` | `font-size`, `height`, `width` |
| `--mp-action-sheet-title-color` | `#888` | `color` |
| `--mp-action-sheet-title-font-size` | `14px` | `font-size` |
| `--mp-action-sheet-title-padding` | `10px 16px` | `padding` |

</div>

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --mp-action-sheet-action-item-color: #333;
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

# Affix

The same scenarios, parameters and interactions as Cedar. Only component prefixes differ; themes and site shells remain independent.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Example source: src/affix/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
```

### Disabled, CSS mode and manual update

Example source: src/affix/example/demos/controls.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { nextTick, ref } from 'vue'

const containerRef = ref<HTMLElement>()
const affixRef = ref<{ updatePosition: () => Promise<void> }>()
const disabled = ref(false)
const cssMode = ref(false)
const spacerHeight = ref(40)
const updates = ref(0)
async function updateLayout() {
  spacerHeight.value = spacerHeight.value === 40 ? 100 : 40
  await nextTick()
  await affixRef.value?.updatePosition()
  updates.value++
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space wrap size="12px" style="margin-bottom: 12px">
    <mp-checkbox v-model="disabled">Disabled</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="cssMode">CSS sticky</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-button @click="updateLayout">Change layout and update position</mp-button>
  </mp-space>
  <p aria-live="polite">Position updates: {{ updates }}</p>
  <div ref="containerRef" class="scroller">
    <div class="scroll-content">
      <div :style="{ height: `${spacerHeight}px` }"></div>
      <mp-affix
        ref="affixRef"
        :target="containerRef"
        :disabled="disabled"
        :css-mode="cssMode"
        :offset-top="12"
        :z-index="2"
      >
        <mp-button status="primary">Scroll to pin</mp-button>
      </mp-affix>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.scroller {
  height: 200px;
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
}
.scroll-content {
  min-height: 600px;
  padding: 16px;
}
</style>
```

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->
### Affix Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| offset-top | Distance from the scroll container top; accepts CSS lengths | `number / string` | `0` |
| offset-bottom | Distance from the bottom; takes precedence over offset-top, including 0 | `number / string` | `undefined` |
| target | Scroller or selector; finds nearest scrolling ancestor when omitted, falling back to window | `string / HTMLElement / Window` | `undefined` |
| target-container | Extra outer scroller to listen to; omitted means no extra listener, and it is not a clipping boundary | `string / HTMLElement / Window` | `undefined` |
| z-index | Stacking level | `number / string` | `10` |
| disabled | Disable affixing | `boolean` | `false` |
| css-mode | Use native position: sticky, subject to ancestor overflow and container boundaries | `boolean` | `false` |

### Affix Events

| Event | Arguments and timing |
| --- | --- |
| change | `(fixed: boolean, offset: number)`, emitted when the fixed state changes. While fixed, offset is the affix threshold; otherwise it is the distance to the corresponding container edge. Disabling affixing reports 0. |

### Affix Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | Content to affix | — |

### Affix Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| updatePosition | Rebind scrollers and recalculate on the next animation frame | — | `Promise<void>` |

### Usage notes

Props, event arguments, slots and public methods match across platforms. CSS mode follows browser sticky rules; examples use independent scroll containers.
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

`change` only reports transitions in fixed state: repeated measurements while fixed do not repeat true, and disabling releases fixation with false and 0. Viewport units are reevaluated on measurement. CSS mode delegates valid lengths to native sticky; JS mode resolves numbers, numeric strings, px, rem, vw, vh, vmin and vmax. target controls listeners and JS measurement, while native sticky remains constrained by actual CSS ancestors. After deactivation, a pending `updatePosition()` cannot restore listeners from an older activation.


### Imports and event types

The subentry default component and the named components from the subentry and root are the same component. Props includes actual listener parameters. Events remain notifications and do not await returned Promises. Use only the documented instance methods.

```ts
import Affix, { Affix as NamedAffix } from '@maple-design/ui-vue/affix'
import { Affix as RootAffix } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
import type { AffixProps, AffixInstance } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
import type { AffixProps as SubAffixProps } from '@maple-design/ui-vue/affix'
const options: AffixProps = { onChange: (fixed: boolean, offset: number) => fixed && offset.toFixed() }
```


### Units and diagnostics

JS mode parses only finite numbers, decimal/scientific numeric strings, and px, rem, vw, vh, vmin or vmax, including negative offsets. Unsupported JS lengths such as em, %, calc() and var() warn in development and measure as zero instead of treating a numeric prefix as pixels. CSS mode delegates to native sticky, converting numeric strings to px and leaving other valid CSS expressions to the browser. NaN/Infinity/blank values receive Vue prop validation warnings. Invalid CSS offsets are removed and JS measurement falls back to zero. target changes listeners and JS measurement, not the actual native sticky scroll ancestor or clipping boundary.

This component declares no independent public CSS variables. Use the configuration and layout APIs documented on this page.

Internal custom properties and measurement values are implementation details and are not customization APIs.

## Appearance and states

### Appearance configuration comparison

Choose a dimension to compare all its values side by side while keeping other settings and content identical. Change the other settings to inspect combinations; input specimens share one model.

<details>
<summary>Configuration details and limits</summary>

#### Appearance combinations

Use this example for the emphasis of informational messages. Adjust variant, status and compare the component with the same data. Keep the content unchanged while comparing the available settings.

#### Type

`type`: `info` / `success` / `warning` / `danger` / `default`. `default` has no built-in icon; use `#icon` to customize.

</details>

Example source: src/alert/example/demos/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive as __demoReactive, computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef } from 'vue'

const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: 'tonal', status: 'default' })
const demoCompareFields = [
  { name: 'variant', values: ['tonal', 'outline', 'standard'] },
  { name: 'status', values: ['info', 'success', 'warning', 'danger', 'default'] },
]
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef('variant')
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(
  () => demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)?.values ?? [],
)
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <mp-form layout="vertical">
      <mp-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="variant">
        <mp-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['variant']"
          aria-label="variant"
          :options="[
            { label: 'tonal', value: 'tonal' },
            { label: 'outline', value: 'outline' },
            { label: 'standard', value: 'standard' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="status">
        <mp-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['status']"
          aria-label="status"
          :options="[
            { label: 'info', value: 'info' },
            { label: 'success', value: 'success' },
            { label: 'warning', value: 'warning' },
            { label: 'danger', value: 'danger' },
            { label: 'default', value: 'default' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </mp-form-item>
    </mp-form>
    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint">
      <span lang="zh-CN">选择一个对比维度；其他配置和内容保持一致。输入类示例共享同一个值，便于比较外观。</span
      ><span lang="en-US"
        >Compare one dimension while keeping the other settings and content identical. Input specimens share the same
        value.</span
      >
    </p>
    <mp-radio-group
      v-model="demoCompareAxis"
      aria-label="Compare configuration"
      :options="demoCompareFields.map((field) => ({ label: field.name, value: field.name }))"
    />
    <div class="demo-config-comparison">
      <section v-for="sample in demoComparedOptions" :key="String(sample)">
        <p>
          <code>{{ demoCompareAxis }}={{ sample }}</code>
        </p>
        <mp-alert title="傲慢与偏见" v-bind="{ ...__demoAppearance, [demoCompareAxis]: sample }" />
      </section>
    </div>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Interaction and control

### Dismiss controls and custom icons

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | Title | Dismiss controls and custom icons |
| `message` | Content | Dismiss controls and custom icons |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Operate the default and custom dismiss controls to compare the same dismissal behavior.

<details>
<summary>Configuration details and limits</summary>

#### Allow To Close

Activate Close with a click, Space or Enter. The close event starts closing; closed follows the leave transition. Unmounting the component in close prevents observing its completed transition. This Demo retains the instance, counts both events, and reopens with a fresh key without changing other Alert instances.

</details>

Example source: src/alert/example/demos/dismiss-comparison.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { proxyRefs as demoProxyRefs, ref } from 'vue'

const scene1 = demoProxyRefs(
  (() => {
    const generation = ref(0)

    const closeCount = ref(0)

    const closedCount = ref(0)
    return { generation, closeCount, closedCount }
  })(),
)

const scene2 = demoProxyRefs(
  (() => {
    const showCloseIcon = ref(true)
    return { showCloseIcon }
  })(),
)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="demo-comparison">
    <section class="demo-comparison-case demo-comparison-case--1" data-comparison-scene="allow-to-close">
      <h4><span lang="zh-CN">允许关闭</span><span lang="en-US">Allow To Close</span></h4>
      <section class="alert-close-demo">
        <mp-alert
          :key="scene1.generation"
          title="傲慢与偏见"
          message="我也说不准是在什么时间，什么地点，看见你的什么神情，听见你的什么言语，便开始爱上了你。"
          closable
          @close="scene1.closeCount++"
          @closed="scene1.closedCount++"
        />
        <p role="status">Close: {{ scene1.closeCount }} · Closed: {{ scene1.closedCount }}</p>
        <mp-button :disabled="scene1.closedCount === scene1.generation" @click="scene1.generation++"
          >Reopen / 重新打开</mp-button
        >
      </section>
    </section>

    <section class="demo-comparison-case demo-comparison-case--2" data-comparison-scene="custom-close-icon">
      <h4><span lang="zh-CN">自定义关闭图标</span><span lang="en-US">Custom Close Icon</span></h4>
      <mp-alert
        v-if="scene2.showCloseIcon"
        title="傲慢与偏见"
        message="我也说不准是在什么时间，什么地点，看见你的什么神情，听见你的什么言语，便开始爱上了你。"
        closable
        @close="scene2.showCloseIcon = false"
      >
        <template #close-icon>
          <m-icon-close />
        </template>
      </mp-alert>
    </section>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped lang="less">
.demo-comparison {
  display: grid;
  gap: 24px;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.demo-comparison-case {
  min-width: 0;
```

## API

### Alert Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | ---------- |
| status | Type, optional values are `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `default` | _AlertStatus_<br>`'default' \| 'success' \| 'info' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `info` |
| `variant` | Variant, optional values are `standard` `outline` `tonal` | _AlertVariant_<br>`'standard' \| 'outline' \| 'tonal'` | `standard` |
| `color` | Background color | _string_ | `-` |
| `title` | Title | _string_ | `-` |
| `message` | Content | _string_ | `-` |
| `show-icon` | Whether to show the left icon | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `closable` | Whether the alert is `closeable` | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `banner` | Full-width mode without rounded corners | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `center` | Whether to center content | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `elevation` | Elevation, optional values are `true`, `false`, and levels from `0-24` | _number \| boolean_ | `false` |

### Alert Slots

| Name | Description |
| ------------ | ---------- |
| `default` | Content |
| `title` | Title |
| `icon` | The prepend icon of alert |
| `action` | Right action |
| `close-icon` | The close icon of alert |

### Alert Events

| Event | Description | Callback arguments |
| -------- | ------------------ | -------------- |
| `close` | Triggered when the Close button is clicked and can only be used when the Close button is displayed | `event: MouseEvent` |
| `closed` | Triggered after the leave transition completes | `-` |

## Types

```ts
import type { AlertInstance, AlertProps, AlertStatus, AlertVariant } from 'ui'
```

## Usage notes



The close button supports keyboard activation. close fires once; closed fires after the leave transition finishes.

### Close labels and elevation types

The close control uses the shared `common.close` locale key and updates reactively with its language scope. The `close-icon` slot replaces only the graphic. Customize `locale.common.close` through Cedar ConfigProvider, or the `'common.close'` message through Maple LocaleProvider.

`elevation` accepts only booleans or numbers. Use `:elevation="4"` for a numeric level; the string `elevation="4"` is outside the public type. Keyboard activation and clicks emit a MouseEvent; `closed` still fires after the leave transition.

## CSS Variables

See `--mp-alert-*` variables under `:root` in `style/token.less`. All use the `--mp-alert-` prefix and support customization through [ThemeProvider](#/en-US/theme-provider).

Colored titles, content, icons and outline borders use readable system content colors. standard and tonal share the same level-1 background; standard adds a subtle decorative border. Default titles use content-primary; body text and icons use content-secondary. The content variable also sets the root inherited color, used by close icons and actions without an explicit color. Maple dark mode inherits these colors while retaining its geometry overrides: 16px padding, 22px icons, 12px icon/close gaps and 1.5 body line height. color changes only the background; callers must also verify foreground contrast. The table lists :root defaults, not theme overrides.

```css
.component-theme {
  --mp-alert-border-radius: var(--mp-sys-radius-md);
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

### Motion

Built-in motion follows `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Reduced motion does not prevent loading-state or close-event updates.

# Atomic CSS

### Intro

| Layer | Package | When |
| ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| Fixed utilities `mp-*` | `utilities.css` | Use without Uno/TW |
| Uno / TW preset | `@maple-design/preset-unocss-vue` / `@maple-design/preset-tailwindcss-vue` | Full atomic system with the `mp-` prefix |

Phone preview uses the same CSS variables; real classes are generated by Uno/TW.
Both engines use the same names, such as `mp-flex`, `mp-p-16`, `mp-text-md`, and `mp-bg-primary`.
Tailwind's `prefix` is global, so one Tailwind instance cannot load the Cedar and Maple presets together; choose the preset for the current app.

Cedar: `@cedar-design/preset-unocss-vue` / `@cedar-design/preset-tailwindcss-vue` with `c-` prefix.

Daily class cheat sheet: [Common Utilities](#/en-US/atomic-usage).

```js
// playground-ignore
import '@maple-design/ui-vue/utilities/style'
```

### Starter example

Choose either UnoCSS or Tailwind. The utility names inside components are identical:

```vue
<template>
  <div class="mp-flex mp-max-w-md mp-flex-col mp-gap-12 mp-rounded-lg mp-border mp-border-solid mp-border-gray-200 mp-bg-body mp-p-16">
    <h3 class="mp-m-0 mp-text-lg mp-text-primary">My first atomic card</h3>
    <p class="mp-m-0 mp-text-sm">Combine small utilities instead of writing component CSS.</p>

    <div class="mp-flex mp-items-center mp-justify-between mp-gap-8 mp-rounded-md mp-bg-gray-100 mp-p-12">
      <code>mp-flex mp-items-center mp-gap-8</code>
      <span class="mp-text-success">Success</span>
    </div>

    <mp-button class="mp-rounded-md mp-border-0 mp-bg-primary mp-px-16 mp-py-8 mp-text-white hover:mp-opacity-80">
      Save
    </mp-button>
  </div>
</template>
```

Read it from left to right: `mp-` is the Maple prefix; `flex` controls layout; `p/px/py/gap` control spacing; `bg/text/border` control colors; `rounded` controls radius; and `hover:` is a state variant.

### UnoCSS

```js
// playground-ignore
import { presetMaple } from '@maple-design/preset-unocss-vue'
import { defineConfig } from 'unocss'

export default defineConfig({
  presets: [presetMaple()],
})
```

### Tailwind CSS

```js
// playground-ignore
import { presetMaple } from '@maple-design/preset-tailwindcss-vue'

export default {
  content: ['./index.html', './src/**/*.{vue,js,ts,jsx,tsx}'],
  presets: [presetMaple()],
}
```

### Class catalog

Colors: `mp-bg-primary` `mp-text-success` `mp-bg-body` …  
Font: Uno / Tailwind `mp-text-md`  
Spacing / Size: values map directly to pixels (`1 = 1px`), such as `mp-p-8` (8px), `mp-h-10` (10px), `mp-w-full` (100%)  
Overflow: `mp-overflow-hidden`, `mp-truncate`, `mp-line-clamp-2`  
Breakpoints: `sm:` `md:` `lg:` `xl:` (768 / 992 / 1200 / 1920)

The phone preview includes a numeric spacing demo for 4px, 8px, 16px, and independent horizontal/vertical padding.

```html
<!-- playground-ignore -->
<template>
  <div class="mp-bg-body mp-text-1 mp-text-md">
    <span class="mp-text-primary">primary</span>
    <div class="mp-bg-primary sm:mp-bg-info md:mp-bg-warning">maple</div>
  </div>
</template>
```

```vue
import { computed, onMounted, onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue'
import { onThemeChange } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/client'

onThemeChange()

const width = ref(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.innerWidth : 0)
const onResize = () => {
  width.value = window.innerWidth
}
onMounted(() => {
  width.value = window.innerWidth
  window.addEventListener('resize', onResize)
})
onUnmounted(() => window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize))

const active = computed(() => {
  const w = width.value
  if (w >= 1920) {
    return 'xl'
  }
  if (w >= 1200) {
    return 'lg'
  }
  if (w >= 992) {
    return 'md'
  }
  if (w >= 768) {
    return 'sm'
  }
  return 'base'
})
```

# Common Utilities

Daily class cheat sheet. Setup and theme tokens: [Atomic CSS](#/en-US/atomic-css).

- Always use the `mp-` prefix; no unprefixed aliases
- Numeric spacing / size: `1 = 1px`, e.g. `mp-p-8` is 8px, `mp-h-40` is 40px
- Variants come first: `hover:mp-opacity-80` `focus:mp-border-primary`
- Breakpoints are unprefixed: `sm:mp-flex` `md:mp-p-24`

UnoCSS and Tailwind share the same class names; enable one generator per app.

### Layout

| Kind | Common classes |
| --- | --- |
| Display | `mp-block` `mp-inline-block` `mp-inline-flex` `mp-flex` `mp-grid` `mp-hidden` |
| Flex direction | `mp-flex-row` `mp-flex-col` `mp-flex-wrap` |
| Main axis | `mp-justify-start` `mp-justify-center` `mp-justify-between` `mp-justify-end` |
| Cross axis | `mp-items-start` `mp-items-center` `mp-items-stretch` `mp-items-end` |
| Flex grow | `mp-flex-1` `mp-flex-none` `mp-shrink-0` `mp-grow` |
| Grid | `mp-grid-cols-2` `mp-grid-cols-3` `mp-col-span-2` |

```html
<!-- playground-ignore -->
<div class="mp-flex mp-items-center mp-justify-between mp-gap-8">
  <span>Left</span>
  <span>Right</span>
</div>
```

### Position

| Kind | Common classes |
| --- | --- |
| Mode | `mp-relative` `mp-absolute` `mp-fixed` `mp-affix` `mp-static` |
| Edges | `mp-inset-0` `mp-top-0` `mp-right-0` `mp-bottom-0` `mp-left-0` |
| Stacking | `mp-z-0` `mp-z-10` `mp-z-20` `mp-z-50` |

`inset` / `top` values use the spacing scale: `mp-top-8` is `8px`.

### Spacing

| Kind | Common classes |
| --- | --- |
| margin | `mp-m-16` `mp-mt-8` `mp-mx-16` `mp-my-8` `mp-m-auto` `mp-ml-auto` |
| padding | `mp-p-16` `mp-px-12` `mp-py-8` `mp-pt-24` |
| gap | `mp-gap-8` `mp-gap-x-16` `mp-gap-y-12` |

Directions: `t` top / `r` right / `b` bottom / `l` left / `x` horizontal / `y` vertical.

### Size

| Kind | Common classes |
| --- | --- |
| Width / height | `mp-w-40` `mp-h-40` `mp-w-full` `mp-h-full` `mp-w-auto` `mp-h-auto` |
| Fractions | `mp-w-1/2` `mp-w-1/3` `mp-h-1/2` |
| Viewport | `mp-w-screen` `mp-h-screen` `mp-min-h-screen` |
| Constraints | `mp-min-w-0` `mp-max-w-md` `mp-min-h-0` `mp-max-h-full` |

`mp-h-10` is **10px**, not 10%. Use `mp-h-full` or `mp-h-1/2` for percentages.

### Overflow

| Kind | Common classes |
| --- | --- |
| overflow | `mp-overflow-hidden` `mp-overflow-auto` `mp-overflow-scroll` `mp-overflow-visible` |
| Axis | `mp-overflow-x-auto` `mp-overflow-y-auto` `mp-overflow-x-hidden` |
| Single-line | `mp-truncate` |
| Multi-line | `mp-line-clamp-1` `mp-line-clamp-2` `mp-line-clamp-3` |

### Typography

| Kind | Common classes |
| --- | --- |
| Align | `mp-text-left` `mp-text-center` `mp-text-right` |
| Theme font size | `mp-text-xs` `mp-text-sm` `mp-text-md` `mp-text-lg` |
| Weight | `mp-font-normal` `mp-font-medium` `mp-font-semibold` `mp-font-bold` |
| Line height | `mp-leading-none` `mp-leading-tight` `mp-leading-normal` |
| Whitespace | `mp-whitespace-nowrap` `mp-whitespace-pre-wrap` |
| Wrap | `mp-break-words` `mp-break-all` |

Do not confuse these with semantic text colors `mp-text-1` … `mp-text-4`.

### Color

Theme color classes set only the matching property. Pair border color with a width class.

| Use | Common classes |
| --- | --- |
| Background | `mp-bg-body` `mp-bg-primary` `mp-bg-success` `mp-bg-warning` `mp-bg-danger` `mp-bg-info` `mp-bg-disabled` |
| Text | `mp-text-primary` `mp-text-success` `mp-text-white` |
| Border color | `mp-border-primary` `mp-border-danger` |

Semantic levels (`mp-text-1`, `mp-fill-2`, `mp-color-border-2`, `mp-bg-1`) live on [Color](#/en-US/color). Palette scales: [Palette](#/en-US/palette).

```html
<!-- playground-ignore -->
<div class="mp-border mp-border-primary">primary border</div>
<mp-button class="mp-bg-primary mp-text-white hover:mp-opacity-80">Save</mp-button>
```

### Border

| Kind | Common classes |
| --- | --- |
| Width | `mp-border` `mp-border-0` `mp-border-2` `mp-border-t` `mp-border-b` |
| Style | `mp-border-solid` `mp-border-dashed` `mp-border-none` |

### Rounded

| Common classes | Note |
| --- | --- |
| `mp-rounded-none` `mp-rounded-sm` `mp-rounded-md` `mp-rounded-lg` `mp-rounded-xl` `mp-rounded-full` | Uno / TW scale |
| `mp-rounded-t-md` `mp-rounded-l-lg` | One side |

### Variants

| Kind | Syntax |
| --- | --- |
| Interaction | `hover:mp-opacity-80` `focus:mp-border-primary` `active:mp-opacity-70` `disabled:mp-opacity-40` |
| Breakpoints | `sm:mp-flex` `md:mp-p-24` `lg:mp-grid-cols-3` `xl:mp-max-w-screen` |

Breakpoints: `sm` 768 / `md` 992 / `lg` 1200 / `xl` 1920.

Do not interpolate class names such as `mp-bg-${status}`; Uno / TW only scans complete literals.

### Not on this page

| Topic | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Elevation / shadow | [Elevation](#/en-US/styles); `mp-shadow-*` is blocked |
| Semantic color levels | [Color](#/en-US/color) |
| Palette scales | [Palette](#/en-US/palette) |
| Install / config | [Atomic CSS](#/en-US/atomic-css) |

<!-- Source: src/auto-complete/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/auto-complete -->

# AutoComplete

Free-text input with suggestions. Both libraries independently maintain the same component, props, Menu and styles. Local Input/Form integration supplies hover versus touch behavior; no shared runtime or platform configuration.

Opening and filtering are independent: shouldOpen controls opening, filterOption filters candidates. Empty results, disabled and readonly keep the menu closed. No list/picker presentation is provided.

## Reading direction

The editor and suggestion popup inherit source dir, including in custom containers. Horizontal caret keys keep native editing behavior; vertical keys navigate candidates, Enter selects and Escape closes. Candidate updates preserve the native composition buffer until composition ends instead of repainting the previous model value.

## Basic examples

### Input and selection

Example source: src/auto-complete/example/demos/en-US/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <mp-auto-complete
    v-model="value"
    :options="options"
    placeholder="Type or select a city"
    clearable
    style="width: 100%; max-width: 320px"
  />
  <p>Current value: {{ value || '-' }}</p>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('')
const options = [
  'Beijing',
  { value: 310000, label: 'Shanghai' },
  { value: 'chengdu', label: 'Chengdu' },
  { value: 'wuhan', label: 'Wuhan', disabled: true },
]
</script>
```

### Custom text submission

Choose a suggestion to commit immediately, or confirm custom text.

Example source: src/auto-complete/example/demos/en-US/custom-draft.vue

```vue
</script>

  <div>
    <p>Choose a suggestion to commit immediately, or confirm custom text.</p>
    <mp-auto-complete v-model="value" edit-mode="popup" :options="options" />
    <p>Committed value: {{ value || '—' }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

Use this example for suggestions while allowing free text. Adjust variant, size and compare the component with the same data. Keep the content unchanged while comparing the available settings.

Example source: src/auto-complete/example/demos/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive as __demoReactive, computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef, ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('研发')
const options = [{ value: '研发' }, { value: '研发平台' }, { value: '设计' }]
const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: 'filled', size: 'md' })
const demoCompareFields = [
  { name: 'variant', values: ['filled', 'outline', 'standard'] },
  { name: 'size', values: ['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'] },
]
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef('variant')
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(
  () => demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)?.values ?? [],
)
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <mp-form layout="vertical">
      <mp-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="variant">
        <mp-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['variant']"
          aria-label="variant"
          :options="[
            { label: 'filled', value: 'filled' },
            { label: 'outline', value: 'outline' },
            { label: 'standard', value: 'standard' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="size">
        <mp-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['size']"
          aria-label="size"
          :options="[
            { label: 'xs', value: 'xs' },
            { label: 'sm', value: 'sm' },
            { label: 'md', value: 'md' },
            { label: 'lg', value: 'lg' },
            { label: 'xl', value: 'xl' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </mp-form-item>
    </mp-form>
    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint">
      <span lang="zh-CN">选择一个对比维度；其他配置和内容保持一致。输入类示例共享同一个值，便于比较外观。</span
      ><span lang="en-US"
        >Compare one dimension while keeping the other settings and content identical. Input specimens share the same
        value.</span
      >
    </p>
    <mp-radio-group
      v-model="demoCompareAxis"
      aria-label="Compare configuration"
      :options="demoCompareFields.map((field) => ({ label: field.name, value: field.name }))"
    />
    <div class="demo-config-comparison">
      <section v-for="sample in demoComparedOptions" :key="String(sample)">
        <p>
          <code>{{ demoCompareAxis }}={{ sample }}</code>
        </p>
        <mp-auto-complete
          v-model="value"
          :options="options"
          clearable
          v-bind="{ ...__demoAppearance, [demoCompareAxis]: sample }"
        ></mp-auto-complete>
      </section>
    </div>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Matching and suggestions

### Opening and filtering

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `options` | Suggestions, including groups; unique values become strings on selection | Opening and filtering, Case sensitivity, Group spacing |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder or floating hint text | Opening and filtering, Case sensitivity, Group spacing |
| `should-open` | Opening policy; does not filter candidates | Opening and filtering, Group spacing, Virtual list |
| `filter-option` | Filter by label; false for remote filtering | Opening and filtering |
| `case-sensitive` | Case-sensitive built-in matching | Case sensitivity |
| `trigger-props` | Trigger configuration; cannot override owned opening and disabled state | Group spacing |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/auto-complete/example/demos/en-US/opening-policy.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('')
const allowEmpty = ref(false)
const filter = ref(true)
const shouldOpen = (text: string) => allowEmpty.value || text.length >= 2
const options = ['Cedar', 'Maple', 'Vue']
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" size="md">
    <mp-checkbox v-model="allowEmpty">Allow opening with empty input</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="filter">Filter suggestions by input</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-auto-complete
      v-model="value"
      :options="options"
      :filter-option="filter"
      :should-open="shouldOpen"
      placeholder="Type two characters to open by default"
    />
    <p>Opening policy does not filter candidates. The menu remains closed when there are no matches.</p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Interaction and keyboard

### Interaction state comparison

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| `options` | Suggestions, including groups; unique values become strings on selection | Interaction state comparison, Keyboard and accessibility |
| `clearable` | Allow clearing a nonempty editable value | Interaction state comparison |
| `disabled` | Disabled; inherited when unset, explicit false overrides | Interaction state comparison |
| `readonly` | Readonly; focus/copy allowed, suggestions stay closed | Interaction state comparison |
| `error` | Error state; inherits FormItem when unset | Interaction state comparison |
| `input-attrs` | Native input attributes; combobox state is owned by the component | Keyboard and accessibility |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Toggle disabled, read-only and error states, then interact with the same instance. Recovery controls remain outside the target; error appearance alone does not validate data.

<details>

</details>

Grouped option lists share Menu spacing: a 20px title line with 4px vertical padding (28px total), an extra 8px before subsequent groups, and no extra group gap before the first title. Labels align with option text; AutoComplete labels follow its option horizontal padding.

## Async data and configuration

### Async suggestions

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `options` | Suggestions, including groups; unique values become strings on selection | Async suggestions, Typed passthrough configuration |
| `filter-option` | Filter by label; false for remote filtering | Async suggestions |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder or floating hint text | Async suggestions |
| `disabled` | Disabled; inherited when unset, explicit false overrides | Typed passthrough configuration |
| `should-open` | Opening policy; does not filter candidates | Typed passthrough configuration |
| `trigger-props` | Trigger configuration; cannot override owned opening and disabled state | Typed passthrough configuration |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/auto-complete/example/demos/en-US/remote.vue

```vue
<template>
  <mp-auto-complete
    v-model="value"
    :options="options"
    :filter-option="false"
    placeholder="Type to request suggestions"
    style="width: 100%; max-width: 320px"
    @search="handleSearch"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('')
const options = ref<string[]>([])

let requestId = 0
onBeforeUnmount(() => requestId++)
const handleSearch = async (keyword: string) => {
  const current = ++requestId
  const result = await Promise.resolve(
    keyword ? Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, index) => `${keyword}-${index + 1}`) : [],
  )
  if (current === requestId) {
    options.value = result
  }
}
</script>
```

### Typed passthrough configuration

AutoCompleteTriggerOptions is an opt-in configuration subset that excludes internally owned Trigger fields, consistent with Select and Cascader. The host trigger-props property intentionally retains TriggerProps, with internal state taking precedence. Candidate visibility follows focus/input and should-open; public open/default-open/update:open/open-change belong to the deferred field editor. Top-level popup-container wins when defined, including false; otherwise the nested container applies.

Example source: src/auto-complete/example/demos/passthrough-options.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { AutoCompleteTriggerOptions } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const disabled = ref(false)
const triggerOptions: AutoCompleteTriggerOptions = { placement: 'top-start', popupOffset: 8, popupContainer: false }
const options = [
  { value: 'USER_A', label: 'Apple' },
  { value: 'USER_B', label: 'Banana' },
]
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" fill>
    <mp-button @click="disabled = !disabled">{{ disabled ? '启用输入' : '禁用输入' }}</mp-button>
    <mp-auto-complete
      edit-mode="direct"
      :disabled="disabled"
      :should-open="() => true"
      :options="options"
      :trigger-props="triggerOptions"
      aria-label="透传配置示例"
    />
    <p role="status">顶层 disabled：{{ disabled }}；聚焦输入框查看向上展开的候选。</p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## Usage notes

### Editing and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `popup` and opens an editor when the value area is clicked. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-direct modes open an editor through the field value trigger. Choosing a suggestion commits immediately by default; custom text uses confirmation. need-confirm also requires confirmation for suggestions. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards an uncommitted draft.

Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` can guard saving the editor. FormItem validates the candidate first; invalid candidates keep the editor open. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes read content. See the unified field presentation examples in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

Asynchronous search should clear old candidates when requests start and accept only the latest response for the current query. Popup arrows/Enter operate current candidates; confirmation mode saves with the bottom button, while immediate single selection commits on choice. Failed validation in confirmation mode preserves drafts. Confirmation locks editing/closing; Form reset closes Popup and aborts submission. Closing/reset invalidates request ownership. See Form’s unified field-presentation examples.

The candidate list shares group, selected and disabled styling with Select, and AutoComplete variables follow their Select counterparts by default. In direct mode the list opens below the input and updates while scrolling; trigger-props can change placement or enable automatic flipping. The field presentation owns the deferred editor while the internal input owns suggestions; each platform retains its public edit-mode values.

### Search fields

`searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node.

### Configuration

Clearing does not emit search or reopen candidates, including when focus returns from a keyboard-focused clear button to the input. The parent controls the value: each rejected clear or selection still emits a change proposal; an accepted candidate selection notifies Form once.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### AutoComplete Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| need-confirm | Applies only to overlay editing. Choosing a suggestion commits and closes by default; true keeps a draft until confirmation. Submission still runs form validation and before-commit; rejection keeps the editor open. AutoComplete typing does not auto-submit; a changed text draft provides a confirmation button, while choosing a suggestion completes selection immediately. | `boolean` | `false` |
| `model-value` | Controlled text | `string \| null` | `—` |
| `default-value` | Initial uncontrolled text | `string` | `''` |
| `options` | Suggestions, including groups; unique values become strings on selection | `(AutoCompleteOption \| SelectOptionGroup)[]` / `(query, { signal }) => Array / Promise` | `undefined` |
| `field-names` | Map value, label, disabled and other fields | `AutoCompleteFieldNames` | `—` |
| `should-open` | Opening policy; does not filter candidates | `(value: string) => boolean` | `value.length > 0` |
| `filter-option` | Filter by label; false for remote filtering | `AutoCompleteFilterOption` | Automatic: enabled for arrays, disabled for loader functions |
| `case-sensitive` | Case-sensitive built-in matching | `boolean` | `false` |
| `popup-container` | Popup container; same contract as Trigger | `PopupContainer` | `—` |

| `variant` | Input variant; inherits Group when unset | `filled \| outline \| standard` | `outline` |
| `disabled` | Disabled; inherited when unset, explicit false overrides | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| `readonly` | Readonly; focus/copy allowed, suggestions stay closed | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| `error` | Error state; inherits FormItem when unset | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| `clearable` | Allow clearing a nonempty editable value | `boolean` | `false` |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder or floating hint text | `string` | `—` |
| `hint` | Enable Input floating hint | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| `line` | Show border or underline | `boolean` | `true` |
| `text-color` | Instance text color | `string` | `—` |
| `focus-color` | Instance focus color | `string` | `—` |
| `blur-color` | Instance unfocused hint color | `string` | `—` |
| `enterkeyhint` | Virtual keyboard action hint | `InputHTMLAttributes['enterKeyHint']` | `—` |
| `aria-label` | Accessible input name | `string` | `—` |
| `max-length` | Finite nonnegative length or `{ length, errorOnly? }`; 0 is unlimited; invalid values diagnose and fall back to no limit | `number \| { length: number; errorOnly?: boolean }` | `0` |
| `show-word-limit` | Display word count | `boolean` | `false` |
| `word-length` | Custom length calculation | `(value: string) => number` | `—` |
| `word-slice` | Custom slicing | `(value: string, maxLength: number) => string` | `—` |
| `input-attrs` | Native input attributes; combobox state is owned by the component | `Record<string, unknown>` | `—` |
| edit-mode | Editing mode, inherited from FormItem and Form | `'direct' \| 'popup'` | `'direct'` |
| read-pretty | Independent read presentation; explicit false overrides the parent | `boolean` | `false` |
| empty-value | Clear output; explicit null is submitted unchanged | `string \| null \| (() => string \| null)` | `''` |
| empty-values | Empty-value recognition; field takes precedence over FormItem and Form | `readonly unknown[]` | `-` |
| empty-text | Read empty text; an explicit empty string is valid | `string` | `'-'` |
| before-commit | Guard before saving a deferred edit; return a boolean or Promise, or complete via done | `(payload: { value: unknown; previousValue: unknown }, done: (allow?: boolean) => void, context: { signal: AbortSignal; event?: Event }) => void \| boolean \| Promise<void \| boolean>` | `-` |
| open | Controlled editor visibility, separate from native input focus | `boolean` | `-` |
| default-open | Initial visibility of an uncontrolled editor | `boolean` | `false` |
| search-delay | Query debounce in milliseconds for an explicit options loader; search notifications are not delayed | number | 250 |
| search-fields | Built-in search fields, mapped through field-names | `readonly ('label' \| 'value')[]` | `['label']` |
| loading | Manual waiting feedback; does not implicitly disable text editing | boolean | false |
| loading-mode | Field waiting feedback style | default \| line | default |

### AutoComplete Events

| Event | Arguments |
| --- | --- |
| keydown | event: KeyboardEvent |
| update:modelValue | value: string \| null |
| input | value: string, event: Event |
| search | value: string, event: Event |
| change | value: string \| null, event: Event |
| select | value: string, option: AutoCompleteOptionInfo, event: Event |
| clear | event: Event |
| focus / blur | event: FocusEvent |
| dropdown-scroll / dropdown-reach-bottom | event: Event |
| load-error | error: unknown |
| update:open / open-change | open: boolean |

`keydown` notifies before the internal keyboard action; call `preventDefault()` to suppress it.
When suggestions are embedded in the editor, Escape closes the editor. When suggestions are a separate popup, Escape closes that popup first.

Typing: `input → update:modelValue → search`; selection: `update:modelValue → select → change`; clear: `clear → input → update:modelValue → change`. Selecting the same value emits only select. change is a commit on blur, Enter or selection. Input owns typing/focus/clear Form notifications; AutoComplete notifies Form once for suggestion commits. Selection applies maxLength; select.value is the committed string, while option.value retains the original suggestion. clear receives an event, not a string.

options is an explicit data loader accepting query and { signal }; it may return an array or a Promise. Failures emit load-error, and refresh retries the current query. Ordinary events such as search only notify and do not collect listener Promises. open events refer only to the deferred field editor.

### AutoComplete Slots

| Slot | Description and arguments |
| --- | --- |
| option | data: AutoCompleteOptionInfo |
| empty | Empty candidate content inside the field editor; no arguments. Cedar shows it with its native input; Maple shows it in the editor candidate area. |
| footer | Menu footer |
| prefix / suffix | Input prefix / suffix |
| clear-icon | clear(event?: Event): void |
| read | value: string \| null, text: string; preserves the raw empty model |

default does not replace the input. option customizes candidates, read customizes reading content, and empty customizes the field editor with no candidates. Ordinary direct input closes the menu when no candidates match.

### AutoComplete Methods

| Method | Arguments | Returns |
| --- | --- | --- |
| focus | - | void |
| blur | - | void |
| refresh | - | `Promise<void>` |

Arrow keys reopen the popup after Escape closes it: ArrowDown activates the first enabled candidate and ArrowUp the last, without committing the model; Enter selects. Composition, canceled keyboard events, readonly/disabled and should-open conditions are respected; Tab retains native focus navigation. Vue useId provides stable SSR identifiers. While candidates are open, aria-controls links the input to the list; the reference is removed on close. When virtualization unmounts the active item, its reference is temporarily removed and restored after remounting.

## Types

```ts
import type {
  AutoCompleteFieldNames,
  AutoCompleteFilterOption,
  AutoCompleteInstance,
  AutoCompleteOption,
  AutoCompleteOptionData,
  AutoCompleteOptionInfo,
  AutoCompleteProps,
} from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
```

### Type imports

Root and component entries export `AutoCompleteEmits`、`AutoCompleteSlots`、`AutoCompleteExpose` alongside Props and Instance. Emits are event argument tuples derived from the runtime validators; Expose contains focus/blur.

`case-sensitive` only makes built-in local filtering `case-sensitive`: `ap` matches `Apple` when false, but not when true. It does not require choosing an option or validate the value. A custom `filterOption` takes priority; `filterOption=false` disables local filtering and makes `case-sensitive` irrelevant.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

## Loading options through a function prop

Pass options(query, { signal }) directly; useAsyncData is unnecessary. options still accepts arrays, and an explicit array, including [], takes precedence. The component manages loading, stale-result isolation and cancellation. load-error reports failures, and the instance refresh() method retries. A business loader may accept only query and ignore the second argument.

AutoComplete text input always supports searching; filter-option only controls local matching and does not issue requests. Explicit options loaders disable secondary local filtering by default; arrays enable it. Business code usually does not need filter-option.

```vue
<mp-auto-complete v-model="text" :options="loadSuggestions" />
```

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omission preserves the existing default. The UI displays null as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to null. In confirmation mode, clearing changes the draft and confirm commits it; without confirmation, clearing commits directly.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

Refresh can retry the component-owned asynchronous option source before the editor opens, using the existing AbortSignal, loading, and load-error protocol without opening the editor; static arrays do not create extra requests.

Follow-up acceptance testing (not yet completed): use real screen readers, such as VoiceOver and NVDA, with supported browsers to verify spoken input names, suggestion loading and navigation, selection, dismissal, and form errors.

# Avatar

Both libraries use the same implementation and examples; package prefixes, themes and registration stay local.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Avatars default to a circle at the default size. Use the default slot for text or icons, or pass an image.

```vue

    <mp-avatar color="#00bebe">U</mp-avatar>
    <mp-avatar image-url="/cat.jpg" alt="一只猫" />
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Group direction and overflow

Compare horizontal and vertical groups, maximum counts, stacking and overflow indicators.

<details>
<summary>Configuration details and limits</summary>

#### Avatar group

`AvatarGroup` stacks children. Use `bordered` for layered outlines, `maxCount` to fold extras into a Popover, `maxStyle` for the summary avatar, and `zIndexAscend` for stacking order. `shape` / `size` / `offset` apply to every child.

#### Vertical group

`vertical` stacks avatars in a column. `offset` is the overlap, in px when numeric.

</details>

Example source: src/avatar/example/demos/group-comparison.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts"></script>

<template>
  <div class="demo-comparison">
    <section class="demo-comparison-case demo-comparison-case--1" data-comparison-scene="group">
      <h4><span lang="zh-CN">头像组</span><span lang="en-US">Avatar group</span></h4>
      <mp-space direction="column" :size="24">
        <mp-space direction="column" :size="8">
```

## Content and presentation

### Auto-fit text

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image-url` | Image URL | Image avatar, Image fit, Loading and fallback |
| `alt` | Image alternative text | Image avatar, Image fit, Loading and fallback |
| `size` | Avatar width and height; numbers are px, strings are CSS lengths | Image avatar, Image fit, Loading and fallback |
| `shape` | Avatar shape | Auto-fit text, Image avatar |
| `auto-fix-font-size` | Whether to shrink long text automatically | Auto-fit text |
| `object-fit` | Image fitting mode | Image fit |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Long text scales to the avatar width by default. Updated slot text is measured after rendering; shortening it restores the original scale when it fits. Set `auto-fix-font-size` to `false` to keep the original size.

Example source: src/avatar/example/demos/auto-fix.vue

```vue
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <mp-space align="center" :size="16" wrap>
      <mp-space direction="column" align="center" :size="8">
        <mp-avatar>{{ text }}</mp-avatar>
        <span class="label">圆形 · 自适应</span>
      </mp-space>
      <mp-space direction="column" align="center" :size="8">
        <mp-avatar shape="square">{{ text }}</mp-avatar>
        <span class="label">方形 · 自适应</span>
      </mp-space>
      <mp-space direction="column" align="center" :size="8">
        <mp-avatar :auto-fix-font-size="false">{{ text }}</mp-avatar>
        <span class="label">关闭自适应</span>
      </mp-space>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-input v-model="text" :style="{ width: '240px' }" placeholder="输入更长的文字看缩放" clearable />
  </mp-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const text = ref('Cedar')
</script>

  font-size: var(--mp-font-size-sm);
}
</style>
```

## Interaction and control

### Trigger icon

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image-url` | Image URL | Trigger icon |
| `alt` | Image alternative text | Trigger icon |
| `size` | Avatar width and height; numbers are px, strings are CSS lengths | Trigger icon |
| `trigger-type` | How the action icon is shown | Trigger icon |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


The `trigger-icon` slot adds an action. `triggerType` is `button` or `overlay`; clicks emit `click`.

Example source: src/avatar/example/demos/trigger.vue

```vue
<template>
  <mp-space align="flex-end" :size="32" wrap>
    <mp-space direction="column" align="center" :size="8">
      <mp-avatar image-url="/cat.jpg" alt="头像" trigger-aria-label="编辑头像" :size="56" @click="onClick('button')">
        <template #trigger-icon>+</template>
      </mp-avatar>
      <span class="label">{{ last === 'button' ? 'click · button' : 'trigger-type="button"' }}</span>
    </mp-space>

    <mp-space direction="column" align="center" :size="8">
      <mp-avatar
        image-url="/cat2.jpg"
        alt="头像"
        trigger-aria-label="更换头像"
        :size="56"
        trigger-type="overlay"
        @click="onClick('overlay')"
      >
        <template #trigger-icon>+</template>
      </mp-avatar>
      <span class="label">{{ last === 'overlay' ? 'click · overlay' : 'trigger-type="overlay"' }}</span>
    </mp-space>
  </mp-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const last = ref('')

function onClick(type: string) {
  last.value = type
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.label {
  color: var(--mp-color-text-3);
  font-size: var(--mp-font-size-sm);
}
</style>
```

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->
The default image `error` icon retains a nonempty `alt` as its accessible name; an empty `alt` denotes decoration. Provide appropriate semantics for a custom `error` slot. The default slot may switch dynamically between images and text; application code owns slotted image load events and styles.

When `trigger-icon` contains no interactive control, the avatar exposes button semantics and supports Enter and Space. Describe the action with `trigger-aria-label` or the root `aria-label`. If the slot supplies its own interactive control, that control handles keyboard input. The default click-triggered group summary can be opened by keyboard; Escape closes it and restores focus.

### Avatar Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| shape | Avatar shape | `circle / square` | `circle` |
| image-url | Image URL | `string` | `-` |
| alt | Image alternative text | `string` | `''` |
| size | Avatar width and height; numbers are px, strings are CSS lengths | `number / string` | `-` |
| auto-fix-font-size | Whether to shrink long text automatically | `boolean` | `true` |
| trigger-type | How the action icon is shown | `button / overlay` | `button` |
| trigger-aria-label | Accessible name of the interaction | `string` | `—` |
| trigger-icon-style | Custom style for the action icon | `CSSProperties` | `-` |
| object-fit | Image fitting mode | `fill / contain / cover / none / scale-down` | `cover` |
| color | Background color | `string` | `-` |
| bordered | Whether to show a border | `boolean` | `false` |
| border-color | Border color | `string` | `-` |
| loading | Placeholder image while loading | `string` | `-` |
| error | Fallback image URL when image loading fails | `string` | `-` |
| lazy | Whether to lazy-load the image | `boolean` | `false` |
| hoverable | Whether to scale on hover | `boolean` | `false` |

### Avatar Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| click | Emitted when the avatar is clicked | `(event: MouseEvent) => void` |
| load | Emitted when the image loads | `() => void` |
| error | Emitted when image loading fails | `() => void` |

### Avatar Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Text, icon, or loading content for an image |
| error | Fallback content when image loading fails |
| trigger-icon | Action icon on the avatar |

### Avatar Methods

No custom public methods.
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

Group `shape` and `auto-fix-font-size` override item values, and a supplied group `size` takes priority. `max-count` is a nonnegative integer; zero or an invalid value means unlimited. Numeric `size` must be finite and nonnegative; invalid numbers use the default, while strings are CSS lengths. `offset` accepts finite negative numbers or CSS length strings; invalid numbers use the default spacing. The summary participates in group stacking order, which overrides z-index in `max-style`.

### AvatarGroup Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| shape | Child avatar shape | `circle / square` | `circle` |
| size | Child avatar width and height; numbers are px, strings are CSS lengths | `number / string` | `-` |
| auto-fix-font-size | Whether to shrink child avatar text automatically | `boolean` | `true` |
| max-count | Maximum visible avatars; `0` means unlimited | `number` | `0` |
| z-index-ascend | Use ascending stacking order | `boolean` | `false` |
| max-style | Custom summary avatar style | `CSSProperties` | `-` |
| max-popover-props | Summary Popover props | `PopoverProps` | `-` |
| offset | Overlap offset | `number / string` | `-` |
| vertical | Stack avatars vertically | `boolean` | `false` |

### AvatarGroup Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Avatar list |

## CSS Variables

Text, summary counts, and button-style trigger icons use the primary content role. Borders follow the ordinary container surface; only icons on the dark interaction overlay use `content-on-dark`. The `fill-4` avatar background, trigger background/hover step, and translucent black overlay remain component visual values. If the `color` prop changes the avatar background, check text contrast and override `text-color` when needed. Maple's dark avatar background remains a component-specific `#303030`.

<!-- component-css-variables:start -->

Use these variables to customize the component. Defaults may vary by the selector condition shown. Each variable applies to the corresponding size, variant and interaction states.

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --mp-avatar-border-color: var(--mp-sys-color-surface-default);
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

### Reduced motion

Built-in CSS transitions follow `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Removing transitions does not change final visibility, selected/expanded state or event semantics. Applications control custom animations inside slots.

---

Document: llms/en-US/back-top.md

<!-- Source: src/back-top/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/back-top -->

# BackTop

Visibility RAF and JS duration/easing interpolation have separate ownership. Old listeners/canceled or consumed frames cannot replay after target replacement/deactivation/disposal. Recheck after custom easing before writing; RAF/cancel/time origin use the target owner window. Retained inactive/disposed commands are inert, activation does not resume old animation. Scoped14/full30 per copy pass using controlled queues/iframe, not native browser/OS proof. Default200ms/API remain; no CSS token added.

A native button that scrolls the page or an explicit container to the top.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Example source: src/back-top/example/demos/en-US/basic-usage.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue'

const scroller = ref<HTMLElement>()
onMounted(() => {
  if (scroller.value) {
    scroller.value.scrollTop = 240
    scroller.value.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll'))
  }
})
</script>

<template>
  <div class="back-top-demo">
    <p>Scroll inside this panel. The button appears at 120px.</p>
    <div class="back-top-demo__frame">
      <div ref="scroller" class="back-top-demo__scroll">
        <p v-for="row in 30" :key="row">A · Scroll content {{ row }}</p>
      </div>
      <mp-back-top
        :target-container="() => scroller"
        :popup-container="false"
        :visible-height="120"
        :right="16"
        :bottom="16"
        aria-label="Back to top"
      />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.back-top-demo {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}
.back-top-demo > p {
  margin: 0;
}
.back-top-demo__frame {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
}
.back-top-demo__scroll {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 240px;
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.back-top-demo__scroll p {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  margin: 0;
}
</style>
```
