### Virtual navigation

The demo uses `Space direction="column"` to place controls above a full-width list. `estimatedSize` estimates unmeasured rows; application rows do not need a fixed height.

Navigation uses rendered row bounds when available and updates virtual padding after measurement. Programmatic scroll events preserve the current alignment while rendering rows; a different native scroll position, a new command, data replacement, deactivation or disposal cancels its deferred correction. `auto` leaves a fully visible row and the rendered window unchanged. Observed root size changes update measurements where `ResizeObserver` is available; arbitrary layout changes are not continuously tracked.

Example source: src/list/example/demos/en-US/virtual-navigation.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const list = ref()
const rows = Array.from({ length: 1000 }, (_, id) => ({ id, name: 'Row ' + (id + 1) }))
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%">
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button @click="list.scrollIntoView({ key: 499, align: 'top' })">Row 500 at top</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="list.scrollIntoView({ key: 499, align: 'bottom' })">Row 500 at bottom</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="list.scrollIntoView({ key: 499, align: 'auto' })">Scroll only if needed</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-list
      ref="list"
      :data="rows"
      :virtual-list-props="{ height: 240, itemKey: 'id', estimatedSize: 48, buffer: 10 }"
    >
      <template #item="{ item, index }"
        ><mp-list-item
          ><template #prefix>{{ index + 1 }}</template
          >{{ item.name }}</mp-list-item
        ></template
      >
    </mp-list>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### manual usage

## Lifecycle

### Lifecycle

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | Data consumed by item slot | Lifecycle |
| `virtual-list-props` | Data virtualization; ignored when default slot exists | Lifecycle |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

On KeepAlive reactivation, the virtual list restores its last recorded vertical and horizontal scroll positions within the current scrollable range. A new scroll command issued during reactivation takes precedence.


Example source: src/list/example/demos/en-US/virtual-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref(true)
const mounted = ref(true)
const rows = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, key) => ({ key }))
let retained
const capture = (instance) => {
  if (instance) {
    retained = instance
  }
}
const jump = () => retained?.scrollIntoView({ key: 50, align: 'top' })
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <mp-button @click="active = !active">Activate / deactivate</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="mounted = !mounted">Mount / dispose cache</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="jump">Retained command: row 51</mp-button>
    <p>Inactive/disposed commands do nothing. Activation never replays them.</p>
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <mp-list
        v-if="active"
        :ref="capture"
        :data="rows"
        :virtual-list-props="{ height: 100, fixedSize: true, estimatedSize: 20, buffer: 2, itemKey: 'key' }"
      >
        <template #item="{ item }"
          ><div style="height: 20px">{{ item.key + 1 }}</div></template
        >
      </mp-list>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

`scrollIntoView` forwards options to the internal VirtualList `scrollTo` only in virtual mode; it is not a direct native DOM scrollIntoView or a local motion timer. Native scrolling, preferences and retained-command lifecycle require a separate VirtualList consumer audit. Source hints are not visual acceptance; this classification changes no List API/implementation.

## API

The virtual list covers the viewport before prerendering additional items on either side according to `buffer`; `buffer=0` is valid. `estimatedSize` must be finite and positive, including values below 1; invalid values fall back to 30px. `fixedSize` can change dynamically. Variable-height mode uses measured and estimated sizes and, when available, `ResizeObserver` to watch measurable mounted roots. The `item` slot receives the original index and unknown data, may return multiple measurable root nodes, and should provide a stable `itemKey`; measurement uses the combined root bounds for each item. To expose the complete collection to assistive technology, business rows can supply `aria-setsize` and `aria-posinset` using the actual data.

When a row component replaces its single DOM root, the list measures the new element and uses its height to position subsequent rows.

A virtual row can contain multiple component roots alongside elements from the item slot. The list updates the row height and scroll position when a nested component adds or removes roots. If a previously measured row becomes empty while the list is visible, its height is recorded as zero. Restoring elements measures the row again. The list remeasures spacing when a row root’s class or inline style changes or when a DOM ancestor’s theme class changes. Moving the list to a new container updates which ancestors it observes. A media query or external stylesheet can still change spacing without changing these attributes, leaving the cached height stale. In that case, wrap the row in a single element appropriate to the list semantics and include the spacing inside its measured height.

Server rendering currently fails when the same node combines `v-for` and `v-memo` inside the `default`, `header`, `footer`, `empty` or `item` slot. Data mode is affected with or without virtualization. Temporarily remove `v-memo` from that node. All five slots support the following workaround. Render a single-root child component in the slot and place `v-for`, a stable `:key`, and `v-memo` inside the child’s own template. For virtual items, the child’s root element also carries the row index. Include editable display values in the memo dependencies so that reordering after an edit preserves the updated value.

### List Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data | Data consumed by item slot | unknown[] | undefined |
| size | Implemented sizes only; xs/xl are not supported | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | md |
| bordered | Outer border | boolean | true |
| split | Item/header/footer separators, independent of border | boolean | true |
| loading | Initial loading/refresh feedback, not pagination state | boolean | false |
| max-height | Maximum ordinary viewport height; number in px or CSS length, zero means unlimited | number \| string | 0 |
| virtual-list-props | Data virtualization; ignored when default slot exists | ListVirtualListProps | undefined |
| scrollbar | Ordinary viewport custom scrollbar; false uses native scrolling | boolean \| ListScrollbarProps | true |

Virtual lists use a dedicated viewport without nesting a custom scrollbar. virtualListProps.height overrides maxHeight; with neither, height defaults to 200px. Numeric and unit-bearing CSS lengths are accepted. Invalid/nonpositive max-height does not constrain height.

ListVirtualListProps supports height, threshold, fixedSize, estimatedSize, buffer, itemKey and component. List.data supplies data. Counts at or below threshold render all items. Variable heights use measurements and estimatedSize; buffer controls overscan rows.

ListScrollbarProps supports type: 'track'|'embed', outerClass, outerStyle, hide, disableHorizontal and disableVertical. JavaScript object fields use camelCase.

### List Events / Methods

- scroll(event: Event): one notification per real scroll event.
- scrollIntoView({ index?, key?, align }): virtual-list positioning. index overrides key; align is top/bottom/auto. auto does nothing for a fully visible item, otherwise scrolls the minimum distance required. Invalid targets or nonvirtual mode do nothing.

### List Slots

List slots: default (overrides data), item({ item, index }), header, footer, empty. Empty state appears only without a default slot/data and while not loading. ListItem prefix/default/suffix retain list-item semantics without managing buttons/business interactions.

## Types

ListProps、ListSize、ListVirtualListProps、ListScrollbarProps、ListExpose、ListSlots、ListEmits、ListInstance、ListItemInstance。

List handles display and an optional virtual viewport. Compose InfiniteScroll status/target behavior for pagination rather than duplicating its loading state machine inside List.

# LoadingBar

CSS motion variables control progress-bar and fade transitions. Completion and cleanup wait for the visual transition; CSS styling does not control progress-update timing.

The service uses --mp-loading-bar-transition-duration (250ms) and --mp-loading-bar-transition-timing-function (ease) for width/opacity/background-color. Apply tokens to its real html/body ancestor, not a business card. Reduce disables transitions, not progress/cleanup. After DOM flush, hiding waits max(300ms, resolved width duration+delay); unmounting waits max(250ms, resolved opacity duration+delay). The 200ms show/tick and cleanup floors are scheduling policies, not CSS tokens; later arbitrary CSS changes/custom animation are not promised.

Repeated finish is deduplicated; start/error cancel obsolete tasks. Completion unmounts the service and the next load remounts. setDefaultOptions replaces the full configuration and resetDefaultOptions clears owned settings. SSR calls create no DOM/timers.

### Intro

Display loading progress at the top of the page.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

Example source: src/loading-bar/example/demos/en-US/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { LoadingBar } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const hasCustomStyle = ref(false)

LoadingBar.setDefaultOptions({
  top: '54px',
})

function setStyle() {
  if (hasCustomStyle.value) {
    LoadingBar.resetDefaultOptions()
  } else {
    LoadingBar.setDefaultOptions({
      top: '54px',
      errorColor: '#ff8800',
      color: '#10afef',
      height: '5px',
    })
  }

  hasCustomStyle.value = !hasCustomStyle.value
}
</script>

<template>
  <h3>Basic usage</h3>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="['3vmin', '4vmin']">
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="LoadingBar.start()">Start</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="LoadingBar.finish()">Finish</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="LoadingBar.error()">Error</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="setStyle">{{ hasCustomStyle ? 'Clear style' : 'Set style' }}</mp-button>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

The loading bar grows from the document's inline start. Direction changes do not alter timers, progress or completion. Programmatic calls use document direction.

## Usage notes

### Configuration

Repeated finish deduplicates; start/error cancel old tasks. Completion unmounts the service; the next call remounts it. setDefaultOptions replaces the entire config; resetDefaultOptions clears all options. SSR creates no DOM/timers.

After Teleport, theme variables follow actual DOM ancestors. Variables inside content do not propagate upward to service-created containers.

When importing on demand, also import `@maple-design/ui-vue/loading-bar/style`, or use the full stylesheet `@maple-design/ui-vue/style`.

## API

### LoadingBar Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| --------------------- | ---------- | -- | --------- |
| `LoadingBar.start` | Start loading | `-` | `-` |
| `LoadingBar.finish` | Finish loading | `-` | `-` |
| `LoadingBar.error` | Loading error | `-` | `-` |
| `LoadingBar.setDefaultOptions` | Set default option configuration | _options: LoadingBarOptions_ | `-` |
| `LoadingBar.resetDefaultOptions` | Reset default option configuration | _-_ | `-` |

### LoadingBar Options

Use `LoadingBarOptions` for service configuration; `LoadingBarProps` describes internal view props and does not include `finishDelay`.

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------- | -------------- | ----------- | -------- |
| `color` | LoadingBar color | _string_ | `-` |
| `errorColor` | LoadingBar error color | _string_ | `-` |
| `height` | LoadingBar height | _string \| number_ | `-` |
| `top` | LoadingBar top | _string \| number_ | `-` |
| `finishDelay` ***3.3.13*** | The delay time of the finish function, which can be used to increase the duration of loading animation | _number_ | `-` |

## CSS Variables

Ordinary/error progress bars use readable content-brand/content-danger rather than action/status fills, keeping thin lines visible on ordinary surfaces. color/errorColor override defaults. Recheck custom background/color contrast. Height remains 3px.

Motion variables control width/opacity/background-color; reduce disables transitions. Finishing waits max(300ms, computed width duration+delay) before hiding, then max(250ms, opacity duration+delay) before unmounting. Long overrides are not truncated at 250ms; explicit zero retains cleanup floors. 200ms display/progress ticks are scheduling policy, not CSS tokens. Timing is sampled after DOM updates at each phase, without guaranteeing arbitrary mid-wait CSS changes/custom animations.

Use these variables to customize the component. Defaults may vary by the selector condition shown. Each variable applies to the corresponding size, variant and interaction states.

<div class="token-reference-table" style="max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;">

| Variable | Default / condition | Affected styles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--mp-loading-bar-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-action-primary)` | `background-color` |
| `--mp-loading-bar-error-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-content-danger)` | `background-color` |
| `--mp-loading-bar-height` | `3px` | `height` |
| `--mp-loading-bar-transition-duration` | `250ms` | `transition` |
| `--mp-loading-bar-transition-timing-function` | `ease` | `transition` |

</div>

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css

  --mp-loading-bar-color: var(--mp-sys-color-action-primary);

```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

## Content and presentation

### Loading Directive

The two directive examples keep independent loading states. Their controls and host cards are stacked using Space's `direction="column"`; turning one off leaves the other overlay unchanged.


`v-mp-loading` accepts a boolean shorthand or a `{ loading, tip, type, size, radius, color, hideIcon, fullscreen, background }` options object. In object form, `loading` controls the loading state and the remaining component options match `Loading` props.

#### Registration

`v-mp-loading` renders its indicator with Maple's built-in `Loading` component. The `mp-` prefix avoids collisions with directives from other component libraries. Register it using any one of these approaches.


With `MapleResolver()`, `unplugin-vue-components` resolves `v-mp-loading` automatically. Set `directives: false` to disable directive resolution.

> Wrapper mode applies `opacity: 0.38` to its default-slot content. Because the directive preserves the host DOM, it inserts the built-in Loading VNode and uses an equivalent translucent background overlay instead.

Example source: src/loading/example/demos/directive.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const loading = ref(false)
const simpleDirectiveLoading = ref(false)
const configuredDirectiveLoading = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column">
    <h4 class="loading-demo__title">简单用法</h4>
    <mp-switch v-model="simpleDirectiveLoading" edit-mode="direct" />
    <mp-card
      v-mp-loading="simpleDirectiveLoading"
      title="介绍"
      description="v-mp-loading 会在当前容器内渲染 Loading 遮罩，不会改变内容结构。"
    />

    <h4 class="loading-demo__title">复杂配置</h4>
    <mp-switch v-model="configuredDirectiveLoading" edit-mode="direct" />
    <mp-card
      v-mp-loading="{
        loading: configuredDirectiveLoading,
        tip: '加载中...',
        color: 'var(--mp-color-primary)',
        background: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--mp-color-bg-white) 72%, transparent)',
      }"
      title="介绍"
      description="v-mp-loading 会在当前容器内渲染 Loading 遮罩，不会改变内容结构。"
    />
  </mp-space>
</template>

<style>
.loading-demo .mp-space {
  padding: 8px 0;
}

.loading-demo__title {
  margin: 12px 0 4px;
  font-size: 14px;
}
</style>
```

## Usage notes

### Icons and status messages

A numeric `size` sets the custom indicator container's font size in pixels. Named sizes control built-in animations. Custom icons inherit the `--mp-loading-indicator-size` font size (20px by default): `1em` children scale with it, while SVGs with fixed pixel dimensions keep their own size. Use the `icon` slot for graphics and `tip` or its slot for status text.

Standalone Loading has `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-atomic="true"`. Without a tip it includes localized visually hidden status text, even when the icon is hidden. Wrapper mode retains `aria-busy`. The directive sets `aria-busy="true"` on the original host and restores its previous value on cleanup, preserving a later external change.

Assistive technology may defer announcements within a busy region. For business start, completion or failure messages, maintain a persistent status region outside the busy region and update its text. The overlay does not disable keyboard interaction. See [WAI-ARIA `aria-busy`](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#aria-busy) and [ARIA22 status messages](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Techniques/aria/ARIA22).
### Configuration

The loading-directive mask prevents default click behavior and propagation. Clicking it does not activate Card or ordinary parent click handlers. Normal clicking resumes after loading. It does not disable keyboard access to underlying controls; set those controls’ `disabled` props to block all interaction.

### Overlay styles

Content-overlay class: `.mp-loading__content-overlay`.

Each directive update replaces the complete configuration; omitted options and boolean `true` use defaults. Changing `fullscreen` while loading moves the overlay between the host and its owner document body. Host children stay in place. Multiple `fullscreen` instances share a counted scroll lock: closing a local instance does not unlock `fullscreen` instances, and the final `fullscreen` instance preserves an existing external lock class.

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------ | -------- |
| `color` | Loading color | _string_ | `-` |
| `type` | Can be set to `circle` `wave` `cube` `rect` `disappear` | _string_ | `circle` |
| `size` | Can be set to `xs` `sm` `md` `lg` `xl`, or a number | _string \| number_ | `md` |
| `tip` | Tip of the loading | _string_ | `-` |
| `loading` | Specify whether loading is active | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `radius` | Set radius size when the `type` is `circle` | _string \| number_ | `-` |

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ---- |
| `default` | Content wrapped in `loading` | `-` |
| `tip` | Tip of the `loading` | `-` |
| `icon` | Custom loading indicator | `-` |

The `icon` slot replaces every built-in `type` animation instead of rendering alongside it. `hide-icon=true` hides all indicators while allowing tip content to remain visible.

# LocaleProvider

Set locale and messages for a subtree without changing the rest of the page.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Example source: src/locale-provider/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const custom = ref(false)
const messages = {
  'zh-CN': { emptyDescription: '暂无数据' },
  'en-US': { emptyDescription: 'No data' },
}
const activeMessages = computed(() =>
  custom.value
    ? {
        'zh-CN': { emptyDescription: '自定义暂无数据' },
        'en-US': { emptyDescription: 'Custom no data' },
      }
    : messages,
)
</script>

<template>
  <mp-checkbox v-model="custom">自定义语言包 / Custom messages</mp-checkbox>
  <mp-locale-provider locale="zh-CN" :messages="activeMessages">
    <mp-empty />
  </mp-locale-provider>
  <mp-locale-provider locale="en-US" :messages="activeMessages">
    <mp-empty />
  </mp-locale-provider>
</template>
```

## API

### LocaleProvider Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------- | --------------- | -------------------------- | --------- |
| `locale` | Current locale | _string_ | `zh-CN` |
| `messages` | Language messages | _`Record<string, Partial<Message>>`_ | `-` |
| `dir` | Reading direction; inherits when omitted | _'ltr' \| 'rtl'_ | `-` |
| `tag` | Custom tag name | _string_ | `div` |

### LocaleProvider Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | Component content | `-` |


## Reading direction

`<mp-locale-provider dir="rtl">` supplies a reading-direction scope independently of locale. Omit dir to inherit; nested `dir="ltr"` and native DOM dir containers provide local overrides. Popup content retains the source scope after teleporting. Physical left/right API values and media content keep their original semantics.

### Language fallback and scope

`messages` maps language names to packs, and `locale` must match a pack in the current scope. Each key resolves to its own value in the selected local pack, then the nearest parent LocaleProvider, then the current global Locale. Missing packs or keys and `null`/`undefined` fall through; explicit empty strings are preserved. `Message` contains text and dictionaries such as calendar months and weekdays, so it is not a plain string map. Import `Message` from `@maple-design/ui-vue/locale`.

Setting only `dir` preserves messages; nested local packs can override individual keys. Components inherit their calling scope through Vue injection, including across Teleport. Function services that create separate applications do not automatically inherit a page LocaleProvider; use the service context/configuration entry or global Locale. This component has no dedicated events or instance methods.

Internal custom properties and measurement values are implementation details and are not customization APIs.

# Locale

### Intro

Component library uses Chinese as the default language, support multi-language switch.

### Multi-language Switch (Functional)

`Locale.add` is used for language mounted.

```js
// playground-ignore
import { Locale } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

Locale.add('en-US', Locale.enUS)
```

Use `Locale.merge` to override languages.

```js
// playground-ignore
Locale.merge('en-US', {
  dialogTitle: 'Hello'
})
```

Use `Locale.use` to switch language.

```js
// playground-ignore
Locale.use('en-US')
```

### Multi-language Switch (Component declarative)

```html
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { Locale } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const date = ref('2021-04-08')
const locale = ref('zh-CN')
const messages = {
  'zh-CN': Locale.zhCN,
  'en-US': Locale.enUS
}

function switchLocale() {
  locale.value = locale.value === 'zh-CN' ? 'en-US' : 'zh-CN'
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-locale-provider :locale="locale" :messages="messages">
    <mp-date-picker v-model="date" />
    <mp-button status="primary" @click="switchLocale">Switch</mp-button>
  </mp-locale-provider>
</template>
```

### Notes

- `Locale.use` operates on a singleton language instance context. Do not call it on the server. It is recommended for client-side rendering scenarios.
- `LocaleProvider` is only valid for the sub-components it wraps, and is invalid for functional calls to components. It is recommended for server-side rendering scenarios.

### Currently Supported Languages

| Language Name | Language Code | Language Pack | Supported Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Chinese` | zh-CN | _Locale.zhCN_ | `v2.0.0` |
| `English` | en-US | _Locale.enUS_ | `v2.0.0` |
| `Traditional Chinese (TW)` | zh-TW | _Locale.zhTW_ | `v2.17.0` |
| `Traditional Chinese (HK)` | zh-HK | _Locale.zhHK_ | `v2.17.0` |
| `Farsi` | fa-IR | _Locale.faIR_ | `v2.22.0` |
| `Japanese` | ja-JP | _Locale.jaJP_ | `v3.9.0` |

## Basic examples

### Local language comparison

Example source: src/locale-provider/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const custom = ref(false)
const messages = {
  'zh-CN': { emptyDescription: '暂无数据' },
  'en-US': { emptyDescription: 'No data' },
}
const activeMessages = computed(() =>
  custom.value
    ? {
        'zh-CN': { emptyDescription: '自定义暂无数据' },
        'en-US': { emptyDescription: 'Custom no data' },
      }
    : messages,
)
</script>

<template>
  <mp-checkbox v-model="custom">自定义语言包 / Custom messages</mp-checkbox>
  <mp-locale-provider locale="zh-CN" :messages="activeMessages">
    <mp-empty />
  </mp-locale-provider>
  <mp-locale-provider locale="en-US" :messages="activeMessages">
    <mp-empty />
  </mp-locale-provider>
</template>
```

## API

### LocaleProvider Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------- | --------------- | -------------------------- | --------- |
| `locale` | Current locale | _string_ | `zh-CN` |
| `messages` | Language messages | _Record<string, Record<string, string>>_ | `-` |
| `tag` | Custom tag name | _string_ | `div` |

### LocaleProvider Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | Component content | `-` |

### Global and independent instances

The root `Locale` is a global singleton with only `zh-CN` registered and active by default. Add another built-in language with `Locale.add` before selecting it with `Locale.use`. Japanese is available as `Locale.jaJP`; the `locale` entry has no separate named `jaJP` export. `Locale.useLocale()` (or the named `useLocale` export from `@maple-design/ui-vue/locale`) creates an independent instance; it differs from Cedar's global language-switching function of the same name.

`add(lang, message)` writes `lang` to the supplied object. After replacing the current language's data, call `use` again to update the current reference. `merge(lang, partial)` shallow-merges and selects that language. `t` looks up a complete key, returns `undefined` for missing keys, and does not provide generic interpolation or nested-path lookup. Changing language does not automatically change reading direction.

# Mention

Text input with mention suggestions supplied by the application.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Example source: src/mention/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" size="lg" style="width: 100%">
    <mp-mention v-model="value" :options="['Bytedance', 'Bytedesign', 'Bytenumner']" placeholder="enter something" />
    <mp-mention
      v-model="text"
      :options="['Bytedance', 'Bytedesign', 'Bytenumner']"
      type="textarea"
      placeholder="enter something"
    />
  </mp-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('')
const text = ref('')
</script>
```

### Atomic mentions and display fallback

With `atomic`, selected mentions are edited and deleted as units. The model stores identity as `@[encoded ID]`. Supply unresolved names synchronously through `fallback-option`; the component does not request display data. Atomic values support strings, finite numbers and booleans with their types preserved; object values are unsupported. Literal `@[` and backslashes are escaped. `atomic` is off by default, so existing plain text is not automatically reinterpreted.

For example, string ID `shuai.meng` is stored as `@[shuai.meng]`; numeric `0` is `@[!n:0]`, distinct from string `@[0]`. A non-`@` prefix is encoded as well: a `##` mention of `topic` is `@[%23%23|topic]`. Labels resolve from current options, then `fallback-option`, then the component's selected-item cache, and finally the original value. The per-instance cache is shared by editing and read-pretty presentations, and entries are removed when mentions are removed. Applications must still supply names for unresolved initial values and own data requests and persistent storage.

Local candidates are matched case-insensitively against both `value` and `label`. For example, typing `@xiaoming` or `@小明` finds the same candidate; choosing it displays `@小明` and stores `@[xiaoming]`. In atomic mode, when there are no candidates, Enter also creates a mention if `fallback-option` returns an object for the typed ID. Unconfirmed text is not converted. Remote loaders receive the query and their results are not filtered again locally. During requests the field and suggestion dropdown show loading feedback; stale responses cannot replace the latest results.

Example source: src/mention/example/demos/atomic-mention.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from 'vue'

const content = ref('请联系 @[shuai.meng] 跟进')
const fallbackContent = ref('')
const people = [{ value: 'xiaoming', label: '小明' }]
const names = reactive<Record<string, string>>({ 'shuai.meng': '孟帅', xiaoming: '小明' })
const fallbackOption = (value: string | number | boolean) => ({ value, label: names[String(value)] ?? String(value) })
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%" :size="12">
    <p>
      输入 @ 选择人员；在提及旁按 Backspace 可整体删除。 / Type @ to select a person; Backspace removes a whole mention.
    </p>
    <mp-mention
      v-model="content"
      atomic
      type="textarea"
      :options="people"
      :fallback-option="fallbackOption"
      aria-label="原子提及 / Atomic mentions"
    />
    <mp-button @click="names['shuai.meng'] = '孟帅（已更新）'">模拟更新姓名 / Update mock name</mp-button>
    <pre>{{ content }}</pre>
    <p>
      无候选项时输入 @xiaoming 并按回车，通过 fallback 解析姓名。 / Without options, type @xiaoming and press Enter to
      resolve the name.
    </p>
    <mp-mention
      v-model="fallbackContent"
      atomic
      :options="[]"
      :fallback-option="fallbackOption"
      aria-label="仅回退 / Fallback only"
    />
    <pre>{{ fallbackContent }}</pre>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

After confirming a mention, a space is added unless whitespace already follows; the space is part of the saved value. Mention text uses the primary brand foreground without a background.

## Data and options

### Filtering and async search

With a local array, type `@小` or `@xiaoming` to match a name or ID. The async example passes the query to application code and shows loading in the dropdown. Quickly change `@xi` to `@lisi` to see only the latest result. It uses mock data; a real loader can pass `signal` to `fetch`.

Example source: src/mention/example/demos/search-options.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { OptionsLoader } from '../../../_hooks/use-option-request'

const localValue = ref('')
const remoteValue = ref('')
const autoValue = ref('')
const people = [
  { value: 'xiaoming', label: '小明' },
  { value: 'xiaohong', label: '小红' },
  { value: 'lisi', label: '李四' },
]

// 实际业务可以在这里调用接口，并将 signal 传给 fetch。
const searchPeople: OptionsLoader<(typeof people)[number]> = (query, { signal }) =>
  new Promise((resolve) => {
    const finish = () => {
      signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel)
      const keyword = query.toLowerCase()
      resolve(people.filter((person) => person.value.includes(keyword) || person.label.includes(query)))
    }
    // 模拟不同网络耗时，方便快速改词时观察 loading 和最新结果。
    const timer = setTimeout(finish, query.toLowerCase().startsWith('x') ? 1400 : 450)
    const cancel = () => {
      clearTimeout(timer)
      resolve([])
    }
    if (signal.aborted) {
      cancel()
    } else {
      signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true })
    }
  })
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%" :size="12" data-demo="mention-search-options">
    <p>本地候选按账号或姓名筛选；异步搜索时可快速从 @xi 改为 @lisi，观察下拉加载和最新结果。</p>
    <p>
      Local options match ID or name. For remote search, quickly change @xi to @lisi to see loading and the latest
      results.
    </p>
    <mp-mention v-model="localValue" atomic :options="people" aria-label="本地人员搜索 / Local people search" />
    <mp-mention
      v-model="remoteValue"
      atomic
      :options="searchPeople"
      :min-search-length="2"
      aria-label="异步人员搜索 / Remote people search"
    />
    <p>唯一候选自动提交 / Automatically commit the only matching candidate.</p>
    <mp-mention
      v-model="autoValue"
      atomic
      :options="searchPeople"
      :min-search-length="2"
      :search-delay="250"
      auto-commit-single
      aria-label="唯一结果自动提交 / Commit single result"
    />
    <div>
      本地保存值 / Local value：<code data-local-value>{{ localValue }}</code>
    </div>
    <div>
      异步保存值 / Remote value：<code data-remote-value>{{ remoteValue }}</code>
    </div>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Async search and read-pretty display

Type `@xiaoming` and select the person, then search for `@lisi`. The selected name remains visible in read-pretty mode and when returning to the editor; the model retains its ID. This example uses a mock request for candidates and `fallback-option` for the initial ID.

Example source: src/mention/example/demos/async-read-pretty.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const content = ref('请联系 @[shuai.meng]')
const readPretty = ref(false)
const people = [
  { value: 'xiaoming', label: '小明' },
  { value: 'lisi', label: '李四' },
]

// 初始化 ID 的名称由业务提供；搜索并选中的名称由组件在当前实例中缓存。
const fallbackOption = (value: string | number | boolean) =>
  value === 'shuai.meng' ? { value, label: '孟帅' } : undefined

const searchPeople = (query: string, { signal }: { signal: AbortSignal }) =>
  new Promise<typeof people>((resolve) => {
    const finish = () => {
      signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel)
      const keyword = query.toLowerCase()
      resolve(people.filter((person) => person.value.includes(keyword) || person.label.includes(query)))
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(finish, 500)
    const cancel = () => {
      clearTimeout(timer)
      resolve([])
    }
    if (signal.aborted) {
      cancel()
    } else {
      signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true })
    }
  })
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%" :size="12" data-demo="async-read-pretty">
    <p>
      输入 @xiaoming 并选择小明，再输入 @lisi 搜索其他人员，然后切换阅读态查看反显。 / Select @xiaoming, search @lisi,
      then switch to reading mode.
    </p>
    <mp-mention
      v-model="content"
      atomic
      type="textarea"
      :options="searchPeople"
      :fallback-option="fallbackOption"
      :read-pretty="readPretty"
      aria-label="异步人员提及"
    />
    <mp-button @click="readPretty = !readPretty">{{
      readPretty ? '切换到编辑态 / Edit' : '切换到阅读态 / Read'
    }}</mp-button>
    <div>
      保存值 / Model：<code data-mention-model>{{ content }}</code>
    </div>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Restore saved values asynchronously

This example simulates saving the model in memory, remounts the component, then loads names asynchronously. IDs appear while loading; the synchronous `fallback-option` resolves names when data arrives without changing the saved value. Applications own persistence and fetching display data by ID.

Example source: src/mention/example/demos/async-fallback-restore.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue'

const content = ref('请联系 @[shuai.meng]、@[xiaoming]、@[lisi]')
const saved = ref(content.value)
const names = ref<Record<string, string>>({ 'shuai.meng': '孟帅', xiaoming: '小明', lisi: '李四' })
const generation = ref(0)
const readPretty = ref(false)
const loading = ref(false)
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined

// fallback 只同步读取业务数据，未找到时返回 undefined。
const fallbackOption = (value: string | number | boolean) => {
  const label = names.value[String(value)]
  return label === undefined ? undefined : { value, label }
}

function saveAndReload() {
  // 用内存模拟数据库保存；实际业务应保存 content.value，再按 ID 请求姓名。
  saved.value = content.value
  if (timer) {
    clearTimeout(timer)
  }
  names.value = {}
  content.value = saved.value
  generation.value++ // 重新挂载组件，模拟打开已保存的数据。
  loading.value = true
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    names.value = { 'shuai.meng': '孟帅', xiaoming: '小明', lisi: '李四' }
    loading.value = false
  }, 1500)
}

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  if (timer) {
    clearTimeout(timer)
  }
})
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%" :size="12" data-demo="mention-async-fallback-restore">
    <p>
      模拟保存后重新初始化：请求期间先显示 ID，姓名返回后自动更新。 / Save and reload to resolve names asynchronously.
    </p>
    <mp-mention
      :key="generation"
      v-model="content"
      atomic
      type="textarea"
      :options="[]"
      :fallback-option="fallbackOption"
      :read-pretty="readPretty"
      aria-label="重新初始化的人员提及"
    />
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button @click="saveAndReload">模拟保存并重新加载 / Save and reload</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="readPretty = !readPretty">{{
        readPretty ? '切换到编辑态 / Edit' : '切换到阅读态 / Read'
      }}</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <div role="status">{{ loading ? '正在加载姓名… / Loading names…' : '姓名已加载 / Names loaded' }}</div>
    <div>
      模拟保存值 / Saved value：<code data-saved-value>{{ saved }}</code>
    </div>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Lifecycle and edge cases

### Mirror Lifecycle

Example source: src/mention/example/demos/mirror-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref(true)
const mounted = ref(true)
const disabled = ref(false)
const searches = ref(0)
const value = ref('第一行\n第二行\n第三行\n@al')
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <mp-button html-type="button" @click="active = !active">切换 KeepAlive</mp-button>
    <mp-button html-type="button" @click="mounted = !mounted">卸载／挂载</mp-button>
    <mp-button html-type="button" @click="disabled = !disabled">切换禁用</mp-button>
    <p>搜索通知：{{ searches }}。在文本域滚动后输入 @al，停用再激活，继续输入检查镜像定位。</p>
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <mp-mention
        v-if="active"
        v-model="value"
        type="textarea"
        :disabled="disabled"
        :options="['alice', 'alex']"
        :rows="3"
        @search="searches++"
      />
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Loading and waiting

### Controlled loading

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | Explicit business loading state | `boolean` | `false` |


Set loading explicitly to display feedback. Ordinary event return values do not drive loading. Before hooks retain their documented pending behavior.

Example source: src/mention/example/demos/loading.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue'
import type { OptionsLoader } from '../../../_hooks/use-option-request'

const loading = ref(true)
const requests = new Set<(failed?: boolean) => void>()
const pending = ref(0)
const status = ref('等待数据 / Waiting for data')
const load: OptionsLoader<string> = (query, { signal }) =>
  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const finish = (failed = false) => {
      requests.delete(finish)
      pending.value = requests.size
      signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel)
      if (failed) {
        reject(new Error('Candidate request failed'))
      } else {
        resolve(['Alice', 'Bob'].filter((name) => name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())))
      }
    }
    const cancel = () => finish()
    requests.add(finish)
    pending.value = requests.size
    signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true })
  })
function settle(failed = false) {
  status.value = failed ? '请求失败，可继续输入重试 / Failed; type to retry' : '数据已返回 / Data received'
  ;[...requests].forEach((finish) => finish(failed))
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => settle())
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%" :size="16">
    <h4>业务控制 / Manual loading</h4>
    <mp-switch v-model="loading" aria-label="业务加载状态 / Manual loading" />
    <mp-mention
      edit-mode="direct"
      :loading="loading"
      :options="['Alice', 'Bob']"
      placeholder="单行输入 @ / Single line"
    />
    <mp-mention
      edit-mode="direct"
      type="textarea"
      :loading="loading"
      :options="['Alice', 'Bob']"
      placeholder="多行输入 @ / Multiple lines"
    />
    <p>
      loading 只控制显示，两种输入框均可继续编辑。普通事件返回 Promise 不会触发等待。Loading does not disable editing or
      await notification handlers.
    </p>
    <h4>数据源等待 / Remote candidates</h4>
    <mp-mention
      edit-mode="direct"
      :options="load"
      placeholder="输入 @a，手动返回候选数据 / Type @a"
      @load-error="() => {}"
    />
    <mp-space>
      <mp-button :disabled="!pending" @click="settle()">返回数据 / Resolve</mp-button>
      <mp-button :disabled="!pending" @click="settle(true)">模拟失败 / Reject</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <p role="status">{{ pending ? '请求中，仍可输入 / Pending; editing remains available' : status }}</p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](en/guide/empty-values).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Mention Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value (v-model) | Controlled text; null displays as empty | string \| null | undefined |
| atomic | Enable encoded, indivisible mentions | boolean | false |
| fallback-option | Synchronously resolve an unmatched ID for display | `(value: string \| number \| boolean) => SelectOptionData \| null \| undefined` | undefined |
| default-value | Initial uncontrolled text | string | '' |
| options | Candidate array or explicit loader, including nested groups | readonly (string \| number \| SelectOptionData \| SelectOptionGroup)[] \| ((query: string, context: { signal: AbortSignal }) => Array \| `Promise<Array>`) | undefined |
| min-search-length | Minimum number of characters required to start searching | number | 0 |
| search-delay | Remote search debounce delay in milliseconds | number | 0 |
| auto-commit-single | Automatically commit the sole enabled result | boolean | false |
| prefix | Trigger prefix; supports multiple characters and multiple prefixes | string \| string[] | '@' |
| split | Separator before and after a mention | string | ' ' |
| type | Input presentation | input \| textarea | input |
| disabled | Inherit Form when omitted; explicit false overrides it | boolean | undefined |
| readonly | Inherit Form when omitted; explicit false overrides it | boolean | undefined |
| clearable | Allow clearing text or the editor draft | boolean | false |
| loading | Manual waiting feedback; does not implicitly disable text editing | boolean | false |
| edit-mode | Editing mode, inherited from FormItem and Form | `'direct' \| 'popup'` | `'direct'` |
| read-pretty | Independent read presentation; explicit false overrides the parent | `boolean` | `false` |
| empty-value | Clear output; explicit null is submitted unchanged | `string \| null \| (() => string \| null)` | `''` |
| empty-values | Empty-value recognition; field takes precedence over FormItem and Form | `readonly unknown[]` | `-` |
| empty-text | Read empty text; an explicit empty string is valid | `string` | `'-'` |
| before-commit | Guard before saving a deferred edit; return a boolean or Promise, or complete via done | `(payload: { value: unknown; previousValue: unknown }, done: (allow?: boolean) => void, context: { signal: AbortSignal; event?: Event }) => void \| boolean \| Promise<void \| boolean>` | `-` |
| open | Controlled editor visibility, separate from native input focus | `boolean` | `-` |
| default-open | Initial visibility of an uncontrolled editor | `boolean` | `false` |
| popup-container | Editor mount container | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `-` |

### Mention Events

| Event | Description and arguments |
| --- | --- |
| update:modelValue | value: string \| null |
| change | value: string \| null; no native Event argument |
| search | query: string, prefix: string |
| select | value: SelectOptionValue \| undefined; from the actual leaf candidate |
| clear | event: Event |
| focus / blur | event: FocusEvent |
| load-error | error: unknown; preserves the original loader error |
| update:open / open-change | open: boolean; field editor only |

options is an explicit loader. search, change, select and load-error only notify; listener Promises are not collected. Direct input emits update:modelValue / change, and selection emits select / update:modelValue / change. Deferred editing updates a draft and submits the final model on confirmation.

### Mention Methods

| Method | Description | Returns |
| --- | --- | --- |
| focus | Focus the current target; deferred mode follows the field editing protocol | void |
| blur | Blur the current target without opening the editor | void |
| refresh | Retry the current options query with cancellation and failure handling, without opening the editor; static arrays issue no request | `Promise<void>` |

### Mention Slots

| Slot | Description and arguments |
| --- | --- |
| option | Candidates in both input presentations; data: SelectOptionInfo, including key, raw, value and label |
| read | Reading content in both input presentations; value: string \| null, text: string |
| prefix / suffix | Input prefix and suffix for type=input only |
| clear-icon | Clear node in both input presentations; clear(event?: Event): void |

clear-icon replaces the entire clear node. A custom node must call clear and provide an accessible button. There is no default input replacement, empty or loader-error slot; option does not replace the field input.

## Types

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { MentionProps, MentionInstance, MentionEmits, MentionSlots, MentionExpose } from "@maple-design/ui-vue";
```

Mention reuses Input/Textarea typography and spacing; its measurement mirror copies computed native input styles. Override the corresponding input variables. 

### Editing and confirmation

Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

The `options` prop accepts an array or `(query, { signal }) => array/Promise`. The component manages loading, cancellation and stale-result isolation; failures emit load-error. Single/multiple groups initialize with an empty-string query, searchable fields reload when the query changes, and root loading for tree fields remains independent of existing load-more child loading.

Both input and textarea show manual loading and waiting for the current explicit options loader. Displaying waiting does not disable editing. A search notification's returned Promise does not start a task. An old options request cannot clear a newer request's indicator, and load-error preserves the original error.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

### Mention ranges and grouped options

prefix accepts single characters, multiple characters and arrays of strings. Selection replaces only the matched prefix and query before the caret, preserving the trailing text; the textarea mirror uses the matched prefix. Nested option groups render nonselectable titles and only leaves may be selected; disabled leaves do not submit. The option slot receives normalized candidates, including the valid identities zero and empty string.

### Candidate feedback and instance boundaries

Explicit options loading appears in the current Input/Textarea field, whose native input announces aria-busy. Manual loading combines with request loading and text remains editable. With no available candidates the mention menu stays closed. Failure ends current waiting and emits the original load-error; business code chooses error presentation. Error strings are not inserted into candidates or text. refresh waits for one read attempt; failures notify through load-error without awaiting error-listener Promises.

disabled/readonly pause requests; deactivation, unmount and stale responses cannot update data. refresh may read while the field editor is closed without opening it. The candidate menu belongs to the internal input; public open/default-open controls only the deferred field editor. MentionProps, MentionEmits, MentionSlots and MentionExpose are exported consistently from root and mention subentries; MeasureInfo remains internal measurement state.

Mention is available in both Cedar and Maple.

### Input and candidate relationships

input uses combobox, while textarea retains a multiline textbox. Both link to the actual listbox and active candidate with aria-autocomplete, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant. Closing suggestions or making the field readonly removes active references; arrow navigation keeps DOM focus in the native input.

Follow-up acceptance testing (not yet completed): use real screen readers, such as VoiceOver and NVDA, with supported browsers to verify spoken names when atomic mentions are initialized, suggestion navigation and selection, editing, and deletion of an entire mention.

<!-- Source: src/menu/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/menu -->

# Menu

Collects transient commands for the current object, such as overflow actions, context menus and the extra actions of a button. Use [Select](#/en-US/select) to pick form data and [Cascader](#/en-US/cascader) to pick hierarchical data.

Use `placement` to choose the popup direction, defaulting to `bottom`; `cover` controls overlap with the trigger. Use `auto-fit-popup-width` to match trigger width and `popup-max-height` to limit menu height.

## Basic examples

### Overflow Actions

Pass the trigger element through the default slot and describe commands with `options`. `type: 'divider'` renders a separator.

Example source: src/menu/example/demos/overflow-actions.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { IconMore } from '@maple-design/icons-vue'

const actionOptions = computed(() => [
  { label: '编辑', value: 'edit' },
  { label: '复制', value: 'copy' },
  { type: 'divider' },
  { label: '删除', value: 'delete' },
])
</script>

<template>
  <mp-menu :options="actionOptions">
    <mp-button variant="tonal" :elevation="false" aria-label="更多操作"
      ><template #icon>
        <mp-icon><IconMore /></mp-icon></template
    ></mp-button>
  </mp-menu>
</template>

<style>
.menu-example-area {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 160px;
  background-color: var(--mp-color-fill-2);
}

.menu-example-footer {
  padding: 8px 12px;
}
</style>
```

## Options and hierarchy

### Groups, submenus and option content

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | Command tree | Groups, submenus and option content, Selection and visual emphasis |
| `hide-on-select` | Close the popup after activating a command | Selection and visual emphasis |
| `submenu-trigger` | How every submenu level expands | Selection and visual emphasis |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Compare flat groups, nested menus and option content. Expand or select options to inspect their hierarchy.

<details>
<summary>Configuration details and limits</summary>

#### Option Group

Group commands with `{ type: 'group', children }` inside `options`; no extra group component is needed. A group is purely visual and does not add a level.

#### Submenu

A plain option with `children` becomes a submenu. Every level shares `submenu-trigger`, which expands on tap by default; switching it to `'hover'` applies to all levels too. It cannot be set per option, so a single tree never mixes two expansion styles.

#### Custom Option Content

Prefer passing `icon`, `extra` or a VNode directly on the option; all three also accept a render function receiving `{ option, active, level }`. To render a whole data set uniformly, use the `option-label`, `option-icon` and `option-extra` scoped slots.

`active` means this exact option matches the active value. A active descendant does not select its parent. Descendant selection and submenu opening remain private styling state. MenuOption uses `highlight` for visual emphasis without changing selection.

</details>

Example source: src/menu/example/demos/structure-comparison.vue

### Selection and visual emphasis

`active` is false on a parent whose child is active. The three examples compare render functions, scoped slots and manual MenuOption content; `highlight` only emphasizes a row.

Example source: src/menu/example/demos/active-rendering.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { MenuRenderContext } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const selectedValue = ref('account')
const status = ({ active }: MenuRenderContext) => (active ? '当前项已选中' : '当前项未选中')
const options = [
  {
    label: '设置',
    value: 'settings',
    extra: status,
    children: [
      { label: '账户', value: 'account', extra: status },
      { label: '通知', value: 'notifications', extra: status },
    ],
  },
  { label: '帮助', value: 'help', extra: status },
]
const helpLabel = ({ active }: MenuRenderContext) => (active ? '帮助（已选中）' : '帮助（未选中，仅视觉强调）')
</script>

<template>
  <p>当前值：{{ selectedValue }}。默认选中“账户”；父分支“设置”处于选中路径，但 active=false。</p>
  <mp-space wrap>
    <mp-menu v-model="selectedValue" :options="options" :hide-on-select="false" submenu-trigger="click">
      <mp-button>渲染函数中的 active</mp-button>
    </mp-menu>
    <mp-menu v-model="selectedValue" :options="options" :hide-on-select="false" submenu-trigger="click">
      <mp-button>作用域插槽中的 active</mp-button>
      <template #option-extra="{ active }">
        <mp-tag :status="active ? 'primary' : 'default'">{{ active ? '当前项已选中' : '当前项未选中' }}</mp-tag>
      </template>
    </mp-menu>
    <mp-menu v-model="selectedValue" :hide-on-select="false">
      <mp-button>自定义子项与 highlight</mp-button>
      <template #content>
        <mp-menu-option value="account">
          <template #default="{ active }">账户：{{ active ? '已选中' : '未选中' }}</template>
        </mp-menu-option>
        <mp-menu-option value="help" :label="helpLabel" highlight />
      </template>
    </mp-menu>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Option values

Give each command a stable, unique `value` when adding, removing or reordering options. Numeric `0`, string `'0'` and boolean `false` are different values.

## Triggers and positioning

### Context Menu

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` | Root menu trigger | Context Menu, Trigger |
| `options` | Command tree | Context Menu, Positioning strategy |
| `align-point` | Align to the pointer position at activation; stays in place until the next context menu activation | Context Menu |
| `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | Placement |
| `strategy` | Positioning strategy inherited by every submenu | Positioning strategy |
| `submenu-trigger` | How every submenu level expands | Positioning strategy |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

### Positioning strategy

Both root and nested menus use the same reactive `strategy` (`absolute` by default or `fixed`). Changing it does not change selection or close the menu. `popup-container` independently controls mounting; `fixed` does not automatically escape transformed ancestors.

Example source: src/menu/example/demos/en-US/positioning.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { MenuStrategy } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const strategy = ref<MenuStrategy>('fixed')
const options = [
  {
    label: 'Actions',
    children: [
      {
        label: 'Export',
        children: [
          { label: 'CSV', value: 'csv' },
          { label: 'JSON', value: 'json' },
        ],
      },
      { label: 'Copy', value: 'copy' },
    ],
  },
]
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column">
    <mp-button @click="strategy = strategy === 'fixed' ? 'absolute' : 'fixed'">
      Toggle positioning：{{ strategy }}
    </mp-button>
    <mp-menu :strategy="strategy" :options="options" submenu-trigger="click">
      <mp-button>Open three-level menu</mp-button>
      <template #footer>
        <mp-button variant="text" @click.stop="strategy = strategy === 'fixed' ? 'absolute' : 'fixed'">
          Switch while open：{{ strategy }}
        </mp-button>
      </template>
    </mp-menu>
    <small
      >The strategy applies to every submenu. The mounting container is controlled separately by popup-container.</small
    >
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Switching triggers

Clicking another hover-open sibling trigger closes the previous menu. Clicking inside a submenu keeps its parent open.

## State and content customization

### Selected Value and Select Event

Use `v-model` to keep the active value. Activating a command emits `update:model-value` first and then `select(value, option, event)`; `select` means a menu item was activated, not that a form value changed.

Example source: src/menu/example/demos/selection.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref('edit')
const selectedLabel = ref('编辑')
const selectionOptions = computed(() => [
  { label: '编辑', value: 'edit' },
  { label: '复制', value: 'copy' },
  { label: '删除', value: 'delete' },
])
const handleSelect = (_value: unknown, option: { label?: unknown }) => {
  selectedLabel.value = String(option.label ?? '')
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column">
    <mp-menu v-model="active" :options="selectionOptions" @select="handleSelect">
      <mp-button>{{ selectedLabel || '请选择操作' }}</mp-button>
    </mp-menu>
    <span>当前值：{{ active || '-' }}，最近选择：{{ selectedLabel || '-' }}</span>
  </mp-space>
</template>

<style>
.menu-example-area {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 160px;
  background-color: var(--mp-color-fill-2);
}

.menu-example-footer {
  padding: 8px 12px;
}
</style>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Submenus expand in reading order; enter/return horizontal keys follow the current direction, while Up/Down and boundary navigation preserve order and skip disabled options. Menus mounted externally inherit the source direction. Direction changes do not change selection.

## Keyboard interaction

Enter, Space or an arrow key opens the menu from its trigger. Up/Down and Home/End move between enabled options; Enter or Space activates an option. The forward key enters a submenu and the backward key returns, following the reading direction. Escape requests closing the topmost menu; focus returns to its trigger after closing. Tab requests close and continues browser focus navigation. Editable inputs retain their text-editing keys.

## API

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the selected option value; `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once, and later changes do not reset it. Explicit binding takes precedence. Initialization emits no `update:modelValue`.

### Menu Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | Command tree | _MenuOption[]_ | `[]` |
| `field-names` | `label/value/children/disabled` field mapping | _MenuFieldNames_ | `-` |
| `v-model` | Active value | _MenuValue_ | `-` |
| `v-model:open` | Whether the popup is visible | _boolean_ | `-` |
| `default-open` | Uncontrolled default visibility | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `size` | Option size | _'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'_ | `'md'` |
| `trigger` | Root menu trigger | _'click' \| 'hover' \| 'focus' \| 'contextMenu'_ | `'click'` |
| `submenu-trigger` | How every submenu level expands | _'click' \| 'hover'_ | `'click'` |
| `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | `MenuPlacement`<br>`'top' \| 'top-start' \| 'top-end' \| 'bottom' \| 'bottom-start' \| 'bottom-end' \| 'left' \| 'left-start' \| 'left-end' \| 'right' \| 'right-start' \| 'right-end'` | `'bottom'` |
| `strategy` | Positioning strategy inherited by every submenu | _'absolute' \| 'fixed'_ | `'absolute'` |
| `reference` | External trigger element | _string \| HTMLElement_ | `-` |
| `popup-container` | Popup mount container | _string \| HTMLElement \| false_ | `-` |
| `popup-class` | Popup class name | _string \| array \| object_ | `-` |
| `popup-max-height` | Default limit, pixel height, or unlimited | _boolean \| number_ | `true` |
| `offset-x` | Horizontal offset | _string \| number_ | `0` |
| `offset-y` | Vertical offset | _string \| number_ | `0` |
| `mouse-enter-delay` | Hover open delay in ms | _number_ | `100` |
| `mouse-leave-delay` | Hover close delay in ms | _number_ | `100` |
| `close-on-click-reference` | Close when the trigger is clicked again | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `unmount-on-close` | Unmount popup content on close | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `hide-on-select` | Close the popup after activating a command | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `auto-fit-popup-width` | Match the trigger width | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `cover` | Popup covers the trigger | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `align-point` | Align to the pointer position at activation; stays in place until the next context menu activation | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `disabled` | Disable the menu | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `elevation` | Popup shadow level | _boolean \| number_ | `true` |

### Menu Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `update:model-value` | Active value update request | `value: MenuValue` |
| `select` | A menu item was activated | `value, option, event` |
| `open-change` | Visibility update request | `open: boolean` |
| `open` / `opened` | Popup starts opening / finished opening | `-` |
| `close` / `closed` | Popup starts closing / finished closing | `-` |
| `click-outside` | Clicked outside the popup | `event: Event` |
| `key-escape` | Escape was pressed | `-` |

### Menu Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | Open the popup | `-` |
| `close` | Close the popup | `-` |
| `resize` | Recalculate the popup position | `-` |
| `setReference` | Set the external trigger element | `reference?: HTMLElement` |

### Menu Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | Trigger element | `-` |
| `content` | Hand-written content, pairs with `MenuOption` | `-` |
| `footer` | Footer | `-` |
| `option-label` | Render every option's main content | `{ option, active, level }` |
| `option-icon` | Render every option's icon | `{ option, active, level }` |
| `option-extra` | Render every option's trailing content | `{ option, active, level }` |

### MenuOption Props

Kept for SplitButton and hand-written `content`. Groups and submenus are described through `options` only; there are no `MenuGroup` or `MenuSubmenu` components.

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | Main content or render function | _MenuContent_ | `-` |
| `value` | Value passed to events on activation | _any_ | `-` |
| `disabled` | Disable interaction | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `ripple` | Whether to show the click ripple | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `highlight` | Visual emphasis without changing selection | _boolean_ | `false` |

### MenuOption Events / Slots

`click` fires when the option is not disabled. The `default`, `icon` and `suffix` slots and the `label` render function receive the same `{ option, active, level }` context.

## Types

### MenuOptionData

| Field | Description | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | Plain command, group or divider | _'item' \| 'group' \| 'divider'_ |
| `label` | Main content | _VNodeChild \| (context) => VNodeChild_ |
| `icon` | Leading icon | _VNodeChild \| (context) => VNodeChild_ |
| `extra` | Trailing content such as a shortcut | _VNodeChild \| (context) => VNodeChild_ |
| `value` | Value passed to events on activation | _any_ |
| `children` | Child commands; a plain option with children becomes a submenu | _MenuOption[]_ |
| `disabled` | Disable this item and its descendants | _boolean_ |
| `show` | Whether to render | _boolean_ |
| `ripple` | Whether to show the click ripple | _boolean_ |
| `props` | HTML attributes forwarded to the row element | _HTMLAttributes_ |

The render context is `{ option, active, level }`. `type: 'group'` is visual only and does not add a level; `type: 'divider'` is neither focusable nor activatable.

```ts
import type {
  MenuFieldNames,
  MenuInstance,
  MenuOptionData,
  MenuRenderContext,
  MenuSlots,
  MenuOptionSlots,
  MenuPlacement,
  MenuProps,
  MenuSubmenuTrigger,
  MenuOptionProps,
  MenuValue,
} from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

### Option state colors

Use `--mp-menu-option-selected-background` for selected rows and `--mp-menu-option-bg-selected-hover` for their hover background. Disabled colors take precedence over selected, hover and focus styles.

### Group styles

Use `--mp-menu-group-title-height` for group-title line height and the component’s group-title padding variables for spacing. The first group has no extra group gap.

<!-- Source: src/message/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/message -->

# Message

duration controls display time; 0 keeps the message open, and only finite positive values schedule automatic closing. Hover preserves remaining time. KeepAlive reactivation starts a full configured duration, while deactivation or unmounting cancels the old timer.

### Description

Displays lightweight, nonmodal global feedback without locking scrolling or blocking page interaction.

## Basic examples

### Function Calls

Example source: src/message/example/demos/function-call.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { h, onBeforeUnmount, resolveComponent } from 'vue'
import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

function createMessage(type) {
  if (type === 'time') {
    Message({
      content: '这是一条消息提示',
      duration: 1000,
    })
  }

  if (type === 'position') {
    Message({
      content: '这是一条消息提示',
      position: 'bottom',
    })
  }

  if (type === 'icon') {
    Message.info({
      content: '这是一条消息提示',
      icon: () => h(resolveComponent('MIconHeart'), { style: { paddingRight: '12px' } }),
    })
  }

  if (type === 'action') {
    const customMessage = Message({
      content: 'Hello, Maple',
      action: () =>
        h(
          resolveComponent('MpButton'),
          { size: 'sm', status: 'primary', onClick: () => customMessage.close() },
          { default: () => '关闭' },
        ),
    })
  }

  if (type === 'closable') {
    Message({
      content: '这是一条消息提示',
      closable: true,
      duration: 0,
    })
  }

  if (type === 'update') {
    Message.info({
      id: 'demo-update',
      content: '更新中...',
      duration: 0,
      resetOnUpdate: true,
    })

    setTimeout(() => {
      Message.success({
        id: 'demo-update',
        content: '更新完成',
        duration: 2000,
        resetOnUpdate: true,
      })
    }, 1000)
  }

  if (type === 'loading') {
    const message = Message.loading('等待中...')
    setTimeout(() => {
      message.close()
      Message.success('加载成功')
    }, 2000)
  }

  if (!type) {
    Message('这是一条消息提示')
  }
}
function openMultiple() {
  const message1 = Message('Message 1')
  Message.success('Message 2')
  Message.warning('Message 3')

  setTimeout(() => {
    message1.close()
  }, 1000)
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  Message.clear()
})
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="['3vmin', '4vmin']">
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage()">基本使用</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage('icon')">自定义图标</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage('position')">位置</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage('time')">显示时长</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage('closable')">可关闭</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage('update')">更新内容</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage('loading')">Loading 常驻</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="openMultiple">多实例</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage('action')">自定义操作</mp-button>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Appearance and states

### Statuses

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | Visual emphasis | Appearance combinations |
| `status` | Semantic status | Appearance combinations |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


The standard statuses are `default / info / success / warning / danger / loading`. The convenience method is named `error`, while the component receives `status="danger"`. Call `Message(...)` for a default message; there is no `normal` alias.

Example source: src/message/example/demos/type.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue'
import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

function create(type) {
  const text = type === 'loading' ? '等待中...' : '这是一条消息提示'
  const message = Message[type](text)

  if (type === 'loading') {
    setTimeout(() => {
      message.close()
      Message.success('加载成功')
    }, 2000)
  }
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  Message.clear()
})
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="['3vmin', '4vmin']">
    <mp-button status="success" block @click="create('success')">成功</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="create('warning')">警告</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="info" block @click="create('info')">信息</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="danger" block @click="create('error')">错误</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="create('loading')">加载</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="default" block @click="Message('普通提示')">普通</mp-button>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Visual variants

Visual emphasis is independent of status: neutral uses an overlay surface and status icon; tonal uses a subtle status background; solid uses a strong status fill and paired foreground. Cedar and Maple both default to neutral. Explicit solid / tonal variants share the same color contract. Solid default/loading retain a dark surface. MessageVariant is exported; imperative calls, default options and same-id updates accept variant.

Example source: src/message/example/demos/variant.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const variants = ['neutral', 'tonal', 'solid'] as const
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space wrap>
    <mp-button @click="Message.success({ content: 'neutral (default)', closable: true })">neutral (default)</mp-button>
    <mp-button
      v-for="variant in variants"
      :key="variant"
      @click="Message.success({ content: variant, variant, closable: true })"
      >{{ variant }}</mp-button
    >
  </mp-space>
</template>
```
