## Function calls

### Single-column selection

The function returns selection information and the final action `state`: `confirm`/`cancel`/`close`.

```html
<script setup>
  import { Message, Picker } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

  async function picker() {
    const { state, values, indexes, options } = await Picker({
      columns: [[{ text: 'A' }, { text: 'B' }, { text: 'C' }, { text: 'D' }, { text: 'E' }]],
      onChange(values, indexes) {
        Message(`values: ${values.toString()}, indexes: ${indexes.toString()}`)
      },
    })
  }
</script>

<template>
  <mp-button status="primary" block @click="picker">Single column</mp-button>
</template>
```

### Two-way binding

```html
<script setup>
  import { ref } from 'vue'
  import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

  const values = ref(['A', 'B', 'C'])
  const columns = ref([
    [{ text: 'A' }, { text: 'B' }, { text: 'C' }, { text: 'D' }, { text: 'E' }],
    [{ text: 'A' }, { text: 'B' }, { text: 'C' }, { text: 'D' }, { text: 'E' }],
    [{ text: 'A' }, { text: 'B' }, { text: 'C' }, { text: 'D' }, { text: 'E' }],
  ])

  function resetValues() {
    values.value = ['A', 'B', 'C']
  }

  function handleChange(values, indexes) {
    Message(`values: ${values.toString()}, indexes: ${indexes.toString()}`)
  }
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" size="lg">
    <mp-button status="primary" @click="resetValues">values: {{ values }} Reset</mp-button>
    <mp-picker :columns="columns" v-model="values" @change="handleChange" />
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

Columns follow reading order, and selection indicators sit at logical end. Up/Down, wheels, disabled options and data order retain their existing meaning.

## Usage notes

### Keyboard and reduced motion
Each interactive column is a Tab-focusable listbox. Arrows move, Home/End reach first/last enabled items, skipping disabled options. aria-selected indicates the current wheel item; selected-values indicates separate checkmarks. Empty/all-disabled columns leave the Tab sequence.

Within FormItem, each wheel column merges the caller’s `aria-describedby` with the current form error. A form error sets each column’s `aria-invalid` to `true`; clearing it restores the caller’s value and description.

Reduced motion commits selection immediately without waiting for transitionend. Preference changes settle pending scrolling; unmount removes listeners.

### Service callbacks

Programmatic notification callbacks do not control task completion. Service selection/closing results settle independently of callback errors, and closing completion always releases the owned host. Exceptions still propagate through the caller or Vue error channel; returned Promises do not control loading or closing.

## API

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the selected column-values array; `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once without later resets. Explicit binding wins; initialization emits no `update:modelValue`.

### Picker Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | -------- |
| `model-value` (v-model) | External column values; synchronize candidates initially and on external changes | `(string \| number)[]` | `undefined` |
| `default-value` | Uncontrolled initial column values, read only at creation | `(string \| number)[]` | `[]` |
| `columns` | Column content | _PickerColumnOption[] \| PickerColumnOption[][]_ | `[]` |
| `title` | Title | _string_ | `请选择` |
| `field-names` | Custom column field mapping (`label` maps to `text`, default `text`) | _{ label?, value?, children? }_ | `-` |
| `toolbar` | Whether to display the upper toolbar | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `disabled` | Disable option clicks, touch, keyboard selection and confirmation | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `selected-values` | Selected option values; shows a check mark on the right | _(string \| number)[]_ | `[]` |
| `cascade` | Whether to enable cascade mode | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `option-height` | The height of the option | _string \| number_ | `44` |
| `option-count` | Number of visible columns | _string \| number_ | `6` |
| `columns-count` _**3.3.11**_ | Number of visible columns | _string \| number_ | `-` |
| `confirm-button-text` | Confirm button text | _string_ | `确认` |
| `cancel-button-text` | Cancel button text | _string_ | `取消` |
| `confirm-button-text-color` | Confirm button text color | _string_ | `-` |
| `cancel-button-text-color` | Cancel button text color | _string_ | `-` |
| `esc-to-close` | Whether to support keyboard ESC to close the picker | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `dynamic` | Internal popup adapter switch; false renders the embedded component | boolean | `false` |
| `open` (v-model) | Controlled opening when dynamic=true | boolean | `undefined` |
| `default-open` | Initial uncontrolled opening, read only at creation | boolean | `false` |
| `popup-container` | Popup container when dynamic=true; false renders in place | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `undefined` |
| `overlay-closable` | Request closing the dynamic popup on overlay click | boolean | `true` |
| `safe-area` | Bottom, left and right safe areas for dynamic popups | boolean | `false` |

### Picker Options

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------ |
| `columns` | Column content | _PickerColumnOption[] \| PickerColumnOption[][]_ | `[]` |
| `title` | Title | _string_ | `请选择` |
| `fieldNames` | Custom column field mapping (`label` maps to `text`, default `text`) | _{ label?, value?, children? }_ | `-` |
| `toolbar` | Whether to display the upper toolbar | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `disabled` | Disable option clicks, touch, keyboard selection and confirmation | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `selectedValues` | Selected option values; shows a check mark on the right | _(string \| number)[]_ | `[]` |
| `cascade` | Whether to enable cascade mode | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `optionHeight` | The height of the option | _string \| number_ | `44` |
| `optionCount` | Number of visible columns | _string \| number_ | `6` |
| `columnsCount` _**3.3.11**_ | Number of visible columns | _string \| number_ | `-` |
| `confirmButtonText` | Confirm button text | _string_ | `确认` |
| `cancelButtonText` | Cancel button text | _string_ | `取消` |
| `confirmButtonTextColor` | Confirm button text color | _string_ | `-` |
| `cancelButtonTextColor` | Cancel button text color | _string_ | `-` |
| `overlayClosable` | Whether to click the overlay to close the action sheet | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `escToClose` | Whether to support keyboard ESC to close the picker | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `safeArea` | Whether to adapt to the bottom, left and right safe areas | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `onClickOverlay` | Click overlay callback | _(event: MouseEvent) => void_ | `-` |
| `onOpen` | Popup open callback | _() => void_ | `-` |
| `onOpened` | Popup open-animation ends callback | _() => void_ | `-` |
| `onClose` | Popup close callback | _() => void_ | `-` |
| `onClosed` | Close pop-up layer callback when animation ends | _() => void_ | `-` |
| `onChange` | Pick callbacks when content changes | _(values: (string \| number)[], indexes: number[], options: PickerColumnOption[]) => void_ | `-` |
| `onConfirm` | Accepted confirm action | _(values: (string \| number)[], indexes: number[], options: PickerColumnOption[]) => void_ | `-` |
| `onCancel` | Accepted cancel action | _(values: (string \| number)[], indexes: number[], options: PickerColumnOption[]) => void_ | `-` |
| `onKeyEscape` | Triggered when click keyboard ESC | `(event: KeyboardEvent) => void` | `-` |
| `modelValue` | Initial service values, taking precedence over defaultValue | `(string \| number)[]` | `undefined` |
| `defaultValue` | Initial uncontrolled service values | `(string \| number)[]` | `[]` |
| `popupContainer` | Service container following the shared popup-container protocol; false renders in place | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `body` |

### PickerColumnOption Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| --------- | ------------------------------- | ---- | ------ |
| `confirm` | Stop scrolling immediately and emit confirm | `-` | `-` |
| `cancel` | Stop scrolling immediately and emit cancel | `-` | `-` |

### PickerColumnOption Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `change` | Triggered when the pick content changes | values: (string \| number)[] selected values <br> `indexes: number[]` selected indices <br> `options: PickerColumnOption[]` selected option objects |
| `cancel` | Accepted cancel action | values: (string \| number)[] selected values <br> `indexes: number[]` selected indices <br> `options: PickerColumnOption[]` selected option objects |
| `confirm` | Accepted confirm action | values: (string \| number)[] selected values <br> `indexes: number[]` selected indices <br> `options: PickerColumnOption[]` selected option objects |
| `key-escape` | Triggered when pressing ESC | `KeyboardEvent` |
| `update:model-value` | Candidate values after change; does not imply business confirmation | `(values: (string \| number)[])` |
| `update:open` | Dynamic popup opening request | `(open: boolean)` |
| `open` | Dynamic popup starts opening | `()` |
| `opened` | Dynamic popup opening transition completes | `()` |
| `close` | Dynamic popup starts closing | `()` |
| `closed` | Dynamic popup closing transition completes | `()` |
| `click-overlay` | Dynamic popup overlay click | `(event: MouseEvent)` |

### PickerColumnOption Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --------- | ------------ | ---- |
| `title` | Title content | `-` |
| `cancel` | Cancel-button content | `-` |
| `confirm` | Confirm-button content | `-` |

### Candidates, layout and service ownership

The wheel retains local candidates. modelValue synchronizes from outside; scrolling or keyboard selection updates candidates and notifies change followed by update:modelValue. Unaccepted updates do not immediately roll back. Later external value changes synchronize again. Both confirm and cancel carry current candidates; cancel does not restore initial values. The component only notifies, while its owner controls closing.

Changing optionHeight or optionCount recenters candidates and stops old scrolling transitions. columnsCount immediately updates visible columns, preserving retained nodes, focus and candidates. Layout changes send no additional model/change notifications and do not roll unaccepted candidates back to old external values. Removed column nodes are outside the focus-retention guarantee.

Picker(options) is an explicit asynchronous selection service. It copies configuration and owns mutable open/dynamic state and singleton lifecycle without writing to caller options, including frozen objects. Explicit popupContainer values are respected; the default is body. open, defaultOpen and dynamic are not service Options; component Props still support embedded and popup modes.

The service returns PickerResolvedData with state confirm, cancel or close. confirm/cancel include values, indexes and options; close contains only state. Notification callbacks are not awaited. confirm/cancel settle and request closing before notification; a throwing closed callback cannot skip host cleanup. Picker.close() closes only the current service singleton.

The title, cancel and confirm toolbar slots have no scoped arguments. Custom buttons may call instance confirm()/cancel(). Only these two methods form the public instance contract; other setup render bindings are not business extension points. Picker.Component and _PickerComponent are actual SFCs; default Picker is the callable service and installation entry point.

```ts
import { Picker, type PickerOptions, type PickerColumnOption,
  type PickerResolvedState, type PickerResolvedData,
  type PickerProps, type PickerInstance, type PickerEmits,
  type PickerSlots, type PickerSelection } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
```

<!-- Source: docs/platform.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/platform -->

# Platforms and compatibility

Cedar targets desktop applications; Maple targets mobile applications. Choose by interaction and information density. Check the installed package peer dependencies and verify your target browsers.

## Vue version compatibility

Cedar / Maple target Vue 3.3 and later for ongoing compatibility checks; development uses Vue 3.5. The UI package keeps a `3` Vue peer range, so successful installation does not mean every Vue 3 version and scenario has been verified. On Vue 3.2, generated ID associations may differ if asynchronous components resolve in a different order on the server and client. Vue 3.0 and 3.1 have not been verified.

When the initial server render of Cedar Table must apply a default filter, pass the columns through `:columns` and set `filterable.defaultFilteredValue`. Columns declared with `<c-table-column>` do not guarantee filtered rows in the server HTML.

## Build tool compatibility

Cedar / Maple do not currently guarantee Webpack 4 compatibility or continuously validate that toolchain. ESM output preserves `import` / `export` and may also contain modern JavaScript syntax such as optional chaining (`?.`) and nullish coalescing (`??`). ESM describes the module format, not ES5 syntax compatibility.

Webpack 4 cannot parse `?.` / `??` directly. Applications that need this toolchain must transpile the library and relevant dependencies with Babel and validate their own integration. Browser compatibility and build tool parsing capabilities are separate requirements.

### Complete minimal Webpack 4 configuration

This example combines Babel transpilation, entry/subpath aliases, CSS loaders and Vue build flags in one configuration. Create the files below in an empty directory. It consumes precompiled components and does not use `.vue` single-file components, so no `vue-loader` is needed. Retain your existing Vue loader configuration if your application uses SFCs.

1. Install dependencies (validated with UI / icons 1.1.11 and Vue 3.5.45):

```sh
npm init -y
npm install vue@3.5.45 @maple-design/ui-vue@1.1.11 @maple-design/icons-vue@1.1.11
npm install --save-dev webpack@4.47.0 webpack-cli@3.3.12 babel-loader@8.4.1 @babel/core@^7 @babel/preset-env@^7 style-loader@2.0.0 css-loader@5.2.7
```

2. Create `webpack.config.cjs` (CommonJS, including when the application declares `"type": "module"`):

```js
const path = require('path')
const webpack = require('webpack')
const uiRoot = path.dirname(require.resolve('@maple-design/ui-vue/package.json'))
const iconsRoot = path.dirname(require.resolve('@maple-design/icons-vue/style.css'))

module.exports = {
  mode: 'production',
  entry: './src/index.js',
  output: { path: path.resolve(__dirname, 'dist'), filename: 'bundle.js' },
  resolve: {
    extensions: ['.mjs', '.js', '.json'],
    alias: {
      'vue$': require.resolve('vue/dist/vue.runtime.esm-bundler.js'),
      '@maple-design/ui-vue/style$': require.resolve('@maple-design/ui-vue/style'),
      '@maple-design/ui-vue/reset.css$': require.resolve('@maple-design/ui-vue/reset.css'),
      '@maple-design/ui-vue': path.join(uiRoot, 'es'),
      '@maple-design/icons-vue/style.css$': require.resolve('@maple-design/icons-vue/style.css'),
      '@maple-design/icons-vue': path.join(iconsRoot, 'es'),
    },
  },
  module: {
    rules: [
      {
        test: /\.[cm]?js$/,
        type: 'javascript/auto',
        use: {
          loader: 'babel-loader',
          options: {
            babelrc: false,
            configFile: false,
            presets: [['@babel/preset-env', { targets: { chrome: '70' }, modules: false }]],
          },
        },
      },
      { test: /\.css$/, use: ['style-loader', 'css-loader'] },
    ],
  },
  plugins: [
    new webpack.DefinePlugin({
      __VUE_OPTIONS_API__: JSON.stringify(true),
      __VUE_PROD_DEVTOOLS__: JSON.stringify(false),
      __VUE_PROD_HYDRATION_MISMATCH_DETAILS__: JSON.stringify(false),
    }),
  ],
}
```

3. Create `src/index.js`. It consumes both root and component/icon subpath imports, plus component, full, reset and icon styles to exercise resolution:

```js
import { createApp, h } from 'vue'
import { Button as RootButton } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
import Button from '@maple-design/ui-vue/button'
import { IconAlertCircle as RootIcon } from '@maple-design/icons-vue'
import { IconAlertCircle } from '@maple-design/icons-vue/icon-alert-circle'
import '@maple-design/ui-vue/button/style'
import '@maple-design/ui-vue/style'
import '@maple-design/ui-vue/reset.css'
import '@maple-design/icons-vue/style.css'

if (RootButton !== Button || RootIcon !== IconAlertCircle) throw new Error('Entry mismatch')
createApp({
  setup() {
    return () => h(Button, { onClick: () => { document.body.dataset.clicked = 'yes' } }, {
      default: () => [h(IconAlertCircle), 'Webpack 4 works'],
    })
  },
}).mount('#app')
```

4. Create `index.html` in the project root:

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Webpack 4 example</title></head>
  <body>
    <div id="app"></div>
    <script src="./dist/bundle.js"></script>
  </body>
</html>
```

5. Build, then serve the project root over local HTTP and open `index.html`:

```sh
npx webpack --config webpack.config.cjs
```

The page should display a `Webpack 4 works` button with an icon. Clicking it sets `document.body.dataset.clicked` to `yes`. Production builds may report asset size warnings. This entry intentionally imports both full and component styles to validate their paths; applications usually choose one styling approach.

#### Configuration details and scope

- Babel `preset-env` uses Chrome 70 as its syntax target with `modules: false`, transforming optional chaining, nullish coalescing, logical assignment and class fields while preserving ESM. This is a compilation target for this example, not a promise that the library supports Chrome 70; it supplies neither runtime API polyfills nor CSS fallbacks. `syntax-*` plugins alone do not transform syntax.
- This minimal example transpiles all `.js` / `.mjs` / `.cjs` files, including Vue, the component library and other dependencies. It avoids excluding `node_modules`; narrow the scope only after validating your application, and ensure `oneOf` allows files to reach the rule. `javascript/auto` allows Webpack 4 to handle interop between `.mjs` and CommonJS dependencies.
- Webpack 4 does not support `exports` mappings. Package aliases without `$` cover the root and component/icon/component-style subpaths matching the ES directory layout; no separate `ui-vue$` alias is needed. Exact style aliases must precede prefix aliases. Full, reset and icon styles map to their actual files. Include `.mjs` in the extensions list.
- When integrating, retain your application's entry, output, extensions and other loaders/plugins. Prefix aliases do not replace all `exports` mappings. Other exports, such as `package.json` or Maple's `json/*` and `highlight/*`, need mappings based on the installed version.
- This configuration validates only the minimal application shown here. It does not guarantee ongoing Webpack 4 compatibility, provide runtime API polyfills or CSS fallbacks for older browsers, or verify every component's behavior.

[LLM documentation](#/en-US/llms) · [Cedar](https://cedar.show) · [Maple](https://maple.show)

# Popover

SSR limitation: a trigger slot node using both `v-for` and `v-memo` can make server rendering fail. Remove `v-memo` from that slot node when rendering on the server; ordinary `v-for` remains supported. In Vue 3.5.13, a standalone dynamic `v-memo` can also fail in this slot. The same limitation can affect the `content` slot; remove `v-memo` there for server rendering.

Shows structured, interactive content after the reference is clicked. Use Tooltip for a short, non-interactive description.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Example source: src/popover/example/demos/basic-usage.vue

```vue

    <template #content>

      <p>状态：运行中</p>
    </template>
  </mp-popover>
</template>

<style lang="less" scoped>

  height: 250px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}
</style>
```

## Interaction and control

### Interactive content and retained state

```vue

        <mp-input v-model="draft" placeholder="关闭后再次打开，草稿仍会保留" />
        <mp-button status="primary" block @click="open = false">完成</mp-button>
      </mp-space>
    </template>
  </mp-popover>
</template>
```

## Empty content

With `hide-empty`, the panel is hidden when the title is empty and the body contains only comments or whitespace. The open state is unchanged and the panel appears when content becomes available. Component nodes count as content.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Content defaults to inline-start alignment and popovers inherit source direction. Logical start/end follow reading direction; explicit left/right placements remain physical.

## Usage notes

### Configuration

These are actual :root defaults. Prefer component variables for business customization; internal positioning variables are not public API.

With Teleport, variables must be in the actual popup scope, for example through `popup-style`. Trigger-button variables do not automatically inherit into popups.

## API

Popover inherits Trigger positioning, container, controlled state and `close` policies. `auto-fit-transform-origin` defaults to true; an omitted `animation-name` uses the Popover animation. `content-class` and `content-style` apply to the content panel; `popup-class` and `popup-style` apply to the outer positioning node. The instance exposes seven methods: `open`, `close`, `resize`, `allowClose`, `getReference`, `focusReference`, and `setReference`. Focus remains on the trigger when opening. The panel is non-modal and Tab order depends on its actual DOM mount location; provide an accessible keyboard path for interactive content.

### Popover Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| v-model:open | Controlled open state | `boolean` | — |
| default-open | Initial uncontrolled state | `boolean` | `false` |
| title | Title | `string` | — |
| content | Body | `string` | — |
| trigger | Interaction | `TriggerEvent \| TriggerEvent[]`<br>`TriggerEvent: 'manual' \| 'focus' \| 'hover' \| 'click' \| 'contextMenu'` | `click` |

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |

### Popover Methods

`open()`、`close()`、`resize()`、`allowClose()`、`getReference()`、`setReference()`、`focusReference()`。

The reference is connected to the panel with `aria-controls` and `aria-expanded`. The panel is a group and does not declare aria-haspopup by default. When setting an explicit popup type through reference-attrs, ensure it matches the actual content semantics. Use Trigger for unstyled positioning. Popover has no `defaultStyle`, `popoverClass`, or `elevation`; customize with tokens, `content-class`, or `content-style`.

Maple dark mode retains a 2px radius and platform-specific shadows. Content and arrows share background/border variables, independent of Trigger style-loading order.

# Popup

Mobile modal surface entering from the top, bottom, left, right, or center. Popup shares its modal controller with Cedar Drawer while retaining mobile safe-area and transition presentation.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

## Loading and waiting

### Controlled loading

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | Explicit business loading state | `boolean` | `false` |

External loading blocks close/switch requests; internal before-hook waiting is merged for display.


Set loading explicitly to display feedback. Ordinary event return values do not drive loading. Before hooks retain their documented pending behavior.

Example source: src/popup/example/demos/loading.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const loading = ref(false)
const open = ref(false)
const beforeWait = () => new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(true), 800))
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%" :size="16">
    <mp-form layout="vertical"
      ><mp-form-item label="加载状态 / Loading"><mp-switch v-model="loading" /></mp-form-item
    ></mp-form>
    <mp-button @click="open = true">打开弹层 / Open</mp-button
    ><mp-popup v-model:open="open" :before-close="beforeWait" :loading="loading"
      ><mp-space direction="column"
        ><p>业务控制加载 / Controlled loading</p>
        <mp-button @click="loading = !loading">切换加载 / Toggle loading</mp-button
        ><mp-button @click="open = false">关闭 / Close</mp-button></mp-space
      ></mp-popup
    >
    <p>
      通过 loading 显式控制等待展示，普通事件返回 Promise 不会自动加载。Loading is controlled by business state.
      关闭手动加载后切换或关闭，观察 before 守卫的自动等待反馈。
    </p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Usage notes

### Focus management

Built-in fade, center scaling, four-direction pop and base content/scrim transitions consume duration/timing-function tokens, retaining 250ms/ease defaults. Whole-layer overrides belong on the actual post-Teleport common ancestor or popup-container host. style affects content only; overlay-style affects scrim only. Use valid nonnegative CSS times. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce overrides built-in transitions/initial displacement/scaling. Business code adapts custom animations.

With unmount-on-close=true, content remains during closing and unmounts after completion; close locks are not released early. Rapid reopening cancels closing and retains slot state. opened/closed fire once per valid phase, never after destruction. No fixed 250ms JS timer is used. Initial opening retains mounted notification without promising complete appear timing. Business code must coordinate custom transitions or differing inner/outer durations.

Opening focuses the actual dialog panel. Tab/Shift+Tab cycle through available controls, skipping hidden/disabled elements. The topmost nested popup owns focus handling; closing restores its opener. Applications must retain trigger nodes and must not override internal focus-root markers.

### Landscape safe areas

Use `safe-area-inset-left` and `safe-area-inset-right` to add safe-area padding on the sides. Both default to `false`. See [SafeArea](#/en-US/safe-area) for host insets and nested containers.

### Closing by pulling the header

Enable `swipe-to-close` for bottom popups and mark draggable header areas with `data-popup-swipe-handle`. It is off by default and inactive at other placements. `swipe-threshold` defaults to 40 layout CSS px, including under parent scaling. Closing requests `update:open(false)` and emits `swipe-close(PointerEvent)` only if final movement is downward and reaches the threshold. Small/horizontal/canceled gestures, buttons/inputs and body scrolling do not close. Rejected controlled requests retain the popup and restore its position. Existing Esc/scrim/close controls remain.

The vertical threshold accounts for vertical scaling independently of horizontal scaling; gesture conversion under rotation or skew is not specified.

```html
<mp-popup v-model:open="open" placement="bottom" swipe-to-close>
  <header data-popup-swipe-handle>Edit information</header>
  <main>Popup content</main>
</mp-popup>
```

Maple field editors allow dragging blank header areas to cancel drafts by default; pending asynchronous confirmation disables gestures. ActionSheet can explicitly set swipe-to-close/swipe-threshold; default titles are marked, while custom title slots must mark their own drag area.
# Asynchronous close interception


Reasons: `overlay`, `escape`, `route`, `swipe`, `close`, `api`, `model`. The default slot provides `{ close, pending }`; `close` buttons should call `close('close', event)`. Instance `close()` uses `api`; `requestClose(reason, event)` specifies a reason and returns `Promise<boolean>`. External `open`=`false` uses `model`; rejection emits `update:open(true)`, which controlled parents should accept. Only enabled `close` entries request closing.

Adding, replacing, or removing `before-close` does not change the current `open` state; in controlled mode the parent continues to update `open`.

Direct destruction, removing `v-if` or destroying a route page is not a close request and cannot await internal guards. Await `requestClose()` before those parent actions. Keep business confirmation in `beforeCommit`; a close guard does not replace validation. The theme page's complete form demonstrates delayed allowance/rejection/errors and all close entries.

Popup close()/requestClose() and external open=false are guarded. Dialog on both ends and Cedar Drawer instance/service close() are direct commands with a different responsibility. Await `Promise<boolean>` when Popup confirmation is required; do not infer behavior from matching method names.

## API

### Popup Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | Business loading state, combined with the close guard pending state | `boolean` | `false` |
| `dir` | Reading direction; inherited from the source scope when omitted | `'ltr' \| 'rtl'` | `-` |
| `before-close` | Explicit close guard receiving the reason, completion callback, and context | `PopupBeforeClose` | `-` |
| `v-model:open` | Visible state | `boolean` | - |
| `default-open` | Whether to display by default in uncontrolled mode | `boolean` | `false` |
| `placement` | Panel region at a container edge or center, default center. It is not trigger-relative and does not automatically flip | `'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'right' \| 'left' \| 'center'` | `'center'` |
| `swipe-to-close` | Enable swipe-to-close in the designated header area of a bottom popup | `boolean` | `false` |
| `swipe-threshold` | Swipe-to-close threshold in layout CSS pixels | `number` | `40` |
| `overlay` | Show the overlay | `boolean` | `true` |
| `overlay-class` | Overlay class | `string` | `-` |
| `overlay-style` | Overlay style | `object` | `-` |
| `overlay-closable` | Close after an overlay click | `boolean` | `true` |
| `transition` | Content transition name | `string` | Derived from placement |
| `overlay-animation-name` | Overlay transition name | `string` | `mp-fade` |
| `unstyled` | Remove the default background, text color and elevation | `boolean` | `false` |
| `lock-scroll` | Lock scrolling on the host | `boolean` | `true` |
| `esc-to-close` | Close on Escape | `boolean` | `true` |
| `close-on-route-change` | Close after a route change | `boolean` | `false` |
| `unmount-on-close` | False mounts and preserves content even when initially closed; true unmounts after leaving | `boolean` | `false` |
| `popup-container` | Portal container | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `body` |
| `safe-area-inset-bottom` | Apply the bottom safe-area inset | `boolean` | `false` |
| `safe-area-inset-top` | Apply the top safe-area inset | `boolean` | `false` |
| `safe-area-inset-right` | Apply the right safe-area inset | `boolean` | `false` |
| `safe-area-inset-left` | Apply the left safe-area inset | `boolean` | `false` |
| `z-index` | Outer stacking level | `number` | Automatically distributed |

### Popup Events

| Event | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `update:open` | `boolean` | Request that the parent update the open state |
| `open` | - | The popup starts opening |
| `opened` | - | Opening has completed |
| `close` | - | The popup starts closing |
| `closed` | - | Closing has completed |
| `click-overlay` | `MouseEvent` | The overlay was clicked |
| `key-escape` | `KeyboardEvent` | The topmost popup received Escape |
| `swipe-close` | `PointerEvent` | A swipe close request passed the guard |
| `close-error` | `error: unknown, reason: PopupCloseReason` | The close guard threw or returned a rejected Promise |

### Popup Slots

| Slot | Prop | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | `{ close, pending }` | Popup content; `close(reason?, event?)` returns `Promise<boolean>` |

### Popup Methods

| Method | Parameters and return value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close` | `(event?: Event) => Promise<boolean>` | Request closing with the `api` reason |
| `requestClose` | `(reason?: PopupCloseReason, event?: Event) => Promise<boolean>` | Request closing with the specified reason |
| `pending` | `boolean` | Current manual loading or guard pending state |

`placement` describes the popup position relative to its container; `dir` controls reading direction. `route-change` is not a lifecycle event; explicitly enable `close-on-route-change` to close on navigation.

## Close guards



Synchronous logging-only hooks must explicitly return true; synchronous undefined means awaiting a callback. Earlier `Promise<void>` hooks without done now allow closing when their Promise resolves.

Popup reasons: overlay, escape, route, swipe, close, api, model. Rejecting external open=false requests update:open(true). Direct destruction cannot await hooks; await requestClose() first.


Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise&lt;void&gt; allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

### Async operation feedback

Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection or failure restores interaction; repeated input does not start the same operation again. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate in loading.

## CSS Variables

Scrim variables dim only the background. Content background/text form a raised-surface color pair, with dark themes inheriting the same semantics. `unstyled` disables default background/text colors together. style sets content variables, overlay-style scrim variables, or place system variables on an actual common ancestor. Teleport does not inherit from the original call site. Dialog uses independent scrim variables unaffected by Popup variables.

<!-- component-css-variables:start -->

Use these variables to customize the component. Defaults may vary by the selector condition shown. Each variable applies to the corresponding size, variant and interaction states.

<div class="token-reference-table" style="max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;">

| Variable | Default / condition | Affected styles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--mp-popup-content-background-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-surface-raised)` | `background-color` |
| `--mp-popup-content-text-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-content-primary)` | `color` |
| `--mp-popup-overlay-background-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-scrim)` | `background-color` |
| `--mp-popup-transition-duration` | `250ms` | `transition` |
| `--mp-popup-transition-timing-function` | `ease` | `transition` |

</div>

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --mp-popup-content-background-color: var(--mp-sys-color-surface-raised);
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

# 项目卡片页

收藏、组合筛选、项目计划和快速编辑。

## 完整业务体验

全部使用 Maple 自有组件。手机列表使用可选择的项目卡片，资料使用 Cell 展示，选择与日期使用 Popup。任务、跟进、收藏、归档和草稿在这些页面间共享，刷新保留当前浏览器会话数据。

业务数据在 `practices-examples/shared/usePracticeData.js` 中；示例使用合成数据，不访问真实业务接口。归档可恢复，重置会还原整个工作区。

# 团队工作台

按类型汇总项目指标、预算、待办与最近动态。

## 完整业务体验

选择业务范围，处理待办中的项目；再进入列表或详情，核对同一个项目的状态。创建、编辑、归档和跟进都会进入最近动态。

Example source: docs/practices-examples/dashboard/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { projectError, usePracticeData } from '../shared/usePracticeData.js'
import { usePracticeNavigation } from '../shared/usePracticeNavigation.js'

const data = usePracticeData()
const {
  workspace,
  rows,
  projects,
  favorites,
  activity,
  savedDraft,
  latest,
  query,
  applied,
  current,
  selected,
  notice,
  statusOptions,
  categories,
  categoryOptions,
  priorities,
  filtered,
  pageRows,
  done,
  budget,
  overdue,
  active,
  detailOpen,
  createOpen,
  archiveOpen,
  editingKey,
  draft,
  fresh,
  search,
  clear,
  show,
  finish,
  finishSelected,
  startCreate,
  startEdit,
  create,
  requestArchive,
  confirmArchive,
  restore,
  favorite,
  reset,
  exportCsv,
} = data
const { route, go, href } = usePracticeNavigation()
const required = [(value) => !!value?.trim() || '此项不能为空']
const money = (value) => Number(value).toLocaleString('zh-CN', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })
const category = ref('全部')
const visible = computed(() =>
  projects.value.filter((row) => category.value === '全部' || row.category === category.value),
)
const completed = computed(() => visible.value.filter((row) => row.status === '已完成').length)
const completion = computed(() =>
  visible.value.length ? Math.round((completed.value / visible.value.length) * 100) : 0,
)
const totalBudget = computed(() => visible.value.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.budget, 0))
const visibleEvents = computed(() =>
  activity.value
    .filter((event) => !event.project || visible.value.some((row) => row.key === event.project))
    .slice(0, 6),
)
const pending = computed(() => visible.value.filter((row) => row.status !== '已完成').slice(0, 4))
const timeLabel = (value) => new Date(value).toLocaleString('zh-CN')
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space class="practice-page" direction="column" block size="lg"
    ><mp-page-header title="团队工作台" subtitle="一份项目数据驱动指标、待办、交付与操作动态" :show-back="false"
      ><template #extra
        ><mp-space wrap><mp-button @click="reset">重置工作区</mp-button></mp-space></template
      ></mp-page-header
    ><mp-space wrap size="sm"
      ><mp-button @click="go('dashboard')">工作台</mp-button><mp-button @click="go('list')">项目列表</mp-button
      ><mp-button @click="go('card')">卡片视图</mp-button
      ><mp-button status="primary" @click="go('form')">创建申请</mp-button></mp-space
    ><mp-cell>本地演示工作区 · 各页面共享数据，刷新保留本次会话。归档可恢复，重置会还原整个工作区。</mp-cell
    ><mp-card title="业务概况"
      ><mp-form layout="vertical"
        ><mp-form-item label="业务范围"
          ><mp-select v-model="category" :options="categoryOptions" edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-form
      ><mp-grid :cols="{ xs: 2, md: 4 }" :col-gap="16" :row-gap="16"
        ><mp-grid-item><mp-statistic title="范围内项目" :value="visible.length" /></mp-grid-item
        ><mp-grid-item><mp-statistic title="已交付项目" :value="completed" /></mp-grid-item
        ><mp-grid-item><mp-statistic title="预算（元）" :value="totalBudget" show-group-separator /></mp-grid-item
        ><mp-grid-item
          ><mp-statistic title="交付完成率" :value="completion" suffix="%" /></mp-grid-item></mp-grid></mp-card
    ><mp-grid :cols="{ xs: 1, lg: 2 }" :col-gap="16" :row-gap="16"
      ><mp-grid-item
        ><mp-card title="我的待办"
          ><mp-space direction="column" block
            ><mp-card
              v-for="row in pending"
              :key="row.key"
              :title="row.name"
              :description="row.owner + ' · 截止 ' + row.dueDate"
              ><mp-progress :percent="row.progress" /><template #footer
                ><mp-space wrap
                  ><mp-button @click="go('detail', { project: row.key })">处理项目</mp-button
                  ><mp-button @click="finish(row)">完成交付</mp-button></mp-space
                ></template
              ></mp-card
            ><mp-empty v-if="!pending.length" description="该范围内的项目均已交付" /></mp-space></mp-card></mp-grid-item
      ><mp-grid-item
        ><mp-space direction="column" block
          ><mp-card title="类型交付分布"
            ><mp-space direction="column" block
              ><mp-space v-for="item in categories" :key="item.value" direction="column" block
                ><mp-cell
                  >{{ item.label }} ·
                  {{ projects.filter((row) => row.category === item.value && row.status === '已完成').length }} /
                  {{ projects.filter((row) => row.category === item.value).length }} 已完成</mp-cell
                ><mp-progress
                  :percent="
                    projects.filter((row) => row.category === item.value).length
                      ? Math.round(
                          (projects.filter((row) => row.category === item.value && row.status === '已完成').length /
                            projects.filter((row) => row.category === item.value).length) *
                            100,
                        )
                      : 0
                  " /></mp-space></mp-space></mp-card
          ><mp-card title="最近动态"
            ><mp-space direction="column" block
              ><mp-cell v-for="event in visibleEvents" :key="event.key"
                >{{ timeLabel(event.at) }} · {{ event.text }}</mp-cell
              ><mp-empty
                v-if="!visibleEvents.length"
                description="暂无操作记录" /></mp-space></mp-card></mp-space></mp-grid-item></mp-grid
    ><mp-cell role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ notice }}</mp-cell></mp-space
  >
</template>
<style scoped>
.practice-page {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.practice-page :deep(.mp-grid-item) {
  min-width: 0;
}
.practice-page :deep(.mp-grid) {
  width: 100%;
}
.practice-page :deep(.mp-space__item) {
  min-width: 0;
}
</style>
```

## 移动端业务适配

全部使用 Maple 自有组件。手机列表使用可选择的项目卡片，资料使用 Cell 展示，选择与日期使用 Popup。任务、跟进、收藏、归档和草稿在这些页面间共享，刷新保留当前浏览器会话数据。

业务数据在 `practices-examples/shared/usePracticeData.js` 中；示例使用合成数据，不访问真实业务接口。归档可恢复，重置会还原整个工作区。

# 业务详情页

动态项目资料、任务清单、交付进度、跟进、操作记录与归档。

## 完整业务体验

从列表或卡片进入一个具体项目；编辑资料后取消，确认原值未变；保存编辑、完成任务并添加跟进，再到工作台查看操作动态。

Example source: docs/practices-examples/detail/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { projectError, usePracticeData } from '../shared/usePracticeData.js'
import { usePracticeNavigation } from '../shared/usePracticeNavigation.js'

const data = usePracticeData()
const {
  workspace,
  rows,
  projects,
  favorites,
  activity,
  savedDraft,
  latest,
  query,
  applied,
  current,
  selected,
  notice,
  statusOptions,
  categories,
  categoryOptions,
  priorities,
  filtered,
  pageRows,
  done,
  budget,
  overdue,
  active,
  detailOpen,
  createOpen,
  archiveOpen,
  editingKey,
  draft,
  fresh,
  search,
  clear,
  show,
  finish,
  finishSelected,
  startCreate,
  startEdit,
  create,
  requestArchive,
  confirmArchive,
  restore,
  favorite,
  reset,
  exportCsv,
} = data
const { route, go, href } = usePracticeNavigation()
const required = [(value) => !!value?.trim() || '此项不能为空']
const money = (value) => Number(value).toLocaleString('zh-CN', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })
const project = computed(() => rows.value.find((row) => row.key === (route.query.project || projects.value[0]?.key)))
const noteText = ref('')
const projectEvents = computed(() => activity.value.filter((event) => event.project === project.value?.key))
const info = computed(() =>
  project.value
    ? [
        { label: '项目编号', value: project.value.key },
        { label: '负责人', value: project.value.owner },
        { label: '业务类型', value: project.value.category },
        { label: '优先级', value: project.value.priority },
        { label: '开始日期', value: project.value.startDate },
        { label: '截止日期', value: project.value.dueDate },
        { label: '预算', value: money(project.value.budget) + ' 元' },
        { label: '当前状态', value: project.value.archived ? '已归档' : project.value.status },
      ]
    : [],
)
function addNote() {
  if (workspace.note(project.value, noteText.value)) {
    noteText.value = ''
    notice.value = '跟进已添加到项目记录和工作台动态。'
  }
}
const timeLabel = (value) => new Date(value).toLocaleString('zh-CN')
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space class="practice-page" direction="column" block size="lg"
    ><mp-result v-if="!project" status="404" title="项目不存在" subtitle="该项目可能已重置或编号无效"
      ><template #extra><mp-button @click="go('list')">返回项目列表</mp-button></template></mp-result
    ><template v-else
      ><mp-page-header title="项目业务详情" subtitle="项目资料、任务清单和操作记录在所有页面同步" :show-back="false"
        ><template #extra
          ><mp-space wrap
            ><mp-button v-if="!project.archived" @click="startEdit(project)">编辑项目</mp-button
            ><mp-button
              v-if="!project.archived"
              :disabled="project.status === '已完成'"
              status="primary"
              @click="finish(project)"
              >完成交付</mp-button
            ><mp-button v-if="project.archived" @click="restore(project)">恢复项目</mp-button
            ><mp-button v-else @click="requestArchive([project.key])">归档项目</mp-button></mp-space
          ></template
        ></mp-page-header
      ><mp-space wrap size="sm"
        ><mp-button @click="go('dashboard')">工作台</mp-button><mp-button @click="go('list')">项目列表</mp-button
        ><mp-button @click="go('card')">卡片视图</mp-button
        ><mp-button status="primary" @click="go('form')">创建申请</mp-button></mp-space
      ><mp-card :title="project.name" :subtitle="project.key" :description="project.description"
        ><template #title-action
          ><mp-tag>{{ project.archived ? '已归档' : project.status }}</mp-tag></template
        ><mp-progress :percent="project.progress" /><mp-steps
          :model-value="project.status === '已完成' ? 3 : project.status === '进行中' ? 2 : 1"
          ><mp-step>项目创建</mp-step><mp-step>执行交付</mp-step><mp-step>交付完成</mp-step></mp-steps
        ></mp-card
      ><mp-tabs default-value="info"
        ><mp-tab-pane name="info" title="基本资料"
          ><mp-card title="项目资料"
            ><mp-space direction="column" block
              ><mp-cell v-for="item in info" :key="item.label" :title="item.label">{{ item.value }}</mp-cell></mp-space
            ></mp-card
          ></mp-tab-pane
        ><mp-tab-pane name="tasks" title="任务清单"
          ><mp-card title="交付任务"
            ><mp-space direction="column" block
              ><mp-checkbox
                v-for="task in project.tasks"
                :key="task.key"
                :model-value="task.done"
                :disabled="project.archived"
                @update:model-value="(checked) => workspace.toggleTask(project, task.key, checked)"
                >{{ task.title }}</mp-checkbox
              ></mp-space
            ></mp-card
          ></mp-tab-pane
        ><mp-tab-pane name="history" title="操作记录"
          ><mp-card title="项目动态"
            ><mp-space direction="column" block
              ><mp-cell v-for="event in projectEvents" :key="event.key"
                >{{ timeLabel(event.at) }} · {{ event.text }}</mp-cell
              ><mp-empty
                v-if="!projectEvents.length"
                description="项目尚无新增记录" /></mp-space></mp-card></mp-tab-pane></mp-tabs
      ><mp-card title="新增跟进"
        ><mp-form layout="vertical"
          ><mp-form-item label="跟进内容"
            ><mp-textarea
              v-model="noteText"
              placeholder="记录当前进展、风险或下一步计划"
              :disabled="project.archived"
              edit-mode="direct" /></mp-form-item></mp-form
        ><mp-button status="primary" :disabled="!noteText.trim() || project.archived" @click="addNote"
          >添加跟进</mp-button
        ></mp-card
      ><mp-cell role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ notice }}</mp-cell
      ><mp-dialog
        v-model:open="createOpen"
        :title="editingKey ? '编辑项目资料' : '快速创建项目'"
        :footer="false"
        :unmount-on-close="true"
        ><mp-form :model="draft" layout="vertical" @submit="create"
          ><mp-grid :cols="{ xs: 1, md: 2 }" :col-gap="16" :row-gap="8"
            ><mp-grid-item
              ><mp-form-item label="项目名称" field="name" :rules="required" feedback
                ><mp-input
                  v-model="draft.name"
                  edit-mode="direct"
                  placeholder="项目名称" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
            ><mp-grid-item
              ><mp-form-item label="负责人" field="owner" :rules="required" feedback
                ><mp-input v-model="draft.owner" edit-mode="direct" placeholder="负责人" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
            ><mp-grid-item
              ><mp-form-item label="业务类型" field="category"
                ><mp-select
                  v-model="draft.category"
                  :options="categories"
                  edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
            ><mp-grid-item
              ><mp-form-item label="优先级" field="priority"
                ><mp-select
                  v-model="draft.priority"
                  :options="priorities"
                  edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
            ><mp-grid-item
              ><mp-form-item label="开始日期" field="startDate"
                ><mp-date
                  v-model="draft.startDate"
                  value-format="YYYY-MM-DD"
                  edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
            ><mp-grid-item
              ><mp-form-item label="截止日期" field="dueDate"
                ><mp-date
                  v-model="draft.dueDate"
                  value-format="YYYY-MM-DD"
                  edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
            ><mp-grid-item
              ><mp-form-item label="项目预算（元）" field="budget"
                ><mp-input-number
                  v-model="draft.budget"
                  :min="0"
                  :precision="2"
                  edit-mode="direct" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item></mp-grid
          ><mp-form-item label="项目说明" field="description"
            ><mp-textarea
              v-model="draft.description"
              edit-mode="direct"
              placeholder="项目目标、交付物和验收要求" /></mp-form-item
          ><mp-space wrap
            ><mp-button html-type="submit" status="primary">{{ editingKey ? '保存项目' : '创建项目' }}</mp-button
            ><mp-button @click="createOpen = false">取消</mp-button></mp-space
          ><mp-cell role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ notice }}</mp-cell></mp-form
        ></mp-dialog
      ><mp-dialog v-model:open="archiveOpen" title="确认归档项目" :footer="false"
        ><mp-space direction="column" block
          ><mp-cell>将归档所选项目。项目、任务和操作记录会保留，可在“已归档”筛选中恢复。</mp-cell
          ><mp-space wrap
            ><mp-button status="warning" @click="confirmArchive">确认归档</mp-button
            ><mp-button @click="archiveOpen = false">取消归档</mp-button></mp-space
          ></mp-space
        ></mp-dialog
      ></template
    ></mp-space
  >
</template>
<style scoped>
.practice-page {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.practice-page :deep(.mp-grid-item) {
  min-width: 0;
}
.practice-page :deep(.mp-grid) {
  width: 100%;
}
.practice-page :deep(.mp-space__item) {
  min-width: 0;
}
</style>
```

## 移动端业务适配

全部使用 Maple 自有组件。手机列表使用可选择的项目卡片，资料使用 Cell 展示，选择与日期使用 Popup。任务、跟进、收藏、归档和草稿在这些页面间共享，刷新保留当前浏览器会话数据。

业务数据在 `practices-examples/shared/usePracticeData.js` 中；示例使用合成数据，不访问真实业务接口。归档可恢复，重置会还原整个工作区。

# 分步表单页

基础资料、计划预算、核对提交、办理结果四阶段。

## 完整业务体验

先提交空资料查看校验；填写名称和负责人，设置计划与预算。保存草稿后离开并回来恢复；确认页模拟失败并重试，成功后点击“查看项目详情”。新项目同时进入列表、卡片和工作台。

Example source: docs/practices-examples/form/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { projectError, usePracticeData } from '../shared/usePracticeData.js'
import { usePracticeNavigation } from '../shared/usePracticeNavigation.js'

const data = usePracticeData()
const {
  workspace,
  rows,
  projects,
  favorites,
  activity,
  savedDraft,
  latest,
  query,
  applied,
  current,
  selected,
  notice,
  statusOptions,
  categories,
  categoryOptions,
  priorities,
  filtered,
  pageRows,
  done,
  budget,
  overdue,
  active,
  detailOpen,
  createOpen,
  archiveOpen,
  editingKey,
  draft,
  fresh,
  search,
  clear,
  show,
  finish,
  finishSelected,
  startCreate,
  startEdit,
  create,
  requestArchive,
  confirmArchive,
  restore,
  favorite,
  reset,
  exportCsv,
} = data
const { route, go, href } = usePracticeNavigation()
const required = [(value) => !!value?.trim() || '此项不能为空']
const money = (value) => Number(value).toLocaleString('zh-CN', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })
const step = ref(0)
const failNext = ref(false)
const committed = ref(null)
const formMessage = ref(
  savedDraft.value ? '存在可恢复草稿，可先恢复继续办理。' : '填写基础信息后，设置计划与预算，再核对提交。',
)
function next({ errors } = {}) {
  if (errors) {
    formMessage.value = '请补全必填项。'
    return
  }
  if (step.value === 1 && projectError(draft.value)) {
    formMessage.value = projectError(draft.value)
    return
  }
  step.value++
  formMessage.value = step.value === 2 ? '请确认全部资料，返回修改不会生成项目。' : '设置项目执行计划。'
}
function saveDraft() {
  savedDraft.value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(draft.value))
  formMessage.value = '草稿已保存，切换页面或刷新后仍可恢复。'
}
function restoreDraft() {
  if (savedDraft.value) {
    draft.value = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(savedDraft.value))
    step.value = 0
    formMessage.value = '已恢复上次保存的草稿。'
  }
}
function submit() {
  if (failNext.value) {
    failNext.value = false
    formMessage.value = '模拟保存失败，草稿已保留，请重试提交。'
    return
  }
  const row = workspace.save(draft.value)
  if (!row) {
    formMessage.value = projectError(draft.value)
    return
  }
  committed.value = row
  savedDraft.value = null
  step.value = 3
  formMessage.value = '项目已创建，列表、卡片和工作台已同步。'
}
function resetForm() {
  step.value = 0
  draft.value = fresh()
  committed.value = null
  failNext.value = false
  formMessage.value = '已清空当前表单，工作区里的项目不受影响。'
}
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space class="practice-page" direction="column" block size="lg"
    ><mp-page-header title="创建项目申请" subtitle="基础资料 → 计划预算 → 核对提交 → 办理完成" :show-back="false"
      ><template #extra
        ><mp-space wrap><mp-button @click="resetForm">清空当前表单</mp-button></mp-space></template
      ></mp-page-header
    ><mp-space wrap size="sm"
      ><mp-button @click="go('dashboard')">工作台</mp-button><mp-button @click="go('list')">项目列表</mp-button
      ><mp-button @click="go('card')">卡片视图</mp-button
      ><mp-button status="primary" @click="go('form')">创建申请</mp-button></mp-space
    ><mp-card
      ><mp-steps :model-value="step + 1"
        ><mp-step>基础资料</mp-step><mp-step>计划预算</mp-step><mp-step>核对提交</mp-step
        ><mp-step>办理完成</mp-step></mp-steps
      ></mp-card
    ><mp-card v-if="step === 0" title="基础资料"
      ><mp-form :model="draft" layout="vertical" @submit="next"
        ><mp-grid :cols="{ xs: 1, md: 2 }" :col-gap="16" :row-gap="8"
          ><mp-grid-item
            ><mp-form-item label="项目名称" field="name" :rules="required" feedback
              ><mp-input v-model="draft.name" edit-mode="direct" placeholder="项目名称" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
          ><mp-grid-item
            ><mp-form-item label="负责人" field="owner" :rules="required" feedback
              ><mp-input v-model="draft.owner" edit-mode="direct" placeholder="负责人" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
          ><mp-grid-item
            ><mp-form-item label="业务类型" field="category"
              ><mp-select
                v-model="draft.category"
                :options="categories"
                edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
          ><mp-grid-item
            ><mp-form-item label="优先级" field="priority"
              ><mp-select
                v-model="draft.priority"
                :options="priorities"
                edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item></mp-grid
        ><mp-space wrap
          ><mp-button html-type="submit" status="primary">下一步：计划预算</mp-button
          ><mp-button @click="saveDraft">保存草稿</mp-button
          ><mp-button :disabled="!savedDraft" @click="restoreDraft">恢复草稿</mp-button></mp-space
        ></mp-form
      ></mp-card
    ><mp-card v-else-if="step === 1" title="计划与预算"
      ><mp-form :model="draft" layout="vertical" @submit="next"
        ><mp-grid :cols="{ xs: 1, md: 2 }" :col-gap="16" :row-gap="8"
          ><mp-grid-item
            ><mp-form-item label="开始日期" field="startDate"
              ><mp-date
                v-model="draft.startDate"
                value-format="YYYY-MM-DD"
                edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
          ><mp-grid-item
            ><mp-form-item label="截止日期" field="dueDate"
              ><mp-date
                v-model="draft.dueDate"
                value-format="YYYY-MM-DD"
                edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
          ><mp-grid-item
            ><mp-form-item label="项目预算（元）" field="budget"
              ><mp-input-number
                v-model="draft.budget"
                :min="0"
                :precision="2"
                edit-mode="direct" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item></mp-grid
        ><mp-form-item label="项目说明" field="description"
          ><mp-textarea
            v-model="draft.description"
            edit-mode="direct"
            placeholder="项目目标、交付物和验收要求" /></mp-form-item
        ><mp-space wrap
          ><mp-button html-type="submit" status="primary">下一步：核对提交</mp-button
          ><mp-button @click="step = 0">上一步</mp-button><mp-button @click="saveDraft">保存草稿</mp-button></mp-space
        ></mp-form
      ></mp-card
    ><mp-card v-else-if="step === 2" title="核对项目申请"
      ><mp-space direction="column" block
        ><mp-cell>项目：{{ draft.name }} · 负责人：{{ draft.owner }}</mp-cell
        ><mp-cell
          >类型：{{ draft.category }} · 优先级：{{ draft.priority }} · 预算：{{ money(draft.budget) }} 元</mp-cell
        ><mp-cell>执行计划：{{ draft.startDate || '待安排' }} 至 {{ draft.dueDate || '待安排' }}</mp-cell
        ><mp-cell>项目说明：{{ draft.description || '未填写' }}</mp-cell
        ><mp-checkbox v-model="failNext">模拟本次提交失败</mp-checkbox
        ><mp-space wrap
          ><mp-button status="primary" @click="submit">{{
            formMessage.includes('失败') ? '重试提交' : '确认创建项目'
          }}</mp-button
          ><mp-button @click="step = 0">返回修改</mp-button></mp-space
        ></mp-space
      ></mp-card
    ><mp-card v-else
      ><mp-result status="success" title="项目已创建" :subtitle="committed.key + ' · ' + committed.name"
        ><template #extra
          ><mp-space wrap
            ><mp-button status="primary" @click="go('detail', { project: committed.key })">查看项目详情</mp-button
            ><mp-button @click="go('list')">返回项目列表</mp-button
            ><mp-button @click="resetForm">继续创建</mp-button></mp-space
          ></template
        ></mp-result
      ></mp-card
    ><mp-cell role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ formMessage }}</mp-cell></mp-space
  >
</template>
<style scoped>
.practice-page {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.practice-page :deep(.mp-grid-item) {
  min-width: 0;
}
.practice-page :deep(.mp-grid) {
  width: 100%;
}
.practice-page :deep(.mp-space__item) {
  min-width: 0;
}
</style>
```

# 查询列表页

组合筛选、分页、编辑、交付、批量归档、恢复与 CSV 导出。

## 完整业务体验

按关键词、类型和状态组合查询；编辑项目后查看详情；归档所选项目，再勾选“查看已归档项目”并查询，恢复记录。导出的是当前筛选结果。

Example source: docs/practices-examples/list/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { projectError, usePracticeData } from '../shared/usePracticeData.js'
import { usePracticeNavigation } from '../shared/usePracticeNavigation.js'

const data = usePracticeData()
const {
  workspace,
  rows,
  projects,
  favorites,
  activity,
  savedDraft,
  latest,
  query,
  applied,
  current,
  selected,
  notice,
  statusOptions,
  categories,
  categoryOptions,
  priorities,
  filtered,
  pageRows,
  done,
  budget,
  overdue,
  active,
  detailOpen,
  createOpen,
  archiveOpen,
  editingKey,
  draft,
  fresh,
  search,
  clear,
  show,
  finish,
  finishSelected,
  startCreate,
  startEdit,
  create,
  requestArchive,
  confirmArchive,
  restore,
  favorite,
  reset,
  exportCsv,
} = data
const { route, go, href } = usePracticeNavigation()
const required = [(value) => !!value?.trim() || '此项不能为空']
const money = (value) => Number(value).toLocaleString('zh-CN', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })
const columns = [
  { title: '项目 / 编号', slotName: 'project' },
  { title: '负责人', dataIndex: 'owner' },
  { title: '进度与状态', slotName: 'state' },
  { title: '预算', slotName: 'budget' },
  { title: '截止日期', dataIndex: 'dueDate' },
  { title: '操作', slotName: 'actions' },
]
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space class="practice-page" direction="column" block size="lg"
    ><mp-page-header title="项目管理" subtitle="统一查询、编辑、交付与归档的项目台账" :show-back="false"
      ><template #extra
        ><mp-space wrap
          ><mp-button @click="exportCsv">导出查询结果</mp-button><mp-button @click="reset">重置工作区</mp-button
          ><mp-button status="primary" @click="startCreate">快速新建</mp-button></mp-space
        ></template
      ></mp-page-header
    ><mp-space wrap size="sm"
      ><mp-button @click="go('dashboard')">工作台</mp-button><mp-button @click="go('list')">项目列表</mp-button
      ><mp-button @click="go('card')">卡片视图</mp-button
      ><mp-button status="primary" @click="go('form')">创建申请</mp-button></mp-space
    ><mp-cell>本地演示工作区 · 各页面共享数据，刷新保留本次会话。归档可恢复，重置会还原整个工作区。</mp-cell
    ><mp-grid :cols="{ xs: 2, md: 4 }" :col-gap="16" :row-gap="16"
      ><mp-grid-item
        ><mp-card><mp-statistic title="在管项目" :value="projects.length" /></mp-card></mp-grid-item
      ><mp-grid-item
        ><mp-card><mp-statistic title="已交付" :value="done" /></mp-card></mp-grid-item
      ><mp-grid-item
        ><mp-card><mp-statistic title="逾期待处理" :value="overdue" /></mp-card></mp-grid-item
      ><mp-grid-item
        ><mp-card
          ><mp-statistic
            title="预算合计（元）"
            :value="budget"
            show-group-separator /></mp-card></mp-grid-item></mp-grid
    ><mp-card title="项目筛选"
      ><mp-form :model="query" layout="vertical" @submit="search"
        ><mp-grid :cols="{ xs: 1, md: 3 }" :col-gap="16" :row-gap="8"
          ><mp-grid-item
            ><mp-form-item label="关键词"
              ><mp-input
                v-model="query.keyword"
                placeholder="项目、编号、负责人或类型"
                edit-mode="direct"
                clearable /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
          ><mp-grid-item
            ><mp-form-item label="项目状态"
              ><mp-select
                v-model="query.status"
                :options="statusOptions"
                edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
          ><mp-grid-item
            ><mp-form-item label="业务类型"
              ><mp-select
                v-model="query.category"
                :options="categoryOptions"
                edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item></mp-grid
        ><mp-space wrap
          ><mp-checkbox v-model="query.archived" edit-mode="direct">查看已归档项目</mp-checkbox
          ><mp-checkbox v-model="query.favorites" edit-mode="direct">仅看收藏</mp-checkbox
          ><mp-button html-type="submit" status="primary">查询项目</mp-button
          ><mp-button @click="clear">清空筛选</mp-button></mp-space
        ></mp-form
      ></mp-card
    ><mp-card title="项目台账"
      ><template #title-action
        ><mp-space wrap
          ><mp-button :disabled="!selected.length || applied.archived" @click="finishSelected"
            >交付选中（{{ selected.length }}）</mp-button
          ><mp-button :disabled="!selected.length || applied.archived" @click="requestArchive([...selected])"
            >归档选中</mp-button
          ></mp-space
        ></template
      ><mp-space direction="column" block
        ><mp-card
          v-for="row in pageRows"
          :key="row.key"
          :title="row.name"
          :subtitle="row.key"
          :description="row.owner + ' · ' + row.category"
          ><template #title-action
            ><mp-checkbox
              :model-value="selected.includes(row.key)"
              :aria-label="`选择${row.name}`"
              @update:model-value="
                (checked) => (selected = checked ? [...selected, row.key] : selected.filter((key) => key !== row.key))
              " /></template
          ><mp-space direction="column" block
            ><mp-space wrap
              ><mp-tag>{{ row.status }}</mp-tag
              ><mp-tag>{{ row.priority }}优先级</mp-tag></mp-space
            ><mp-progress :percent="row.progress" /><mp-cell title="截止日期">{{ row.dueDate || '未设置' }}</mp-cell
            ><mp-cell title="预算">{{ money(row.budget) }} 元</mp-cell></mp-space
          ><template #footer
            ><mp-space wrap
              ><mp-button size="sm" @click="go('detail', { project: row.key })">详情</mp-button
              ><mp-button v-if="!row.archived" size="sm" @click="startEdit(row)">编辑</mp-button
              ><mp-button v-if="!row.archived" size="sm" :disabled="row.status === '已完成'" @click="finish(row)"
                >交付</mp-button
              ><mp-button v-if="row.archived" size="sm" @click="restore(row)">恢复</mp-button
              ><mp-button v-else size="sm" @click="requestArchive([row.key])">归档</mp-button></mp-space
            ></template
          ></mp-card
        ></mp-space
      ><mp-empty v-if="!filtered.length" description="没有匹配项目，清空筛选可恢复结果" /><template #footer
        ><mp-pagination v-model="current" :total="filtered.length" :page-size="4" /></template></mp-card
    ><mp-cell role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ notice }}</mp-cell
    ><mp-dialog
      v-model:open="createOpen"
      :title="editingKey ? '编辑项目资料' : '快速创建项目'"
      :footer="false"
      :unmount-on-close="true"
      ><mp-form :model="draft" layout="vertical" @submit="create"
        ><mp-grid :cols="{ xs: 1, md: 2 }" :col-gap="16" :row-gap="8"
          ><mp-grid-item
            ><mp-form-item label="项目名称" field="name" :rules="required" feedback
              ><mp-input v-model="draft.name" edit-mode="direct" placeholder="项目名称" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
          ><mp-grid-item
            ><mp-form-item label="负责人" field="owner" :rules="required" feedback
              ><mp-input v-model="draft.owner" edit-mode="direct" placeholder="负责人" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
          ><mp-grid-item
            ><mp-form-item label="业务类型" field="category"
              ><mp-select
                v-model="draft.category"
                :options="categories"
                edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
          ><mp-grid-item

              ><mp-select
                v-model="draft.priority"
                :options="priorities"
                edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item

              ><mp-date
                v-model="draft.startDate"
                value-format="YYYY-MM-DD"
                edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
          ><mp-grid-item

              ><mp-date
                v-model="draft.dueDate"
                value-format="YYYY-MM-DD"
                edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item
          ><mp-grid-item
            ><mp-form-item label="项目预算（元）" field="budget"
              ><mp-input-number
                v-model="draft.budget"
                :min="0"
                :precision="2"
                edit-mode="direct" /></mp-form-item></mp-grid-item></mp-grid
        ><mp-form-item label="项目说明" field="description"
          ><mp-textarea
            v-model="draft.description"
            edit-mode="direct"
            placeholder="项目目标、交付物和验收要求" /></mp-form-item
        ><mp-space wrap
          ><mp-button html-type="submit" status="primary">{{ editingKey ? '保存项目' : '创建项目' }}</mp-button
          ><mp-button @click="createOpen = false">取消</mp-button></mp-space
        ><mp-cell role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ notice }}</mp-cell></mp-form
      ></mp-dialog
    ><mp-dialog v-model:open="archiveOpen" title="确认归档项目" :footer="false"
      ><mp-space direction="column" block
        ><mp-cell>将归档所选项目。项目、任务和操作记录会保留，可在“已归档”筛选中恢复。</mp-cell
        ><mp-space wrap
          ><mp-button status="warning" @click="confirmArchive">确认归档</mp-button
          ><mp-button @click="archiveOpen = false">取消归档</mp-button></mp-space
        ></mp-space
      ></mp-dialog
    ></mp-space
  >
</template>
```

# 结果与异常页

结合最新项目记录提供成功反馈、异常恢复与下一步。

## 完整业务体验

体验服务失败重试、空状态创建申请和项目详情返回；办理成功时可以打开最近创建的真实本地项目。结果类型只用于本地演示，不调用真实业务后端。

Example source: docs/practices-examples/result/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { projectError, usePracticeData } from '../shared/usePracticeData.js'
import { usePracticeNavigation } from '../shared/usePracticeNavigation.js'

const data = usePracticeData()
const {
  workspace,
  rows,
  projects,
  favorites,
  activity,
  savedDraft,
  latest,
  query,
  applied,
  current,
  selected,
  notice,
  statusOptions,
  categories,
  categoryOptions,
  priorities,
  filtered,
  pageRows,
  done,
  budget,
  overdue,
  active,
  detailOpen,
  createOpen,
  archiveOpen,
  editingKey,
  draft,
  fresh,
  search,
  clear,
  show,
  finish,
  finishSelected,
  startCreate,
  startEdit,
  create,
  requestArchive,
  confirmArchive,
  restore,
  favorite,
  reset,
  exportCsv,
} = data
const { route, go, href } = usePracticeNavigation()
const required = [(value) => !!value?.trim() || '此项不能为空']
const money = (value) => Number(value).toLocaleString('zh-CN', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })
const state = ref(String(route.query.state || 'success'))
const retries = ref(0)
const lastProject = computed(() => rows.value.find((row) => row.key === (route.query.project || latest.value)))
const resultOptions = [
  { value: 'success', label: '办理成功' },
  { value: '500', label: '服务异常' },
  { value: '403', label: '无权限访问' },
  { value: '404', label: '项目不存在' },
  { value: 'empty', label: '暂无项目' },
]
const content = computed(
  () =>
    ({
      success: [
        '办理成功',
        lastProject.value
          ? `${lastProject.value.key} · ${lastProject.value.name}`
          : '可返回项目列表，或创建一份新申请。',
      ],
      500: ['保存暂时失败', '这是一种本地演示状态，重试恢复后可继续处理。'],
      403: ['暂时无法访问', '当前演示权限不足，请返回工作台。'],
      404: ['未找到项目', '请从项目列表重新选择，避免使用失效的项目编号。'],
      empty: ['尚未建立项目', '创建一份申请，建立完整的项目与任务清单。'],
    })[state.value] || ['结果类型无效', '请从下方选择一个演示状态。'],
)
function recover() {
  if (state.value === '500') {
    retries.value++
    state.value = 'success'
    notice.value = `重试成功（${retries.value} 次），可以继续处理。`
  } else if (state.value === 'empty') {
    go('form')
  } else {
    go('list')
  }
}
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space class="practice-page" direction="column" block size="lg"
    ><mp-page-header title="办理结果与异常恢复" subtitle="结合实际项目记录提供下一步操作" :show-back="false"
      ><template #extra><mp-space wrap></mp-space></template></mp-page-header
    ><mp-space wrap size="sm"
      ><mp-button @click="go('dashboard')">工作台</mp-button><mp-button @click="go('list')">项目列表</mp-button
      ><mp-button @click="go('card')">卡片视图</mp-button
      ><mp-button status="primary" @click="go('form')">创建申请</mp-button></mp-space
    ><mp-card title="结果体验"
      ><mp-form layout="vertical"
        ><mp-form-item label="演示结果类型"
          ><mp-select v-model="state" :options="resultOptions" edit-mode="popup" /></mp-form-item></mp-form></mp-card
    ><mp-card
      ><mp-result
        :status="resultOptions.some((item) => item.value === state) ? state : 'warning'"
        :title="content[0]"
        :subtitle="content[1]"
        ><template #extra
          ><mp-space wrap
            ><mp-button status="primary" @click="recover">{{
              state === '500' ? '重试处理' : state === 'empty' ? '创建项目申请' : '返回项目列表'
            }}</mp-button
            ><mp-button v-if="state === 'success' && lastProject" @click="go('detail', { project: lastProject.key })"
              >查看最新项目</mp-button
            ><mp-button @click="go('dashboard')">返回工作台</mp-button></mp-space
          ></template
        ></mp-result
      ></mp-card
    ><mp-cell role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ notice }}</mp-cell></mp-space
  >
</template>

  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}

  min-width: 0;
}
.practice-page :deep(.mp-grid) {
  width: 100%;
}
.practice-page :deep(.mp-space__item) {
```

# ProgressGroup

### Introduction

Display multiple values as segments of a single progress track with a matching legend.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

```vue

]
</script>

<template>
```

## Interaction and control

### Overflow and keyboard

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | Segment data | Overflow and keyboard, Custom Content |
| `max` | Total used to calculate each share | Overflow and keyboard, Custom Content |
| `show-text` | Show the summed percentage | Overflow and keyboard, Custom Content |
| `tooltip` | Enable segment hover/focus tips | Overflow and keyboard |
| `aria-label` | Accessible group name | Overflow and keyboard |
| `mode` | Display mode | Overflow and keyboard |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


The demo's parent updates `max`, `items` and `tooltip` for both shapes; these controls are not built-in editing events. Toggle capacity between 100/200, clear/restore data or disable/enable tooltips. Disabling tooltips removes segments from the Tab order, and clearing data removes their tips. Pointer hover takes precedence over keyboard focus; leaving the hovered segment restores the focused segment's tip.

Example source: src/progress-group/example/demos/overflow-keyboard.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const initialItems = [
  { label: 'A', value: 70 },
  { label: 'B', value: 50, color: '#722ed1' },
  { label: 'C', value: 10, color: '#0fc6c2' },
]
const items = ref(initialItems)
const max = ref(100)
const tooltip = ref(true)
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" size="24px" data-demo-capacity>
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button @click="max = max === 100 ? 200 : 100">Capacity: {{ max }}</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="items = items.length ? [] : initialItems">{{
        items.length ? 'Clear data' : 'Restore data'
      }}</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="tooltip = !tooltip">Tooltips: {{ tooltip ? 'on' : 'off' }}</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-progress-group :items="items" :max="max" :tooltip="tooltip" show-text aria-label="Capacity line" />
    <mp-progress-group
      mode="circle"
      :items="items"
      :max="max"
      :tooltip="tooltip"
      show-text
      aria-label="Capacity circle"
    />
    <p aria-live="polite">Items: {{ items.length }}; capacity: {{ max }}; tooltips: {{ tooltip ? 'on' : 'off' }}</p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

Segments are clipped cumulatively at max in both line and circle modes. Legend and tooltip values retain the logical per-item percentages. Non-finite/negative values become zero; invalid max falls back to 100. Focus a visible segment with Tab to show its tooltip; Escape dismisses it. Moving the pointer away does not dismiss a focused segment's tooltip. Use aria-label to name the group.

All five size presets affect line thickness (2/4/8/12/16px), not circle diameter; circle-size and stroke-width control circles. CSS-length circle-size values are supported.

### Custom Content

Example source: src/progress-group/example/demos/custom.vue

```vue
<script setup>
const items = [
  { label: 'System', value: 24, color: '#64748b', tip: 'System · 24 GB' },

]
</script>

<template>
  <mp-progress-group :items="items" :max="128" show-text>
    <template #text="{ value, max }">已使用 {{ value }} / {{ max }} GB</template>
    <template #item-trailing="{ item }">{{ item.value }} GB</template>
    <template #tooltip="{ item, percent }"
      >{{ item.label }} · {{ item.value }} GB · {{ Math.round(percent) }}%</template
    >
  </mp-progress-group>
</template>

```

## Reading direction

Horizontal segments, highlights and hints share the same logical origin. Vertical progress remains top to bottom; rings retain their existing angles and data order.

## Usage notes

### Geometry and motion
Built-in effects respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Track thickness applies to both horizontal and vertical layouts; circle geometry remains prop-driven.


`orientation` controls linear layout only; circle legend arrangement is unchanged. Circle `stroke-width` is a number in the 100×100 SVG coordinate system, not a CSS length. A `text` slot is displayed even when `show-text=false`. When `item.slot` is set, its prefix and `-leading`, `-label`, `-trailing` slots are used; missing dynamic slots use built-in content rather than generic `item-*` slots.

The pointer can enter and remain over the tooltip; after leaving, the focused segment’s tooltip returns. Escape closes it. Tooltip content is descriptive and should not contain interactive form controls.

## API

### ProgressGroup Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| aria-label | Accessible group name | `string` | — |

| orientation | Horizontal/vertical orientation of the linear progress track, default horizontal; only used for mode=line | `horizontal \| vertical` | `horizontal` |

# Progress

Displays determinate or indeterminate task progress.

## Basic examples

### basic-usage

Example source: src/progress/example/demos/basic-usage.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onMounted, onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref(0)
let timer

onMounted(() => {
  timer = window.setInterval(() => {
    if (value.value >= 100) {
      value.value = 0
      return
    }

    value.value += 20
  }, 1000)
})

onUnmounted(() => {
  window.clearInterval(timer)
})
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="['3vh', '3vh']">
    <mp-progress :percent="20" />
    <mp-progress :percent="value" :track="false" show-text />
    <mp-progress :percent="100" show-text>success</mp-progress>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```
