```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import ModelOutput from '../components/ModelOutput.vue'

const editMode = ref('popup')
const readPretty = ref(false)
const layout = ref('horizontal')
const layoutOptions = ['vertical', 'horizontal', 'inline'].map((value) => ({ label: value, value }))

const options = ref([
  { value: 1, label: '研发设备' },
  { value: 2, label: '设计设备' },
  { value: 3, label: '运营设备' },
])
const form = ref({ name: '默认确认后保存', deviceIds: [2], note: '此项始终直接编辑', summary: '只读展示' })
const status = ref('')

const modeOptions = ['direct', 'popup'].map((value) => ({ label: value, value }))
const committed = computed(() => JSON.stringify(form.value))
const presentationHint = computed(() =>
  readPretty.value
    ? '只展示已保存的值；下方“单项覆盖 direct”通过 readPretty=false 保持可编辑。'
    : editMode.value === 'direct'
      ? '直接编辑，即时更新下方模型；选择设备无需额外确认。'
      : '按展示方式进入编辑；确认才更新下方模型，取消不保存本次修改。',
)
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" align="stretch" :size="16">
    <mp-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="Form 展示方式">
      <mp-radio-group v-model="editMode" aria-label="Form 展示方式" :options="modeOptions" variant="button" size="sm" />
    </mp-form-item>
    <mp-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="layout">
      <mp-radio-group v-model="layout" :options="layoutOptions" variant="button" size="sm" />
    </mp-form-item>
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-checkbox v-model="readPretty">纯阅读 readPretty</mp-checkbox>
    </mp-space>
    <p>{{ presentationHint }}<br />前两项继承 Form 展示方式，后两项演示字段局部覆盖。</p>
    <mp-form
      :layout="layout"
      :model="form"
      :edit-mode="editMode"
      :read-pretty="readPretty"
      @submit-success="status = '表单已提交'"
      @submit-failed="status = '请完成当前编辑或修正校验错误'"
    >
      <mp-form-item field="name" label="名称" :rules="[(value) => Boolean(value) || '名称不能为空']">
        <mp-input v-model="form.name" placeholder="请输入名称" clearable />
      </mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item field="deviceIds" label="设备" :rules="[(value) => value.length > 0 || '请选择设备']">

      </mp-form-item>

      </mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item field="summary" label="固定 readPretty" read-pretty>
        <mp-input v-model="form.summary" />
      </mp-form-item>
      <mp-button html-type="submit">提交表单</mp-button>
    </mp-form>
    <ModelOutput role="status">当前模型：{{ committed }}</ModelOutput>
    <p v-if="status" role="status">{{ status }}</p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

# Loading and waiting

Explore an event registration workspace. Try each component, hold all loading states, or start a two-second local wait. Labels in the live scenario are currently in Chinese.

1. Fill in registration information or use the button on its card to start a two-second wait.
2. Enable “全部保持加载” to compare every visible indicator; “重置加载” restores the state without clearing input.
3. Toggle editing independently, then compare default indicators and bottom lines on decorated fields.
4. Open the confirmation dialog to observe before-close feedback, including a rejected close.

```vue
    component: markRaw(MpTag),
    title: '参与者身份',
    description: '标签状态更新',
    props: {},
    text: '体验官',
    lockable: true,
  },
]
const groups = [
  { title: '01 · 填写与数据选择', cards: fieldCards },
  { title: '02 · 提交与状态操作', cards: actionCards },
]
const held = ref(false)
const lock = ref(false)
const line = ref(false)
const pending = reactive<Record<string, boolean>>({})
const completed = reactive<Record<string, boolean>>({})
const timers = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>()
const ids = [...fieldCards, ...actionCards]
  .map((card) => card.id)
  .concat(['table', 'list', 'skeleton', 'loading', 'popup', 'swipe-cell', 'tab-bar'])

const busyCount = computed(() => ids.filter((id) => isLoading(id)).length)
const status = ref('点击卡片上的「体验等待」，对照加载与恢复。')
function isLoading(id: string) {
  return held.value || Boolean(pending[id])
}
function run(id: string) {
  if (held.value || pending[id]) {
    return
  }
  pending[id] = true
  completed[id] = false
  status.value = `${id} 正在等待；2 秒后恢复。`
  timers.set(
    id,
    setTimeout(() => {
      pending[id] = false
      completed[id] = true
      timers.delete(id)
      status.value = `${id} 已完成，输入内容保留。`
    }, 2000),
  )
}
function runAll() {
  held.value = false
  ids.forEach(run)
}
function reset() {
  held.value = false
  timers.forEach((timer) => clearTimeout(timer))
  timers.clear()
  ids.forEach((id) => {
    pending[id] = false
    completed[id] = false
  })
  status.value = '已恢复全部加载状态，填写内容保留。'
}
const openPopup = ref(false)
const open = ref(false)
const allowClose = ref(true)
const guardStatus = ref('打开报名确认，关闭时等待 2 秒。')
const guardWaits = new Map<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>, (allowed: boolean) => void>()
function beforeClose() {
  guardStatus.value = '正在检查报名状态…'
  return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      guardWaits.delete(timer)
      guardStatus.value = allowClose.value ? '检查通过，允许关闭。' : '本次未通过，弹层保留，可再次尝试。'
      resolve(allowClose.value)
    }, 2000)
    guardWaits.set(timer, resolve)
  })
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  reset()
  guardWaits.forEach((resolve, timer) => {
    clearTimeout(timer)
    resolve(false)
  })
  guardWaits.clear()
})

    </section>
  </div>
</template>
```

This page focuses on input surfaces, data selection, actions and content loading. Ordinary events do not collect Promises. Upload keeps per-file progress and before-hook feedback; Scheduler persistence guards are documented on its own page.

## More before-hook scenarios

### Upload

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const files = ref([])
const beforeRead = (file) => file.size <= 1024 * 1024
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <p>仅允许读取不超过 1 MB 的文件。</p>

  </div>
```

# 最佳实践

Example source: docs/practices-examples/overview.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { usePracticeData } from './shared/usePracticeData.js'
import { usePracticeNavigation } from './shared/usePracticeNavigation.js'

const { projects, done, overdue, savedDraft } = usePracticeData()
const { go } = usePracticeNavigation()

const route = useRoute()
const router = useRouter()
const pages = [
  {
    slug: 'dashboard',
    title: '团队工作台',
    doc: 'practiceDashboard',
    summary: '范围筛选、指标联动、待办完成与详情查看。',
  },

  { slug: 'card', title: '项目卡片页', doc: 'practiceCard', summary: '响应式项目空间、筛选、收藏、新建与详情。' },
  {
    slug: 'detail',
    title: '业务详情页',
    doc: 'practiceDetail',
    summary: '动态项目资料、交付任务、进度、跟进与可恢复归档。',
  },
  { slug: 'form', title: '分步表单页', doc: 'practiceForm', summary: '必填校验、草稿恢复、信息确认、失败重试与结果。' },
  {
    slug: 'result',
    title: '结果与异常页',
    doc: 'practiceResult',
    summary: '成功、服务失败、无权限、页面丢失和空结果。',
  },
]
function open(page) {
  router.push(`/${route.path.startsWith('/en-US/') ? 'en-US' : 'zh-CN'}/${page.doc}`)
}
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" block size="lg"
    ><mp-page-header
      title="常用业务页面"
      subtitle="从查询、创建到处理与反馈，全部使用自有组件"
      :show-back="false"

          ></mp-card

      ></mp-grid

        >以项目协作为同一业务背景，演示真实的查询、校验、取消、提交和恢复。所有页面共享项目台账与操作记录，刷新保留会话数据，归档可恢复。</mp-cell
      ></mp-card
```

# Core features

> Feature descriptions and example labels on this page are currently in Chinese.

Maple 的特点既体现在单个组件，也体现在跨组件的约定和业务流程中。这里整理了 20 个有现有示例支撑的展示点，覆盖 体系级特点、场景组合能力、交互与数据特点、业务组件特点、移动端特点、工程保障。

## 演示时先讲什么

- **跨组件一致性**：一起切换输入、选择和日期字段的尺寸、变体，观察一组字段如何遵循共同约定。
- **阅读与编辑闭环**：修改、取消、确认及拒绝后重试，核对临时输入与已保存数据。
- **业务数据接入**：从 ID 回显、搜索候选到人员操作，展示字段如何连接业务模型与服务。
- **移动触控组合**：体验滑动关闭确认、刷新及安全区，检查触控操作与移动容器的配合。

以下属于本库的设计取向、已实现能力和工程保障。是否比某个参考库更省配置或体验更好，需要在逐组件页中按同一业务任务验证。

## 体系级特点

### 桌面与移动沿用同一套公共约定

公共尺寸、变体、值绑定与主题语言对齐，端侧密度和操作形态分别适配。

演示方法：使用同一巡检任务：Cedar 在字段附近操作；Maple 的选择与日期时间进入 Popup。先取消，再确认，对照已提交模型。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/form#zhuo1mian4yu3yi2dong4de0tong2chang3jing3zhan3shi4) · 相关组件：[Button 按钮](#/en-US/button)、[Input 输入框](#/en-US/input)、[Select 下拉框](#/en-US/select)、[Form 表单](#/en-US/form)

### 主题从品牌延伸到组件与局部覆盖

品牌、语义颜色与组件变量分层，亮暗模式和局部覆盖可以组合使用。

演示方法：切换品牌和亮暗，再比较默认按钮与局部覆盖按钮，随后打开字段弹层。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/themes) · 相关组件：[ThemeProvider](#/en-US/theme-provider)、[Button 按钮](#/en-US/button)、[FieldDecorator 字段外壳](#/en-US/field-decorator)

### 跨控件保持字段外观与几何一致

Input、Select、日期时间字段通过共同外壳组织尺寸、变体、前后缀和清除区域。

演示方法：一次切换尺寸与变体，对照普通、有值、多选长标签和日期范围字段。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/field-decorator#biao3dan1kong4jian4chi3cun4dui4zhao4) · 相关组件：[FieldDecorator 字段外壳](#/en-US/field-decorator)、[Input 输入框](#/en-US/input)、[Textarea 文本域](#/en-US/textarea)、[Select 下拉框](#/en-US/select)、[Cascader 级联选择](#/en-US/cascader)、[Date 日期字段](#/en-US/date)、[Time 时间字段](#/en-US/time)、[Button 按钮](#/en-US/button)

### 同一字段承接阅读与编辑

Form、FormItem 与字段可继承阅读展示和编辑方式，字段可以覆盖父级配置。

演示方法：切换阅读态、直接编辑和确认后提交，再查看单项覆盖。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/form) · 相关组件：[Form 表单](#/en-US/form)、[Input 输入框](#/en-US/input)、[Textarea 文本域](#/en-US/textarea)、[InputNumber 数字输入框](#/en-US/input-number)、[Select 下拉框](#/en-US/select)、[PeopleSelect 人员选择](#/en-US/people-select)、[Date 日期字段](#/en-US/date)、[Time 时间字段](#/en-US/time)、[Upload 上传](#/en-US/upload)

### 日期时间字段和独立面板分别使用

带触发器的字段与可嵌入的面板分层，单值、范围和提交规则按公开契约接入。

演示方法：对照带输入框的字段与内嵌面板，检查手输、取消和确认后的值。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/date#zi4duan4shi4kou3yu3kuai4jie2xiang4shi4jian4) · 相关组件：[Date 日期字段](#/en-US/date)、[DateRange 日期范围字段](#/en-US/date-range)、[Time 时间字段](#/en-US/time)、[TimeRange 时间范围字段](#/en-US/time-range)

## 场景组合能力

### 筛选、行操作和统计来自同一份业务数据

条件查询、状态变更、空结果与统计联动，桌面表格与移动表格使用同一任务场景。

演示方法：查询运营部 → 完成任务 → 按状态过滤 → 空结果 → 清空筛选并恢复任务。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/table#ren4wu0shai1xuan3yu3shu4ju4lian2dong4) · 相关组件：[Table 表格](#/en-US/table)、[Input 输入框](#/en-US/input)、[Select 下拉框](#/en-US/select)

业务流程示例使用本地数据与模拟保存，不代表组件内置业务后端。

### 从字段校验走到确认、失败与恢复

把 Form 校验、预览和保存状态组合为业务流程，失败保留草稿，提交记录独立保存。

演示方法：空值校验 → 填入数据 → 返回修改 → 模拟失败 → 重试成功 → 查看提交记录。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/form#xun2jian3ren4wu0wan2zheng3liu2cheng2) · 相关组件：[Form 表单](#/en-US/form)、[Input 输入框](#/en-US/input)、[Select 下拉框](#/en-US/select)

业务流程示例使用本地数据与模拟保存，不代表组件内置业务后端。

## 交互与数据特点

### 编辑过程具有草稿、确认和失败恢复语义

编辑过程区分临时输入与已保存值，确认失败时可以保留内容供用户修正。

演示方法：修改后取消，再模拟拒绝确认并重试；观察最终模型和仍在编辑的内容。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/form#jin4yong4、zhi1du2yu3yi4bu4que4ren4) · 相关组件：[Form 表单](#/en-US/form)、[Input 输入框](#/en-US/input)、[Select 下拉框](#/en-US/select)、[Date 日期字段](#/en-US/date)、[Time 时间字段](#/en-US/time)

Cedar 的 click/dblclick 原位编辑还包含字段切换与面板键盘优先级；Maple 按自身弹层交互演示。

### 候选高亮、搜索词、草稿与业务值分开

打开或搜索候选时不应意外提交表单，选择和确认按字段展示方式更新模型。

演示方法：先打开、搜索和移动候选，再选择与确认，对照更新次数与真实事件。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/select#hou4xuan3gao1liang4yu3biao3dan1shu4ju4liu2) · 相关组件：[Select 下拉框](#/en-US/select)、[AutoComplete 自动补全](#/en-US/auto-complete)、[PeopleSelect 人员选择](#/en-US/people-select)、[Cascader 级联选择](#/en-US/cascader)、[Form 表单](#/en-US/form)

### 远程搜索与已选 ID 回显分工

候选获取和已选内容解析分别接入业务服务，处理异步状态与过期结果。

演示方法：从仅有 ID 的模型开始，展示名称回显，再连续切换搜索词。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/people-select) · 相关组件：[Select 下拉框](#/en-US/select)、[PeopleSelect 人员选择](#/en-US/people-select)、[AutoComplete 自动补全](#/en-US/auto-complete)

### 数值显示格式与业务数字分离

formatter / parser 处理展示与解析，精度、步长及边界共同约束最终数值。

演示方法：输入带格式的值，再尝试小数步长和边界，观察模型中保存的数字。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/input-number#xiao3bu4chang2yu3fan4wei2bian1jie4) · 相关组件：[InputNumber 数字输入框](#/en-US/input-number)、[Form 表单](#/en-US/form)

模型仍为 JavaScript number；不将十进制计算等同于任意精度的大数存储。

### 上传准备与取消竞争有明确处理

异步准备、取消、重试和迟到请求句柄之间隔离失效结果，文件替换后重新检查限制。

演示方法：等待准备时取消并重新提交，再放行旧结果，核对有效请求与文件状态。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/upload#shang4chuan2qian2zhun3bei4yu3qu3xiao1jing4zheng1) · 相关组件：[Upload 上传](#/en-US/upload)

### 浮层开合、异步关闭和焦点按职责处理

弹层的展示控制、异步确认及焦点恢复与业务保存逻辑配合，嵌套时按当前层操作。

演示方法：在弹层内打开字段面板，尝试 Esc 和拒绝关闭，再核对焦点返回。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/popup#shi4jian4) · 相关组件：[Dialog 对话框](#/en-US/dialog)、[弹出层](#/en-US/popup)、[Popover 气泡卡片](#/en-US/popover)、[Trigger 浮层触发](#/en-US/trigger)

## 业务组件特点

### 人员字段可以连接业务操作

人员显示与选择复用统一字段行为；头像与操作区由业务提供，不绑定聊天 SDK。

演示方法：同一人员 ID 在编辑字段和阅读字段中联动，并触发示例业务操作。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/people-select) · 相关组件：[PeopleSelect 人员选择](#/en-US/people-select)、[Form 表单](#/en-US/form)

### 文件读取、准备、请求和展示可分别接入

不配置上传接口时可以只读取文件；请求、进度和自定义展示按业务需要组合。

演示方法：先选择本地文件，再展示手动提交、外部进度与独立 hook。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/upload#shou3dong4dui4lie4he2ke3qu3xiao1qing3qiu2) · 相关组件：[Upload 上传](#/en-US/upload)

## 移动端特点

### 滑动操作包含关闭确认和取消处理

SwipeCell 为左右操作区、关闭前确认和拖动取消提供专门的触控场景。

演示方法：左右滑动并尝试拒绝关闭，再通过可见按钮完成同一操作。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/swipe-cell#guan1bi4qian2que4ren4) · 相关组件：[滑动单元格](#/en-US/swipe-cell)

### 刷新、滚动与内容定位有专用组件

下拉刷新、无限加载和分组索引分别处理移动内容的刷新与定位。

演示方法：下拉刷新结束后再次操作；再对照无限加载和分组索引入口。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/pull-refresh#ji1ben3shi3yong4) · 相关组件：[下拉刷新 PullRefresh](#/en-US/pull-refresh)、[InfiniteScroll 无限滚动](#/en-US/infinite-scroll)、[索引栏](#/en-US/index-bar)

### 安全区与底部操作区可以组合

安全区留白与弹层、底部栏等组件联动，覆盖嵌套和应用容器接入。

演示方法：切换安全区模拟条件，观察底部按钮及嵌套区域的留白。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/safe-area#di3bu4liu2bai2yu3qian4tao4) · 相关组件：[SafeArea 安全区](#/en-US/safe-area)、[弹出层](#/en-US/popup)、[底部标签栏](#/en-US/tab-bar)、[浮动面板](#/en-US/floating-panel)

## 工程保障

### 部分稳定逻辑可以脱离默认界面复用

useUploader 提供独立文件处理逻辑，可以接入自定义界面与请求服务。

演示方法：展开 useUploader 示例，查看模型、文件校验与自定义请求如何连接。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/upload#shang4chuan2qian2zhun3bei4yu3qu3xiao1jing4zheng1) · 相关组件：[Upload 上传](#/en-US/upload)

### 复杂交互明确考虑停用、卸载与过期任务

对选择请求、计时、拖动和滚动等异步过程提供生命周期示例与相应检查。

演示方法：启动操作后改变状态或停用实例，再恢复并重新操作，观察旧任务是否干扰。

[打开对应示例](#/en-US/select#jiao1hu4diao4du4sheng1ming4zhou1qi1) · 相关组件：[Select 下拉框](#/en-US/select)、[Search 搜索框](#/en-US/search)、[Upload 上传](#/en-US/upload)、[Countdown 倒计时](#/en-US/countdown)

## 继续逐项比较

# Themes and branding

Some scenario descriptions and demo labels are currently in Chinese. Component messages follow the selected site language.

比较品牌表单和局部主题覆盖，再从站点主题菜单切换亮暗。

# Mobile touch interactions

Some scenario descriptions and demo labels are currently in Chinese. Component messages follow the selected site language.

尝试下拉刷新和滑动操作。触屏设备与鼠标模拟应分别体验；滑动操作同时提供页面中的可见操作入口。

## 下拉刷新：等待与恢复

向下拉动至触发阈值，松手后等待刷新完成；再重复一次观察状态是否恢复。

Example source: src/pull-refresh/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from 'vue'

const data1 = Array(30).fill('列表项')
const data2 = Array(30).fill('新的列表项')
const isRefresh = ref(false)
const data = ref(data1)
let refreshTimer

function cancelRefresh() {
  clearTimeout(refreshTimer)
  refreshTimer = undefined
  isRefresh.value = false
}
onBeforeUnmount(cancelRefresh)
onDeactivated(cancelRefresh)

function refresh() {
  clearTimeout(refreshTimer)
  refreshTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    refreshTimer = undefined
    data.value = data.value[0] === '列表项' ? data2 : data1
    isRefresh.value = false
  }, 2000)
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="pull-refresh-demo__scroller">
    <mp-pull-refresh v-model="isRefresh" :success-duration="2000" @refresh="refresh">
      <mp-cell v-for="(item, index) in data" :key="index" border> {{ item }} {{ index + 1 }} </mp-cell>
    </mp-pull-refresh>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.pull-refresh-demo__scroller {
  height: 360px;
  overflow: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}
</style>
```

# Signature

### Intro

Signature component based on `Canvas`.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

Get the data url of the canvas through the component method `confirm`. When the canvas is empty, you will get the `empty string`.

Example source: src/signature/example/demos/en-US/basic-usage.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const signature = ref('')
const signatureRef = ref()
function confirmSignature() {
  signature.value = signatureRef.value.confirm()
}
function resetSignature() {
  signature.value = ''
  signatureRef.value.reset()
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-signature ref="signatureRef" />
  <mp-space class="gap">
    <mp-button status="primary" @click="confirmSignature">Confirm</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" @click="resetSignature">Reset</mp-button>
  </mp-space>
  <img v-if="signature" class="gap" :src="signature" />
</template>

<style scoped>
.gap {
  margin-top: 10px !important;
}
</style>
```

## Customization and slots

### Custom Style

You can customize the signature style through `stroke-style` and `line-width`. The default `stroke-style` is `currentColor`, which will inherit the text color, so you can also set the color through `css color`.

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const customStyleSignature = ref('')
const customStyleSignatureRef = ref()

  customStyleSignature.value = customStyleSignatureRef.value.confirm()
}
function clearCustomStyleSignature() {
  customStyleSignature.value = ''
  customStyleSignatureRef.value.reset()
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-signature ref="customStyleSignatureRef" style="color: var(--mp-sys-color-content-primary)" :line-width="4" />
  <mp-space class="gap">
    <mp-button status="primary" @click="confirmCustomStyleSignature">Confirm</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" @click="clearCustomStyleSignature">Reset</mp-button>
  </mp-space>
  <img v-if="customStyleSignature" :src="customStyleSignature" class="gap" />
</template>

<style scoped>
.gap {
  margin-top: 10px !important;
}
</style>
```

## Drawing sessions

### Writing-session cancellation

A stroke belongs to its initiating single touch identifier. Extra contacts do not restart it; moves/end events from unrelated contacts and events older than the current start cannot take it over. Native `touchcancel`, reset, KeepAlive deactivation, unmount, owner-window blur, a hidden owner document, and the existing resize reset end an active session exactly once. Ordinary release also emits one `end`; cleanup without a stroke does not manufacture an event. After cancellation/reactivation, moving an old contact cannot resume writing: a fresh `touchstart` is required.

`end` means interaction ended, including cancellation; it is not a save/validation task. Cancellation retains already drawn ink, while explicit reset clears it before notifying `end`. Ordinary event handler return Promises are not awaited. The demo schedules business-owned reset/pause from a start notification and clears its timer when the session ends; it does not dispatch fake browser cancellation events. See the size and export contract below.

Example source: src/signature/example/demos/session-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue'
import type { SignatureInstance } from '../..'

const pad = ref<SignatureInstance>()
const visible = ref(true)
const nextCleanup = ref<'none' | 'reset' | 'pause'>('none')
const starts = ref(0)
const signs = ref(0)
const ends = ref(0)
const status = ref('触屏落笔后移动；结束事件只表示交互结束 / Draw with touch; end is an interaction notification')
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
function clearPending() {
  if (timer !== undefined) {
    clearTimeout(timer)
  }
  timer = undefined
}
function start() {
  starts.value++
  clearPending()
  const cleanup = nextCleanup.value
  nextCleanup.value = 'none'
  if (cleanup === 'none') {
    status.value = '正在书写 / Writing'
    return
  }
  status.value = '保持触点，1 秒后取消本次交互 / Keep touching; the interaction stops in one second'
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    timer = undefined
    if (cleanup === 'reset') {
      pad.value?.reset()
      status.value = '已重置，需重新落笔 / Reset; a fresh touchstart is required'
    } else {
      visible.value = false
      status.value = '已停用，恢复后需重新落笔 / Paused; resume and start a new stroke'
    }
  }, 1000)
}
function end() {
  ends.value++
  clearPending()
  if (visible.value) {
    status.value = '本次交互已结束 / Interaction ended'
  }
}
function resume() {
  visible.value = true
  status.value = '已恢复，请重新落笔 / Resumed; start a fresh stroke'
}
function resetNow() {
  if (!pad.value) {
    return
  }
  clearPending()
  pad.value.reset()
  status.value = '已重置，需重新落笔 / Reset; a fresh touchstart is required'
}
function arm(cleanup: 'reset' | 'pause') {
  nextCleanup.value = cleanup
  status.value = '下次落笔后等待 1 秒 / Touch down, then wait one second'
}
onBeforeUnmount(clearPending)
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%" :size="16">
    <p>
      先选择自动重置或停用，再用触屏书写并保持触点。后续移动不应延续已取消笔画。Arm a cleanup, then draw and keep the
      contact down; later moves must not resume the canceled stroke.
    </p>
    <KeepAlive>
      <mp-signature
        v-if="visible"
        ref="pad"
        role="img"
        aria-label="签名书写区域 / Signature pad"
        @start="start"
        @signing="signs++"
        @end="end"
      />
    </KeepAlive>
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button @click="arm('reset')">下次自动重置 / Arm reset</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="arm('pause')">下次自动停用 / Arm pause</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="resume">恢复签名区 / Resume pad</mp-button>
      <mp-button :disabled="!visible" @click="resetNow">立即重置 / Reset now</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <p role="status">start: {{ starts }}；signing: {{ signs }}；end: {{ ends }}；{{ status }}</p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Drawing and export boundaries

Input is touch-only; mouse, pen and keyboard drawing are not supported. Provide clear instructions and an accessible alternative, such as uploading an existing signature or a non-canvas signing flow. This component does not determine legal validity. A tap and release draws a round dot; movement starts at the initial point with round caps and joins. Cancellation does not add a dot.

The bitmap follows the container size and device pixel ratio. Existing pixels scale to the new size; a zero-size hidden container keeps its bitmap until it becomes visible again. Repeated scaling can interpolate pixels. ResizeObserver tracks container changes where available; otherwise window resize updates the bitmap. Device-pixel-ratio changes are also applied on window resize.

PNG keeps transparency. JPEG uses a white background, so white ink may be invisible in JPEG. The root CSS background is display-only: it is not included in PNG and does not replace the white JPEG background. `line-width` accepts a finite positive number or parseable numeric string, including values below 1; invalid widths fall back to 2px. `stroke-style` is a Canvas color; `currentColor` is resolved when a stroke starts.

## API

### Signature Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stroke-style` | Canvas stroke style | _string_ | `currentColor` |
| `line-width` | Canvas line width | _string \| number_ | `2` |
| `data-url-type` | Data url type for generating image | _'png' \| 'jpg'_ | `'png'` |

### Signature Events

| Event | Description | Callback arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | Triggered when signing begins | `-` |
| `signing` | Triggered during signature | `-` |
| `end` | Triggered when ending signature | `-` |

### Signature Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reset` | Reset canvas | `-` | `-` |
| `confirm` | Return an image data URL; empty canvas returns an empty string, and an unmounted canvas returns undefined | `-` | `string \| undefined` |

When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

## API

### Skeleton Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | Loading Status Set to `true` to turn on the skeleton | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `animation` | Whether to enable the shimmer animation | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `title` | Whether to display the title | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `card` | Whether to display the card | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `avatar` | Whether to display the avatar | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `fullscreen` | Whether to enable fullscreen mode | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `fullscreen-z-index` | Fullscreen mode z-index | _string \| number_ | `100` |
| `title-width` | Title placeholder width; falls back to the theme variable, `50%` by default | _string \| number_ | `-` |
| `card-height` | Card placeholder height; falls back to the theme variable, `160px` by default | _string \| number_ | `-` |
| `avatar-size` | Avatar placeholder size; falls back to the theme variable, `34px` by default | _string \| number_ | `-` |
| `rows` | The paragraph number of rows | _string \| number_ | `3` |
| `rows-width` | The width of each line of a paragraph | _Array<number \| string>_ | `[]` |

### Skeleton Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | -- | --- |
| `default` | Content not loaded | `-` |
| `template` | Custom loading placeholder | `-` |

The package also exports `SkeletonLine` and `SkeletonShape`, available as `Skeleton.Line` and `Skeleton.Shape` for custom templates.


### SkeletonLine Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` | Row count; non-finite and negative values become zero, fractions are rounded down | _number_ | `1` |
| `widths` | Individual row widths; numbers are pixels | _Array<number \| string>_ | `[]` |
| `line-height` | Line height in pixels | _number_ | `20` |
| `line-spacing` | Line spacing in pixels | _number_ | `15` |

### SkeletonShape Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | Placeholder shape | _'square' \| 'circle'_ | `square` |
| `size` | Placeholder size, controlled by theme variables | _'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'_ | `md` |

Line and Shape have no dedicated events, slots or instance methods; native attributes fall through. The main component has no dedicated instance methods.

## Usage notes





Built-in motion respects `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, keeping content and state feedback while disabling decorative animations. Adapt custom animations to that preference in your application.

Built-in Skeleton placeholders and standalone Line/Shape primitives default to `aria-hidden="true"`. The root exposes waiting through `aria-busy`. Custom `template` content and the loaded default content remain accessible and can supply business status messages.

### Fullscreen coverage

`fullscreen` renders an inline `position: fixed` placeholder without automatically teleporting to body. It covers the viewport when no ancestor establishes a fixed positioning containing block. An ancestor with `transform`, a relevant `will-change`, or `contain` may limit coverage to that ancestor. To cover the viewport, place Skeleton outside those ancestors or arrange its position with Vue Teleport in the application. This loading placeholder does not manage modal focus. See [CSS Positioned Layout fixed containing blocks](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-position-3/#fixed-cb).

Omitted size props use their theme tokens. A `-` in the table means there is no Prop default, rather than no placeholder size. Both Line and the main component normalize non-finite and negative row counts to zero and round fractions down.

</div>

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --mp-skeleton-animation-background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--mp-sys-color-surface-default), transparent);
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

## Interaction and control

### Interaction state comparison

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |

### Pointer session cancellation

Example source: src/slider/example/demos/interaction-session.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { SliderValue } from '../..'

const value = ref(20)
const disabled = ref(false)
const readonly = ref(false)
const max = ref(100)
const starts = ref(0)
const ends = ref<SliderValue[]>([])
function recordEnd(next: SliderValue) {
  ends.value.push(next)
}
function keyboard(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  const key = event.key.toLowerCase()
  if (!['d', 'r', 'm'].includes(key)) {
    return
  }
  event.preventDefault()
  if (key === 'd') {
    disabled.value = !disabled.value
  }
  if (key === 'r') {
    readonly.value = !readonly.value
  }
  if (key === 'm') {
    max.value = max.value === 100 ? 80 : 100
  }
}
function restore() {
  disabled.value = false
  readonly.value = false
  max.value = 100
}
</script>
<template>
  <div style="width: 100%; padding: 24px 0" @keydown="keyboard">
    <p>
      拖动滑块时按 D 禁用、R 只读、M 改上限。取消后仍会收到一次 end。While dragging, press D, R or M to cancel by
      changing the configuration.
    </p>
    <mp-slider
      v-model="value"
      edit-mode="direct"
      :disabled="disabled"
      :readonly="readonly"
      :max="max"
      aria-label="交互收尾 / Session end"
      @start="starts++"
      @end="recordEnd"
    />
    <p role="status">
      start: {{ starts }}；end: {{ ends.length }}；最后提案 / Last proposal: {{ JSON.stringify(ends.at(-1)) ?? '—' }}
    </p>
    <p>value: {{ value }}；disabled: {{ disabled }}；readonly: {{ readonly }}；max: {{ max }}</p>
    <mp-button @click="restore">恢复可交互 / Restore controls</mp-button>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Usage notes

### Editing and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-direct modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled.

`before-commit({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

### Pointer session cancellation

Every accepted pointer `start` has one `end`, including cancellation by disabling/readonly, bounds/step/orientation/range changes, capture loss, owner-window blur, KeepAlive deactivation, or unmount. `end` carries the last proposal from that gesture, or its initial value if it never proposed a `change`; changing range mode does not convert the old gesture's payload shape. Cancellation ends interaction, does not roll back earlier `change` proposals, and does not manufacture another model update. The parent still controls whether to accept proposals. A late pointerup/move cannot `end` the same gesture twice. Notification return Promises are not awaited.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

Steps align to a decimal grid anchored at min, retaining exact endpoints and range constraints; representable decimal and exponential steps are supported. The public model remains Number; increments below its representable spacing cannot be expressed. format-tooltip only changes display. Numeric inputs follow their normal blur commit and validation flow; Slider does not add another value publication.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Slider Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value | SliderValue / null | undefined | Controlled number or range pair; null is explicitly empty. |
| default-value | SliderValue | 0 | Uncontrolled initial value; ranges normalize to an ascending pair. |
| min | number / string | 0 | Finite minimum, accepting decimal and exponential numeric strings. |
| max | number / string | 100 | Finite maximum; interaction is blocked when it does not exceed min. |
| step | number / string | 1 | Positive finite step anchored at min; invalid values fall back to 1. |
| range | boolean | false | Two-thumb range with ordered, noncrossing endpoints. |
| orientation | 'horizontal' / 'vertical' | 'horizontal' | Track orientation; invalid values produce a development diagnostic. |
| disabled | boolean | undefined | Disable interaction; inherited from the form when omitted. |
| readonly | boolean | undefined | Readonly retains focus and tooltips while blocking value changes. |
| error | boolean | undefined | Error appearance, inherited from the form when omitted. |
| marks | Record<number, string> | undefined | Text marks at positions within the range. |
| show-ticks | boolean | false | Display step ticks, capped at 1000. |
| show-input | boolean | false | Show an accompanying InputNumber, or two in range mode. The slider’s aria-describedby also applies to the number inputs and is combined with form error descriptions. An explicit aria-description is forwarded to both the slider and number inputs. Browsers prioritize a resolvable aria-describedby, so the two descriptions are not necessarily combined. |
| show-tooltip | boolean / 'always' | true | True shows on hover, focus or drag; false hides; always remains visible. |
| format-tooltip | SliderTooltipFormatter | undefined | Format tooltips and aria-valuetext without changing the model. |
| aria-label | string / [string, string] | undefined | Single-thumb name or names for the two range thumbs. |
| active-color | string | undefined | Selected track color. |
| track-color | string | undefined | Background track color. |
| thumb-color | string | undefined | Thumb color. |
| label-color | string | undefined | Tooltip background color. |
| label-text-color | string | undefined | Tooltip text color. |
| track-height | number / string | undefined | Track thickness, with numeric values in px; invalid lengths preserve theme defaults. |
| thumb-size | number / string | undefined | Thumb diameter, with numeric values in px; invalid lengths preserve theme defaults. |
| edit-mode | FieldEditMode<br>`'direct' \| 'popup'` | undefined | Field editing entry, inherited from the form when omitted, otherwise direct. |
| read-pretty | boolean | undefined | Common pure-reading state, independent of readonly and disabled. |
| before-commit | BeforeFieldCommit | undefined | Deferred confirmation protocol ({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal }); complete with a boolean, Promise or done; synchronous undefined waits for done. |
| open | boolean | undefined | Controlled deferred editor state. |
| default-open | boolean | false | Initial uncontrolled deferred editor state. |
| popup-container | PopupContainer | undefined | Deferred editor mount target: selector, HTMLElement or false. |
| clearable | boolean | false | Provide clearing in the deferred editor; does not add a clear button to the inline slider. |
| empty-value | SliderProps['emptyValue'] | undefined | Published clear override, including explicit null. |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | undefined | Empty-value recognition inherited through field, FormItem and Form. |
| empty-text | string | undefined | Default empty reading text; defaults to a dash after inheritance. |

In range mode, `aria-labelledby` names the range group; an `aria-label` array still names the two thumbs. An explicit `role` takes precedence.

### Behavior and keyboard

Arrows adjust by step, PageUp/PageDown by 10 steps, Home/End reach available endpoints. Range-thumb ARIA min/max follow the other thumb. When overlapping, clicks left/down separate the lower thumb, right/up the upper thumb. Keyboard events inside interactive thumb content are not intercepted. Readonly retains focus/tooltips; disabled leaves the Tab sequence.

Pointer Events unify mouse, touch and pen. pointerup commits final coordinates; pointercancel/lost capture ends the latest proposal. Disabling, unmounting or KeepAlive deactivation cleans listeners/capture and stops value events. Horizontal sliders allow vertical page scrolling; vertical sliders allow horizontal scrolling.

Controlled display changes only after parent updates; normalization does not emit automatically. change/update:model-value report distinct proposals; end includes the final proposal without guaranteeing acceptance. Each keyboard/numeric-input operation has start/end; a drag has one pair. Internal InputNumber does not duplicate Form validation.

### Slider Events

| Event | Arguments | Meaning |
| ------------------ | ------------- | ---------------------------- |
| update:model-value | `SliderValue` | Request an update |
| change | `SliderValue` | Distinct numeric proposal paired with the model event |
| start | — | Interaction starts |
| end | `SliderValue` | Final proposal when interaction ends |

### Slider Slots / Methods

The button slot receives { currentValue, index }; custom content retains keyboard behavior, ARIA and tooltips. The read slot receives { value, text }, retaining null/undefined and range models; text is the formatted value. focus(index=0) focuses the displayed thumb; blur() blurs the currently focused owned element, including show-input numeric controls, without affecting outside controls.

Exports SliderProps, SliderValue, SliderOrientation, SliderTooltipFormatter, SliderTooltipVisibility, SliderEmits, SliderSlots, SliderExpose, SliderInstance and runtime sliderProps.

## Interaction and control

### Interactive layout

Toggle direction, column gap and wrapping, or add/remove items. Row gap stays 8px; column gap switches between 8px and 24px. Direction does not swap these geometric axes. The narrow preview scrolls horizontally without wrapping.

Example source: src/space/example/demos/interactive-layout.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const direction = ref<'row' | 'column'>('row')
const gap = ref(8)
const wrap = ref(false)
const count = ref(3)
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <mp-space wrap :size="8">
      <mp-button @click="direction = direction === 'row' ? 'column' : 'row'">Toggle direction</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="gap = gap === 8 ? 24 : 8">Toggle gap</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="wrap = !wrap">Toggle wrap</mp-button>
      <mp-button :disabled="count >= 6" @click="count++">Add item</mp-button>
      <mp-button :disabled="count <= 1" @click="count--">Remove item</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <p aria-live="polite">{{ direction }} / gap {{ gap }} / wrap {{ wrap }} / items {{ count }}</p>
    <div style="max-width: 100%; overflow: auto">
      <mp-space
        data-demo-layout
        :direction="direction"
        :size="[8, gap]"
        :wrap="wrap"
        style="width: 260px; max-width: 100%"
      >
        <div
          v-for="item in count"
          :key="item"
          style="width: 72px; padding: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid currentColor"
        >
          Item {{ item }}
        </div>
      </mp-space>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Separators and wrapping

### Split wrapping and content state

Change wrapping, direction and order after typing a draft. A separator stays with its preceding item and may appear at a line end.

Example source: src/space/example/demos/split-wrapping.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const wrap = ref(true)
const direction = ref<'row' | 'column'>('row')
const items = ref(['A', 'B', 'C'])
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space wrap :size="8">
    <mp-button data-space-toggle-wrap @click="wrap = !wrap">换行 / Wrap</mp-button>
    <mp-button data-space-toggle-direction @click="direction = direction === 'row' ? 'column' : 'row'"
      >方向 / Direction</mp-button
    >
    <mp-button data-space-reorder @click="items = [...items].reverse()">重排 / Reorder</mp-button>
  </mp-space>
  <p>输入草稿后切换布局或重排，文字仍跟随对应项。Drafts stay with their items.</p>
  <div style="max-width: 100%; overflow: auto">
    <mp-space
      data-space-split-demo
      :size="12"
      :wrap="wrap"
      :direction="direction"
      style="width: 260px; max-width: 100%"
    >
      <template v-for="item in items" :key="item">
        <label class="space-split-field">
          <span>Item {{ item }}</span>
          <mp-input edit-mode="direct" :aria-label="'Draft ' + item" placeholder="草稿 / Draft" />
        </label>
      </template>
      <template #split><span aria-hidden="true">/</span></template>
    </mp-space>
  </div>
  <p>分隔符跟随前项，允许位于行尾。Separators stay with the preceding item.</p>

  flex-direction: column;

  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;

```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest native `dir`. `direction="row"` follows reading order; `column` remains top to bottom. justify/align flex-start and flex-end follow their respective flex axes. `size=[rowGap,columnGap]` always describes row and `column` gaps without swapping in RTL. Wrapping and split slots follow content order. Direction changes do not reverse data or recreate children with stable keys.

## API

### Children and size boundaries

Reordering keyed Fragment groups preserves local child identity. Whitespace, empty text, comments and empty Fragments do not generate spacing items. Meaningful text, numeric zero and empty elements are retained. Empty split content does not produce separators.

With wrap and split, a separator follows the previous item and may appear at a line end; hiding separators at every line boundary is not guaranteed. An item wider than its available line may still overflow. Without wrap, existing Flex gap and justify allocation remain. Layout switches do not recreate content nodes.

block switches the container between flex and inline-flex. align=stretch stretches the internal item wrapper without guaranteeing that its control fills it. Use the child control's block or width:100% when needed.

Invalid size shapes, negative/nonfinite numbers and arrays other than pairs fall back to md with development diagnostics. Array entries are lengths and do not accept preset names. CSS var/calc expressions remain supported; the browser handles syntax and resolved lengths.


### Space Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| `direction` | Row/column order of children, default row; column stacks them vertically. Does not use horizontal/vertical values | _string_ | `row` |
| `justify` | Main axis arrangement, Can be set to `flex-start` `flex-end` `center` `space-around` `space-between` `space-evenly` | _string_ | `flex-start` |
| `align` | Cross-axis alignment: `stretch`/`center`/`flex-start`/`flex-end`/`baseline`. Omitted values follow `direction`: `row` → `center`, `column` → `stretch` | _string_ | `-` |
| `size` | Gap: `xs`/`sm`/`md`/`lg`/`xl` or [rowGap, columnGap], supporting CSS lengths | _string \| number \| [string \| number, string \| number]_ | `md` |
| `wrap` | Whether to exceed the line break | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `block` | Use flex instead of inline-flex | _boolean_ | `true` |

### Space Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| ----------- | ---------- | ----- |
| `default` | Content of space | `-` |
| `split` | Range separator | `-` |

# SplitButton

Demo text follows the site language selector. Middle cards and the right-hand mobile collection load the same Vue source without activating a local locale dictionary.

Disabled segments reuse Button disabled colors and suppress interaction feedback. Disabling the entire group also removes its elevation; disabling only the menu button blocks menu opening and closes an uncontrolled open menu.

Both segments inherit the same variant, status and custom colors. The arrow uses the icon slot; its layout does not change the shared palette.

### Introduction

Combines a primary action button with a menu of related actions. The main button performs the action and the trailing button opens the menu.

Examples use `Message.info(...)`, supported on both platforms. Selection closes the menu by default; only the repeated-selection example keeps it open while showing a Message. The outline / text arrow retains a transparent background.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

The main button publishes; the arrow opens related actions. Options have stable values and include a disabled action.

Example source: src/split-button/example/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { demoEnglish as english } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/demo-language'
import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const publish = () => {
  Message.info(english.value ? 'Published' : '发布成功')
}
const handleSelect = (_value: unknown, option: { label?: unknown }) => {
  Message.info(String(option.label))
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-split-button placement="bottom-end" @click="publish" @select="handleSelect">
    {{ english ? 'Publish' : '发布' }}

    <template #content>
      <mp-menu-option :label="english ? 'Save draft' : '保存草稿'" value="draft" />
      <mp-menu-option :label="english ? 'Save and publish' : '保存并发布'" value="publish" />
      <mp-menu-option :label="english ? 'Unavailable' : '暂无权限'" value="restricted" disabled />
    </template>
  </mp-split-button>
</template>
```

## Appearance and states

### Variants

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | Button group variant | Variants |
| `disabled` | Whether the entire split button is disabled | Disabled states |
| `button-props` | Props for the primary button | Disabled states |
| `trigger-button-props` | Props for the menu trigger button | Disabled states |
| `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | Appearance configuration comparison |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

```vue
  Message.info(english.value ? 'Published' : '发布成功')
}
const handleSelect = (_value: unknown, option: { label?: unknown }) => {
  Message.info(String(option.label))
}
const variants = ['default', 'outline', 'tonal', 'text'] as const
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space wrap>
    <mp-split-button
      v-for="variant in variants"
      :key="variant"
      :variant="variant"
      @click="publish"
      @select="handleSelect"
    >
      {{ variant }}

      <template #content>
        <mp-menu-option :label="english ? 'Save draft' : '保存草稿'" value="draft" />
        <mp-menu-option :label="english ? 'Save and publish' : '保存并发布'" value="publish" />
        <mp-menu-option :label="english ? 'Unavailable' : '暂无权限'" value="restricted" disabled />
      </template>
    </mp-split-button>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Appearance configuration comparison

Choose a dimension to compare all its values side by side while keeping other settings and content identical. Change the other settings to inspect combinations; input specimens share one model.

<details>
<summary>Configuration details and limits</summary>

#### Five sizes

All five sizes are supported: xs, sm, md (default), lg and xl. Examples wrap on narrow screens.

#### Appearance combinations

Use this example for a primary action and secondary menu. Adjust status, size and compare the component with the same data. Keep the content unchanged while comparing the available settings.

</details>

Example source: src/split-button/example/demos/en-US/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef, reactive } from 'vue'
import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
import type { ComponentSize, SemanticStatus } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const publish = () => {
  Message.info('Published')
}
const handleSelect = (_value: unknown, option: { label?: unknown }) => {
  Message.info(String(option.label))
}
const __demoAppearance = reactive<{ status: SemanticStatus; size: ComponentSize }>({ status: 'default', size: 'md' })

const demoCompareFields = [
  { name: 'status', values: ['default', 'primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'info', 'success', 'warning', 'danger'] },
  { name: 'size', values: ['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'] },
]
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef('status')
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(
  () => demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)?.values ?? [],
)
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" align="flex-start" :size="16">
    <mp-form layout="vertical">
      <mp-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="status">

            { label: 'default', value: 'default' },

            { label: 'secondary', value: 'secondary' },
            { label: 'tertiary', value: 'tertiary' },
            { label: 'info', value: 'info' },
            { label: 'success', value: 'success' },
            { label: 'warning', value: 'warning' },
            { label: 'danger', value: 'danger' },

            { label: 'xs', value: 'xs' },
            { label: 'sm', value: 'sm' },
            { label: 'md', value: 'md' },
            { label: 'lg', value: 'lg' },
            { label: 'xl', value: 'xl' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
```

## Content and presentation

### Popup and repeated selection

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | Popup and repeated selection |
| `offset-y` | Vertical menu offset | Popup and repeated selection |
| `popup-max-height` | Maximum menu height | Popup and repeated selection |
| `hide-on-select` | Close the menu after selection | Popup and repeated selection |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Use bottom-start, an 8px vertical offset and a 160px maximum height. With hide-on-select=false, repeated selections keep the menu open and display the latest value.

Example source: src/split-button/example/popup.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { demoEnglish as english } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/demo-language'
import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const lastAction = ref('')
const handleSelect = (value: unknown, option: { label?: unknown }) => {
  lastAction.value = String(value)
  Message.info(String(option.label))
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" align="flex-start">
    <mp-split-button
      placement="bottom-start"
      :offset-y="8"
      :popup-max-height="160"
      :hide-on-select="false"
      @click="lastAction = 'publish'"
      @select="handleSelect"
    >
      {{ english ? 'Choose action' : '选择操作' }}
      <template #content>
        <mp-menu-option :label="english ? 'Save draft' : '保存草稿'" value="draft" />
        <mp-menu-option :label="english ? 'Save and publish' : '保存并发布'" value="publish" />
        <mp-menu-option :label="english ? 'Unavailable' : '暂无权限'" value="restricted" disabled />
      </template>
    </mp-split-button>
    <span aria-live="polite"
      >{{ english ? 'Last action' : '最近操作' }}: {{ lastAction || (english ? 'None' : '暂无操作') }}</span
    >
    <span>{{
      english
        ? 'The menu stays open after selection; click outside to close.'
        : '选择后菜单保持展开，可连续选择；点击外部关闭。'
    }}</span>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Interaction and control

### Controlled menu

Use `@click.stop` on external controls so the opening click is not also treated as an outside click. Other outside clicks still close the menu.

Use v-model:open to synchronize external controls, the trigger and selection-driven closing.

Example source: src/split-button/example/controlled.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { demoEnglish as english } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/demo-language'
import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const publish = () => {
  Message.info(english.value ? 'Published' : '发布成功')
}
const handleSelect = (_value: unknown, option: { label?: unknown }) => {
  Message.info(String(option.label))
}
const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" align="flex-start">
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button @click.stop="open = true">{{ english ? 'Open menu' : '展开菜单' }}</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click.stop="open = false">{{ english ? 'Close menu' : '关闭菜单' }}</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-split-button v-model:open="open" @click="publish" @select="handleSelect">
      {{ english ? 'Publish' : '发布' }}

      <template #content>
        <mp-menu-option :label="english ? 'Save draft' : '保存草稿'" value="draft" />
        <mp-menu-option :label="english ? 'Save and publish' : '保存并发布'" value="publish" />
        <mp-menu-option :label="english ? 'Unavailable' : '暂无权限'" value="restricted" disabled />
      </template>
    </mp-split-button>
    <span aria-live="polite">{{ open ? (english ? 'Opened' : '已展开') : english ? 'Closed' : '已关闭' }}</span>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Async and dynamic data

### Async action

Use an async @click handler and control button-props.loading with business state. Reset loading in finally on both success and failure; the counter shows completed operations.

Example source: src/split-button/example/async-action.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { demoEnglish as english } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/demo-language'
import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const completed = ref(0)
const publishing = ref(false)
const publish = async () => {
  if (publishing.value) {
    return
  }
  publishing.value = true
  try {
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800))
    completed.value += 1
    Message.info('发布成功 / Published')
  } finally {
    publishing.value = false
  }
}
const handleSelect = (_value: unknown, option: { label?: unknown }) => {
  Message.info(String(option.label))
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" align="flex-start">
    <mp-split-button :button-props="{ loading: publishing }" @click="publish" @select="handleSelect">
      {{ english ? 'Publish' : '发布' }}

      <template #content>
        <mp-menu-option :label="english ? 'Save draft' : '保存草稿'" value="draft" />
        <mp-menu-option :label="english ? 'Save and publish' : '保存并发布'" value="publish" />
        <mp-menu-option :label="english ? 'Unavailable' : '暂无权限'" value="restricted" disabled />
      </template>
    </mp-split-button>
    <span aria-live="polite">{{ english ? 'Completed' : '完成次数' }}: {{ completed }}</span>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

The main button sits at inline start and the menu button at inline end. LTR/RTL changes do not swap business actions or emit extra selections. Enter/Space retain native button behavior. The menu button opens via Up/Down and skips disabled options; Home/End reaches boundaries, Enter selects, and Escape closes and restores focus. Popovers inherit trigger direction; start/end alignment follows direction while explicit left/right stays physical. Custom downward icons are not mirrored automatically.

## Menu button name

The menu trigger defaults to a localized “More actions” name. Override it with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` through `trigger-button-props`.

## Triggers and positioning

### Popup placement

Use `placement` to position the extra-actions menu. See `MenuPlacement` for the available values.

## API

### SplitButton Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------- | ----------- |
| `open` | Whether the menu is open. Supports `v-model:open` | _boolean_ | `undefined` |
| `default-open` | Whether the menu is open initially | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `disabled` | Whether the entire split button is disabled | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `status` | Button group semantic status | `SemanticStatus`<br>`'default' \| 'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'tertiary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `default` |
| `variant` | Button group variant | _ButtonVariant_<br>`'text' \| 'default' \| 'outline' \| 'tonal'` | `default` |
| `size` | Button group size; does not affect menu item size | _ComponentSize_<br>`'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `md` |
| `color` | Background color | _string_ | `undefined` |
| `text-color` | Custom text color | _string_ | `''` |
| `elevation` | Button group elevation | _boolean \| number_ | `true` |
| `button-props` | Primary button props, including native attributes and events | `SplitButtonButtonProps` | `undefined` |
| `trigger-button-props` | Menu trigger button props, including native attributes and events | `SplitButtonButtonProps` | `undefined` |
| `trigger` | Menu trigger method | _TriggerEvent \| TriggerEvent[]_<br>`TriggerEvent: 'manual' \| 'focus' \| 'hover' \| 'click' \| 'contextMenu'` | `click` |
| `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | `MenuPlacement`<br>`'top' \| 'top-start' \| 'top-end' \| 'bottom' \| 'bottom-start' \| 'bottom-end' \| 'left' \| 'left-start' \| 'left-end' \| 'right' \| 'right-start' \| 'right-end'` | `bottom` |
| `popup-container` | Menu mount container | _PopupContainer_ | `body` |
| `popup-max-height` | Maximum menu height | _boolean \| number_ | `true` |
| `popup-class` | Menu popup class | _string \| array \| object_ | `undefined` |
| `offset-x` | Horizontal menu offset | _string \| number_ | `0` |
| `offset-y` | Vertical menu offset | _string \| number_ | `0` |
| `hide-on-select` | Close the menu after selection | _boolean_ | `true` |

### SplitButton Events

| Event | Description | Callback arguments |
| ------------- | -------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| `update:open` | Emitted when an open-state update is requested | `open: boolean` |
| `open-change` | Emitted when an open-state update is requested | `open: boolean` |
| `click` | Emitted when the primary button is clicked | `event: Event` |
| `select` | Emitted when a menu option is selected | `value, option, event` |

### SplitButton Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --------- | ---------------- | --------------- |
| `default` | Primary button content | `-` |
| `icon` | Menu trigger button icon | `open: boolean` |
| `content` | Menu content | `-` |

### Asynchronous actions and click semantics

`click` is a notification event. The component does not process listener return values or switch loading automatically. Business code controls `button-props.loading` and should restore it in `finally` after asynchronous work. Disabled or loading links have their effective `href` removed.

```html
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
const publishing = ref(false)
const publish = async () => {
  if (publishing.value) return
  publishing.value = true
  try { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800)) }
  finally { publishing.value = false }
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-split-button :button-props="{ loading: publishing }" @click="publish">
    Publish
    <template #content><mp-menu-option label="Save draft" /></template>
  </mp-split-button>
</template>
```

`click` is an ordinary Emits notification. The main button bubbles normally without opening the menu. Overall disabled takes precedence over both buttons' disabled configuration.

### SplitButton Methods

| Method | Description |
| -------- | -------------------------- |
| open() | Request menu opening; disabled prevents opening |
| close() | Request menu closing |
| resize() | Recalculate menu position |

Controlled open requests updates only; callers update the binding. offset-x/offset-y use screen X/Y axes; numbers are px and length strings use existing conversion tools.

This component declares no independent public CSS variables. Use the configuration and layout APIs documented on this page. The appearance of composed controls follows the public variables of `button`, `menu`; a shared variable can affect other controls in the same DOM subtree.

Internal custom properties and measurement values are implementation details and are not customization APIs.

# Statistic

## Content and presentation

### Tabular Numbers

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | Displayed-value title | Tabular Numbers, Extra, Animation |
| `value` | Displayed value | Tabular Numbers, Extra, Animation |
| `suffix` | Value suffix | Tabular Numbers, Animation |
| `value-style` | Custom style of the value | Tabular Numbers |
| `tabular-nums` | Whether to use tabular numbers | Tabular Numbers |
| `prefix` | Value prefix | Extra |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Enable `tabular-nums` so every digit occupies the same width. This is useful for frequently changing values and vertically aligned numbers. Compare equal-length values such as `1111` and `8888`: proportional numbers may change total width, while tabular numbers remain stable.

Example source: src/statistic/example/demos/tabular-nums.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onMounted, onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue'

const values = [1111, 8888, 1010, 9090]
const count = ref(values[0])
const index = ref(0)
let timer

onMounted(() => {
  timer = window.setInterval(() => {
    index.value = (index.value + 1) % values.length
    count.value = values[index.value]
  }, 800)
})

onUnmounted(() => {
  window.clearInterval(timer)
})
</script>

<template>
  <p class="statistic-example__hint">数值始终保持四位，请观察右侧竖线的位置。</p>
  <mp-space direction="column" size="lg">
    <mp-statistic
      title="比例数字（右侧标记会跳动）"
      :value="count"
      suffix="|"
      :value-style="{ fontVariantNumeric: 'proportional-nums' }"
    />
    <mp-statistic title="等宽数字（右侧标记保持稳定）" :value="count" suffix="|" tabular-nums />
  </mp-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.statistic-example__hint {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  color: var(--mp-color-text-3);
  font-size: var(--mp-font-size-sm);
  line-height: 1.5;
}
</style>
```

### Animation

Turn on `animation` to tween the number. Control playback with `start`.

The demo's Start button changes the parent's `start` from `false` to `true`, playing from `value-from` to the target. Repeated clicks do not replay it. Setting `start=false` pauses; switching back to `true` restarts from `value-from`, not the paused position. A replay button should set it to `false`, wait for one Vue update, then set it to `true`.

Example source: src/statistic/example/demos/animation.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const started = ref(false)
const enabled = ref(false)
const origin = ref(0)
const duration = ref(800)
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space align="flex-end" size="lg">
    <mp-statistic title="增长率" :value="50.52" :precision="2" :value-from="0" :start="started" suffix="%" animation>
      <template #prefix>▲</template>
    </mp-statistic>
    <mp-button status="primary" @click="started = true">开始</mp-button>
  </mp-space>

  <mp-space direction="column" style="margin-top: 16px">
    <h4>动态开关与配置 / Dynamic animation</h4>
    <mp-statistic
      title="动态目标 / Dynamic target"
      :value="100"
      :animation="enabled"
      :value-from="origin"
      :animation-duration="duration"
    />
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button @click="enabled = !enabled">{{
        enabled ? '关闭动画 / Disable animation' : '启用动画 / Enable animation'
      }}</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="origin = origin === 0 ? 20 : 0">切换起点 / Change origin</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="duration = duration === 800 ? 1600 : 800">切换时长 / Change duration</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <p>起点 / From: {{ origin }}；时长 / Duration: {{ duration }}ms</p>
  </mp-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.statistic-example__hint {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  color: var(--mp-color-text-3);
  font-size: var(--mp-font-size-sm);
  line-height: 1.5;
}
</style>
```

## Animation duration boundaries

Duration is finite nonnegative milliseconds. Zero reaches the target on the next frame. Negative, NaN and infinite values produce development prop diagnostics and safely behave as zero without continuing to request frames. Pausing or unmounting before that frame cancels completion. Changing animation-duration replays enabled numeric animation according to the existing rules.

## API

`precision` accepts integers from 0 to 100; invalid values fall back to 0. Numeric formatting uses JavaScript binary numbers and rounding and is not exact financial arithmetic. Very large values may use exponential notation; when the difference between animation endpoints overflows, the final value is shown directly. Numeric grouping follows en-US rules, `separator` replaces grouping commas, and the decimal point remains a dot; dates use local time. Non-finite numeric values produce a warning, display literally, and do not animate. An invalid animation start falls back to 0 and an invalid duration to 0 with completion on the next frame.

### Statistic Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | Displayed-value title | _string_ | `-` |
| `value` | Displayed value | _number \| string \| Date_ | `-` |
| `prefix` | Value prefix | _string_ | `-` |
| `suffix` | Value suffix | _string_ | `-` |
| `format` | Date format (date mode) | _string_ | `HH:mm:ss` |
| `extra` | Extra content | _string_ | `-` |
| `start` | Whether to start the animation | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `precision` | Decimal places (number mode) | _number_ | `0` |
| `separator` | Group separator (number mode) | _string_ | `-` |
| `show-group-separator` | Whether to show the group separator | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `tabular-nums` | Whether to use tabular numbers | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `animation` | Whether to enable animation | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `animation-duration` | Animation duration | _number_ | `2000` |
| `value-from` | Animation start value | _number_ | `-` |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder when `value` is `undefined` and the default slot is unused | _string_ | `-` |
| `value-style` | Custom style of the value | _CSSProperties_ | `-` |

### Statistic Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | Custom `value`, used when `value` is not provided | `-` |
| `title` | Title | `-` |
| `prefix` | The prepend icon of alert | `-` |
| `suffix` | Suffix | `-` |
| `extra` | Extra content | `-` |

## Usage notes



Placeholder text updates when the default slot appears/disappears. Animation pauses on unmount/KeepAlive deactivation.

### Animation configuration and lifecycle

With `start=true`, dynamically enabling `animation` or changing the numeric target, `valueFrom` or `animationDuration` replays from the currently configured start. Formatting-only changes, such as precision or separators, do not replay. Disabling `animation` or switching to string/date immediately shows the target and stops frames. `start=false` pauses the current number; explicitly returning to `true` replays. Configuration changes while paused prepare a new start without scheduling frames. KeepAlive deactivation pauses; activation resumes unchanged configuration or resynchronizes changed configuration. Unmount releases frames.

# Steps

### Intro

Steps is a navigation bar that guides users through the steps of a task. Progress is controlled by `modelValue`, counted from **1** (aligned with Pagination / PC).

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

Example source: src/steps/example/demos/basic-usage.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const current = ref(1)
const statuses = ['wait', 'process', 'finish', 'error'] as const
type StepStatus = (typeof statuses)[number]
const basicStatus = ref<StepStatus>('process')
</script>

<template>
  <mp-radio-group v-model="basicStatus" edit-mode="direct" class="status-switch">
    <mp-radio v-for="status in statuses" :key="status" :value="status">{{ status }}</mp-radio>
  </mp-radio-group>
  <mp-steps :model-value="current" :status="basicStatus" content-placement="bottom">
    <mp-step>步骤1</mp-step>
    <mp-step>步骤2</mp-step>
    <mp-step>步骤3</mp-step>
    <mp-step>步骤4</mp-step>
  </mp-steps>
</template>

<style lang="less" scoped>
.status-switch {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
</style>
```

## Triggers and positioning

### Popup placement

content-placement shares side vocabulary and spelling, not an identical set across all components. Steps implements only right/bottom; dot and navigation variants have derived rules. Unsupported sides are not added for naming uniformity.

## API

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the current step, starting at 1. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once; later changes do not reset it. Initialization emits no `update:modelValue`. When supplied, `modelValue` is controlled by the parent.

### Steps Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------- | --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| `model-value` | Current step (controlled, 1-based) | _number_ | `-` |
| `default-value` | Default current step (uncontrolled) | _number_ | `1` |
| `type` | Display type | _'default' \| 'arrow' \| 'dot' \| 'navigation'_ | `default` |
| `orientation` | Horizontal/vertical axis of the step flow, default horizontal; arrow and navigation variants remain horizontal | _'horizontal' \| 'vertical'_ | `horizontal` |
| `content-placement` | Content side relative to the step node: right or bottom, default right. Dot steps derive it from orientation; navigation steps always use right | _'right' \| 'bottom'_ | `right` |
| `status` | Current step status | _'wait' \| 'process' \| 'finish' \| 'error'_ | `process` |
| `size` | Steps size | _'sm' \| 'md'_ | `md` |
| `show-line` | Whether to show connectors | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `changeable` | Whether steps can be switched by click | _boolean_ | `false` |

### Step Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------- | ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `title` | Step title | _string_ | `-` |
| `description` | Step description | _string_ | `-` |
| `status` | Step status; overrides automatic inference | _'wait' \| 'process' \| 'finish' \| 'error'_ | `-` |
| `disabled` | Whether disabled | _boolean_ | `false` |

### Step Events

Step values are nonnegative safe integers: 0 gives every step an automatic waiting status, and values beyond the step count give every step an automatic finished status; an individual status can override it. Invalid values warn in development and render as 1. The node slot is not rendered for arrow type, and the icon slot is not rendered for dot type. Text and native decorations in the default slot do not consume step indices.

### Steps Events

| Event | Description | Callback arguments |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `change` | Triggered when step changes (`changeable` required) | `current: number, previous: number, ev: Event` |
| `update:modelValue` | `v-model` sync | `step: number` |

### Steps Slots

| Name | Description | Prop |
| ------------- | ------------ | ---- |
| `default` | Steps content | `-` |
| `finish-icon` | Finished status icon | `-` |
| `error-icon` | Error status icon | `-` |

### Step Slots

| Name | Description | Prop |
| ------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `default` | Step `title`; overrides `title` | `index`、`status`、`active`、`disabled` |
| `title` | Step title | `index`、`status`、`active`、`disabled` |
| `node` | Full indicator node | `index`、`status`、`active`、`disabled` |
| `icon` | Custom node icon | `index`、`status`、`active`、`disabled` |
| `description` | Step description | `index`、`status`、`active`、`disabled` |

## Usage notes





`active` indicates only whether the current one-based step index matches modelValue, independently of wait/process/finish/error status. A current error step remains `active`. Focus/hover do not change `active`.

## Reading direction and keyboard interaction

Steps inherits the nearest `dir="ltr"` or `dir="rtl"`, including runtime changes. Horizontal steps, connectors and arrows follow reading direction; vertical steps remain top to bottom. Step numbers, progress values and custom icon content keep their meaning.

With `changeable`, Left/Right moves focus according to reading direction, or Up/Down vertically. Home/End focuses the first/last available step, skipping disabled items. Enter/Space confirms. Moving focus or changing reading direction does not update progress.

# Elevation

### Intro

Shadow elevation levels (`mp-elevation--0` … `mp-elevation--24`) for dimensional surfaces, included in the full Maple stylesheet.  
Cedar counterpart: `c-elevation--0` … `--24` (ships with box-shadow tools).

### Import Style

```js
// playground-ignore
import '@maple-design/ui-vue/style'
```

### Basic Usage
Shadows are divided into `0-24` levels, and the higher the level, the higher the altitude.

```html
<template>
  <mp-space class="elevation-example-list" :size="[40, 0]" justify="space-between">
    <div
      class="elevation-example-item"
      :class="`mp-elevation--${e - 1}`"
      v-for="e in 25"
      :key="e"
    >
      {{ e - 1 }}
    </div>
  </mp-space>
</template>

<style>
.elevation-example-list {
  padding: 2vmin 4vmin;
}

.elevation-example-item {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  width: 24vmin;
  height: 24vmin;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
</style>
```

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Example source: src/style/example/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onThemeChange } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/client'

const elevations = Array.from({ length: 25 }).map((_, index) => index)

onThemeChange()
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space wrap class="elevation-example-list" :size="['10vmin', 0]" justify="space-between">
    <div
      v-for="e in elevations"
      :key="e"
      class="elevation-example-item"
      :class="`mp-elevation--${e}`"
      :style="{ background: 'var(--mp-paper-background)' }"
    >
      {{ e }}
    </div>
  </mp-space>
</template>

<style lang="less">
@import '../../style/elevation';
</style>

<style>
.elevation-example-list {
  padding: 8vmin 4vmin;
}

.elevation-example-item {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  width: 24vmin;
  height: 24vmin;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
</style>
```
