# SwipeCell

Swipe cell content left/right to reveal actions, commonly for deletion/favorites in lists.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

`name` identifies the item in `open`, `close`, and `before-close` payloads; it does not render text. Put visible content in the default slot, such as `<mp-cell title="Order title" />`. The example shows the emitted name and position.

Swipe left to reveal the right-side action.

Example source: src/swipe-cell/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const lastEvent = ref('向左滑动查看 open / close 事件中的 name')
function recordEvent(type, { name, position }) {
  lastEvent.value = `${type}: name=${name}, position=${position}`
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="swipe-cell-example">
    <mp-swipe-cell name="order-1001" @open="recordEvent('open', $event)" @close="recordEvent('close', $event)">
      <template #right>
        <mp-button status="danger" style="height: 100%; border-radius: 0">删除</mp-button>
      </template>
      <mp-cell title="左滑显示操作" border />
    </mp-swipe-cell>
    <p role="status">{{ lastEvent }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Directions and actions

### Both Sides

Example source: src/swipe-cell/example/demos/both-sides.vue

```vue
<template>
  <mp-swipe-cell>
    <template #left>
      <mp-button status="primary" style="height: 100%; border-radius: 0">选择</mp-button>
    </template>
    <mp-cell title="两侧均可滑动" border />
    <template #right>
      <mp-button status="danger" style="height: 100%; border-radius: 0">删除</mp-button>
    </template>
  </mp-swipe-cell>
</template>
```

## Async closing control

### Before Close

Example source: src/swipe-cell/example/demos/before-close.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { Dialog } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

let confirming = false

async function beforeClose({ position }) {
  if (confirming) {
    return false
  }
  if (position !== 'right') {
    return true
  }

  confirming = true
  try {
    const action = await Dialog.confirm({ title: '确认删除？' })
    return action === 'confirm'
  } finally {
    confirming = false
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-swipe-cell :before-close="beforeClose">
    <mp-cell title="删除前确认" border />
    <template #right>
      <mp-button status="danger" style="height: 100%; border-radius: 0">删除</mp-button>
    </template>
  </mp-swipe-cell>
</template>
```

`Dialog.confirm(...)` resolves with an action. Only `confirm` allows closing; `cancel` and `close` preserve the revealed actions. The basic Delete button demonstrates closing only; implement data deletion in your application.

## Loading and waiting

### Controlled loading

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | Explicit business loading state | `boolean` | `false` |

External loading blocks close/switch requests; internal before-hook waiting is merged for display.


Set loading explicitly to display feedback. Ordinary event return values do not drive loading. Before hooks retain their documented pending behavior.

Example source: src/swipe-cell/example/demos/loading.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const loading = ref(false)
const beforeWait = () => new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(true), 800))
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%" :size="16">
    <mp-form layout="vertical"
      ><mp-form-item label="加载状态 / Loading"><mp-switch v-model="loading" /></mp-form-item
    ></mp-form>
    <mp-swipe-cell :before-close="beforeWait" :loading="loading" :right-width="80"
      ><p>向左滑动 / Swipe left</p>
      <template #right><mp-button>删除 / Delete</mp-button></template></mp-swipe-cell
    >
    <p>
      通过 loading 显式控制等待展示，普通事件返回 Promise 不会自动加载。Loading is controlled by business state.
      关闭手动加载后切换或关闭，观察 before 守卫的自动等待反馈。
    </p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

Left and right are physical sides. Widths accept `auto`, finite numbers, or numeric strings in pixels; negative or invalid values resolve to zero. Automatic widths are remeasured before opening and observed while supported. An outside touch requests close; an outside mouse click does not. `click` reports cell, left, or right; `outside` is a close reason.

Hidden action regions are inert and excluded from the accessibility tree. When closing while focus is in the actions, focus returns to the opener or to the cell container. Place a Button outside the cell to call `open('right')`, and handle Escape on a containing element by calling `close()`. The close request still passes through `before-close`. Give each action an accessible name.

`close()` returns `Promise<void>` after the guard settles; the return value does not indicate whether the cell closed. Guard exceptions and rejections emit `guard-error(error, position)`.

Keyboard-accessible composition:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { SwipeCellInstance } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const cell = ref<SwipeCellInstance>()
</script>

<template>
  <div @keydown.esc="cell?.close()">
    <mp-button html-type="button" @click="cell?.open('right')">Show actions</mp-button>
    <mp-swipe-cell ref="cell">
      <div>Order</div>
      <template #right><mp-button html-type="button">Archive</mp-button></template>
    </mp-swipe-cell>
  </div>
</template>
```

## API

### SwipeCell Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Item identity returned by open, close, and before-close; does not render text | `string \| number` | `''` |
| `left-width` | Left action-area width; `auto` measures content | `number \| string` | `auto` |
| `right-width` | Right action width | `number \| string` | `auto` |
| `before-close` | Before-close hook; `false` prevents closing | `(args) => boolean \| void \| Promise<boolean \| void>` | `-` |
| `disabled` | Disable swipe | `boolean` | `false` |
| `stop-propagation` | Stop `touchmove` bubbling | `boolean` | `false` |

### SwipeCell Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `click` | Triggered when the cell is clicked | `position: left \| right \| cell` |
| `open` | Emitted on open | `{ name, position }` |
| `close` | Emitted on close | `{ name, position }` |
| `guard-error` | A close guard throws or rejects | `(error, position)` |

### SwipeCell Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | Main content |
| `left` | Left actions |
| `right` | Right action |

### SwipeCell Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | Open the sidebar | `left \| right` |
| `close` | Request close through the guard; resolves `Promise<void>` without indicating whether the cell closed | `-` |

### Async operation feedback

Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection/failure restores interaction; repeated input does not restart the same operation. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate. Guard failure emits guard-error. close() ends waiting and leaves the cell open instead of rejecting its caller. A new gesture can cancel an earlier close request.

### guard-error

Emitted once after a closing guard fails, with `(error, position)`.

When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

# Switch

The same scenarios, parameters and interactions as Cedar. Only component prefixes differ; themes and site shells remain independent.

## Reading direction

Switch inherits source dir: its unchecked handle starts at inline start and moves toward inline end when checked. Space/Enter still toggle. Direction changes do not modify values; disabled, readonly and loading states block commits.

## Basic examples

### Controlled and default value

Example source: src/switch/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const enabled = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space wrap
    ><mp-switch v-model="enabled" aria-label="Enable notifications" /><output>{{ enabled }}</output
    ><mp-switch :default-value="true" aria-label="Initially enabled"
  /></mp-space>
</template>
```

## Appearance and states

### Appearance configuration comparison

Choose a dimension to compare all its values side by side while keeping other settings and content identical. Change the other settings to inspect combinations; input specimens share one model.

<details>
<summary>Configuration details and limits</summary>

#### Appearance combinations

Use this example for settings that take effect immediately. Adjust variant, size and compare the component with the same data. Keep the content unchanged while comparing the available settings.

</details>

Example source: src/switch/example/demos/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive as __demoReactive, computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef, ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref(false)
const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: 'circle', size: 'md' })
const demoCompareFields = [
  { name: 'variant', values: ['circle', 'round', 'line', 'tonal'] },
  { name: 'size', values: ['sm', 'md', 'lg'] },
]
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef('variant')
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(
  () => demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)?.values ?? [],
)
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <mp-form layout="vertical">
      <mp-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="variant">
        <mp-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['variant']"
          aria-label="variant"
          :options="[
            { label: 'circle', value: 'circle' },
            { label: 'round', value: 'round' },
            { label: 'line', value: 'line' },
            { label: 'tonal', value: 'tonal' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="size">
        <mp-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['size']"
          aria-label="size"
          :options="[
            { label: 'sm', value: 'sm' },
            { label: 'md', value: 'md' },
            { label: 'lg', value: 'lg' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </mp-form-item>
    </mp-form>
    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint">
      <span lang="zh-CN">选择一个对比维度；其他配置和内容保持一致。输入类示例共享同一个值，便于比较外观。</span
      ><span lang="en-US"
        >Compare one dimension while keeping the other settings and content identical. Input specimens share the same
        value.</span
      >
```

### Focus and event order

Example source: src/switch/example/demos/events.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref(false)
const events = ref<string[]>([])
function record(name: string) {
  events.value = [...events.value.slice(-7), name]
}
</script>

<template>
  <p>Use Tab to focus, then Space or Enter to toggle.</p>
  <mp-switch
    v-model="value"
    size="md"
    aria-label="Event sequence"
    @focus="record('focus')"
    @blur="record('blur')"
    @click="record('click')"
    @update:model-value="record(`update: ${$event}`)"
    @change="record(`change: ${$event}`)"
  />
  <p aria-live="polite">{{ events.join(' → ') || 'No events yet' }}</p>
  <mp-button @click="events = []">Clear events</mp-button>
</template>
```

## Async and dynamic data

### Async allow, deny and rejection

Example source: src/switch/example/demos/switch-interception.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const result = ref('Ready')
const wait = () => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500))
async function allow() {
  await wait()
  result.value = 'Allowed'
  return true
}
async function deny() {
  await wait()
  result.value = 'Blocked'
  return false
}
async function reject() {
  await wait()
  result.value = 'Rejected'
  throw new Error('Demo rejection')
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column">
    <label>Allow after 500ms <mp-switch :before-change="allow" aria-label="Async allow" /></label>
    <label>Return false <mp-switch :before-change="deny" aria-label="Async deny" /></label>
    <label>Reject Promise <mp-switch :before-change="reject" aria-label="Async rejection" /></label>
    <output aria-live="polite">{{ result }}</output>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Usage notes

### Configuration

Use the CSS Variables table below to customize dimensions and colors.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the actual switch value and matches checkedValue/uncheckedValue types. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once; later changes do not reset it. Explicit binding takes precedence, with no initialization `update:modelValue`.

<!-- same-source-api:start -->

### Switch Props

| Prop | Meaning | Type | Default |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| model-value | Controlled value; managed internally when omitted | string / number / boolean | undefined |
| default-value | Initial uncontrolled value; falls back to uncheckedValue | string / number / boolean | undefined |
| clearable | Show clearing in popup editing | boolean | false |
| empty-value | Value committed after clearing; accepts a value or factory | SwitchValue \| null \| (() => SwitchValue \| null) | undefined |
| empty-values | Empty-value recognition list; fully replaces inherited configuration | readonly unknown[] | Inherits the field empty-value policy |
| empty-text | Reading placeholder; field > FormItem > Form | string | - |
| edit-mode | Editing mode; inherits FormItem/Form when unset. See editing-mode guidance for platform-specific values | FieldEditMode<br>`'direct' \| 'popup'` | undefined |
| read-pretty | Plain reading display, independent of readonly | boolean | undefined |
| before-commit | Cancelable interceptor before saving the editor | BeforeFieldCommit | undefined |
| open | Controlled editor open state | boolean | undefined |
| default-open | Initial uncontrolled editor state | boolean | false |
| popup-container | Editor mount container | PopupContainer | undefined |
| checked-value | Checked value | string / number / boolean | true |
| unchecked-value | Unchecked value | string / number / boolean | false |
| variant | Appearance | circle / round / line / tonal | circle |
| size | Size; omitted value follows platform rules below | sm / md / lg | undefined |
| disabled | Disable interaction, including inherited form disabled state | boolean | undefined |
| readonly | Read only; focus and click remain available without toggling | boolean | undefined |
| loading | Loading; blocks clicks and changes | boolean | false |
| before-change | Switch interceptor, not an event | (payload, done, context) => boolean / void / Promise<boolean / void> | — |
| checked-text | Checked label | string | — |
| unchecked-text | Unchecked label | string | — |
| checked-color | Checked track color | string | — |
| unchecked-color | Unchecked track color | string | — |
| loading-color | Loading-icon color | string | — |
| ripple | Click ripple | boolean | true |
| handle-elevation | Thumb elevation: true means level 2; numbers are integer-clamped to 0–24 | boolean / number | true |

before-change uses (payload, done, context). Return true, call done(), or fulfill a Promise with a non-false result to allow switching. Return false, call done(false), throw, fulfill with false or reject to cancel. Synchronous void waits for done; fulfilled `Promise<void>` allows. Waiting automatically shows loading and blocks duplicate input. In deferred editing, confirmation is disabled while waiting; closing the editor still cancels the operation. Exceptions cancel permission without adding an error event.
Pending results become stale after unmount, KeepAlive deactivation, external value updates or changes to disabled/readonly/loading.
Controlled mode only requests updates. Selection changes after the parent updates model-value. Without model-value, internal state is used.

### Switch Events

| Event | Arguments and timing |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| click | (event: Event), before interception when clicking is allowed |
| update:model-value | (nextValue: SwitchValue), after switching is allowed and before change |
| change | (nextValue: SwitchValue, event?: Event), once per commit |
| focus | (event: FocusEvent), on focus |
| blur | (event: FocusEvent), on blur |

Supports Enter/Space without repeated toggles on key repeat. disabled/loading emit neither click nor value changes; readonly may emit click without running the interceptor.
External model-value updates do not emit an extra change.

### Switch Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | ---- |
| checked | Checked label; overrides checked-text; hidden for line/sm | — |
| unchecked | Unchecked label; overrides unchecked-text; hidden for line/sm | — |
| checked-icon | Checked thumb icon; replaced while loading | — |
| unchecked-icon | Unchecked thumb icon; replaced while loading | — |

### Switch Methods

No public methods.

### Usage notes

Props, event arguments and slots match. Cedar inherits omitted size from Form/global settings: xs/sm map to sm; lg/xl map to lg. Maple defaults to md. Both inherit disabled/readonly from field > FormItem > Form, with explicit false overriding the parent. Form integration is local to each platform.
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

## Types

SwitchProps, SwitchVariant, SwitchSize, SwitchValue, SwitchBeforeChange and SwitchInstance are exported from both root and component entries.

## Inheriting Form disabled state

The default disabled=undefined means inheritance, resolved as local ?? FormItem ?? Form ?? false. Explicit false remains effective, allowing one field to stay enabled while unspecified fields follow Form. Form disabled is the form-wide default, not a lock preventing child overrides.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

```vue
<mp-switch v-model="flag" :before-change="beforeChange" />
```

```ts
const beforeChange = (next, done) => {
  canChange(next).then((allowed) => done(allowed))
}
```

Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise&lt;void&gt; allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

### Async operation feedback

Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection or failure restores interaction; repeated input does not start the same operation again. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate in loading.

Deferred `change` preserves the real confirmation event when available (for example, the save button). Programmatic editor handoff has no DOM event, so its second argument is optional. The event target can be the confirmation control rather than the input. `change` is a notification: its returned Promise is not awaited; use `before-commit` to approve asynchronous saves.

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css

```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

### Motion

Built-in motion follows `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Reduced motion does not prevent loading-state or close-event updates.

### Track and handle colors

| Variable suffix: --mp-switch- | Default system role | Responsibility |
| ------------------------ | ----------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| track-background | content-secondary | Ordinary unchecked solid track |
| track-active-background | content-brand | Checked track and keyboard-focus ring |
| track-error-background | content-danger | Interactive error track and tonal error border |
| handle-background | surface-default | Ordinary/checked/error thumb fill |
| handle-color | content-brand | Ordinary/checked/error thumb icon color |
| text-color | surface-default | Text on a solid track |
| checked-text-color | switch-text-color | Checked-track text; error retains existing foreground precedence |
| tonal-track-background | surface-muted | Tonal unchecked-track background |
| tonal-border-color | content-secondary | Tonal unchecked border and thumb fill |
| tonal-text-color | content-secondary | Tonal unchecked-track text |
| tonal-handle-color | surface-default | Tonal unchecked-thumb icon |

Defaults use the corresponding system roles, such as var(--mp-sys-color-content-secondary). Unchecked tonal uses tonal-text-color / tonal-handle-color; override both ordinary and tonal foregrounds when customizing every variant. Interactive error state uses paired text/handle colors, while disabled / loading suppresses error colors. Keep foregrounds readable on custom track colors.

### Fab

Use the floating button for a primary action such as creating a post, taking a photo or adding an item. The plus button opens the composer without changing the selected tab.

The button is centered for an even number of tabs and right aligned for an odd number. Use the separate control to compare these layouts.

Example source: src/tab-bar/example/demos/fab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const fab = ref(0)
const isEven = ref(true)
const composerOpen = ref(false)
const draft = ref('')
const variant = ref(0)
function handlePublish() {
  Message.success('发布操作演示完成')
  draft.value = ''
}
</script>

<template>
  <p>悬浮按钮用于发布、拍摄或新建等主要操作。点击加号打开发布框，不切换当前导航。</p>
  <mp-space wrap role="group" aria-label="悬浮按钮位置演示">
    <mp-button :variant="isEven ? 'default' : 'outline'" :aria-pressed="isEven" @click="isEven = true"
      >4 个导航项：按钮居中</mp-button
    >
    <mp-button :variant="isEven ? 'outline' : 'default'" :aria-pressed="!isEven" @click="isEven = false"
      >5 个导航项：按钮靠右</mp-button
    >
  </mp-space>
  <mp-tab-bar
    v-model="fab"
    style="margin-top: 40px"
    :fab-props="{ 'aria-label': '发布动态' }"
    @fab-click="composerOpen = true"
  >
    <template #fab
      ><mp-icon :size="24"><m-icon-plus /></mp-icon
    ></template>
    <mp-tab-bar-item label="首页">
      <template #icon
        ><mp-icon :size="22"><m-icon-home-fill /></mp-icon
      ></template>
    </mp-tab-bar-item>
    <mp-tab-bar-item label="发现">
      <template #icon
        ><mp-icon :size="22"><m-icon-search /></mp-icon
      ></template>
    </mp-tab-bar-item>
    <mp-tab-bar-item label="收藏">
      <template #icon
        ><mp-icon :size="22"><m-icon-heart-fill /></mp-icon
      ></template>
    </mp-tab-bar-item>
    <mp-tab-bar-item label="消息">
      <template #icon

  </mp-dialog>
```

```vue
import { ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref('home')
const tabs = ref([
  { name: 'home', label: '首页' },
  { name: 'favorites', label: '收藏' },
  { name: 'profile', label: '我的' },

  </mp-tab-bar>
  <p aria-live="polite">当前选中：{{ tabs.find((tab) => tab.name === active)?.label }}</p>
</template>
```

## Async navigation

### Async selection guards

Example source: src/tab-bar/example/demos/async-change.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref(0)
async function beforeChange(value) {
  if (value === 3) {
    return false
  }
  if (value === 4) {
    throw new Error('Demo: rejected selection')
  }
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, value === 1 ? 1200 : 250))
  return true
}
</script>
<template>
  <p>
    先点慢速（1.2 秒），再点快速（0.25 秒），最终只切到快速；拒绝和异常都会保持当前选中。等待时点击当前标签可取消切换。
  </p>
  <mp-tab-bar v-model="active" :before-change="beforeChange">
    <mp-tab-bar-item label="首页" />
    <mp-tab-bar-item label="慢速" />
    <mp-tab-bar-item label="快速" />
    <mp-tab-bar-item label="拒绝" />
    <mp-tab-bar-item label="异常" />
  </mp-tab-bar>
  <p aria-live="polite">当前选中: {{ active }}</p>
</template>
```

## Loading and waiting

### Controlled loading

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | Explicit business loading state | `boolean` | `false` |

External loading blocks tab switching; internal before-hook waiting is merged for display.


Set loading explicitly to display feedback. Ordinary event return values do not drive loading. Before hooks retain their documented pending behavior.

Example source: src/tab-bar/example/demos/loading.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const loading = ref(false)
const beforeWait = () => new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(true), 800))
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%" :size="16">
    <mp-form layout="vertical"
      ><mp-form-item label="加载状态 / Loading"><mp-switch v-model="loading" /></mp-form-item
    ></mp-form>
    <mp-tab-bar :before-change="beforeWait" :loading="loading"
      ><mp-tab-bar-item label="首页 / Home" name="home" /><mp-tab-bar-item label="消息 / Messages" name="messages"
    /></mp-tab-bar>
    <p>
      通过 loading 显式控制等待展示，普通事件返回 Promise 不会自动加载。Loading is controlled by business state.
      关闭手动加载后切换或关闭，观察 before 守卫的自动等待反馈。
    </p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Navigation items follow reading order without changing selection values or item order. Automatic space for a floating button is at inline end; a center button remains centered. Explicit Badge placements remain physical corners.

## API

`default`/`icon` slot active indicates whether this item's name matches modelValue; focus/hover do not change it. activeColor/inactiveColor control current/noncurrent colors.

#### Async operation feedback
Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection/failure restores interaction; repeated input does not restart the same operation. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate. Switching to a different target retains the latest-request-wins rule.

#### guard-error
Emitted once after a switching guard fails, with `(error, value)`.

TabBar uses a group of buttons for state selection, with aria-pressed on the selected item. Give the root an aria-label when needed. Applications handle routing; ordinary events do not await return values.

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the selected child name; unnamed positional mode uses zero-based indices. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once without later resets. Explicit binding wins, without initialization `update:modelValue`.

### TabBar Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------ | ----------------- | ---- | ---- |
| `v-model` | Selected name or index; controlled when provided | _number \| string_ | `undefined` |
| `loading` | Externally controlled loading state; switching is blocked while active | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `default-value` | Initial uncontrolled selection; read once | _number \| string_ | `0` |
| `before-change` | Guard selection; truthy permits, falsy/throw/rejection cancels. Only the latest request may commit | `TabBarBeforeChange`: `(active: number \| string) => unknown`; may return a Promise; arrays of functions are supported | `-` |
| `fixed` | Whether to fixed bottom | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `border` | Whether to show border | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `safe-area` | Whether to adapt to the bottom, left and right safe areas | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `z-index` | Z-index; an explicit prop overrides the CSS variable | _number \| string_ | `undefined`; CSS defaults to `1` |
| `active-color` | Color of active tab item | _string_ | `-` |
| `inactive-color` | Color of inactive tab item | _string_ | `-` |
| `placeholder`  ***3.2.11*** | Whether to generate placeholder elements of the same height at the bottom (`fixed` required) | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `fab-props` | Fab button props | _ButtonProps_ | `{ status: 'primary' }` |
| `variant` | Appearance | _TabBarVariant_：`standard` / `pill` | `standard` |

When model-value is omitted the component manages selection; when provided it only requests updates. Releasing control retains the last controlled value. Numeric names take precedence over unnamed item indices; named items do not match by index.

### TabBarItem Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ---- | ---- | ---- | ---- |
| `name` | Identifier | _number \| string_ | `-` |
| `icon` | Icon name, matching Icon [name](#/en-US/icon) | _string_ | `-` |
| `label` | Label text content | _string_ | - |
| `badge` | Logo in the upper right corner of the icon | _boolean \| BadgeProps_ | `false` |

### TabBarItem Events

| Event | Description | Callback arguments |
| ---- | ---- | ---- |
| `click` | Triggered when the cell is clicked | `active: number \| string` |

### TabBar Events

| Event | Description | Callback arguments |
| ---- | ---- | ---- |
| `update:modelValue` | Request a selected-value update | `active: number \| string` |
| `change` | Triggered when switching labels | `active: number \| string` |
| `guard-error` | Emitted when the guard throws or its Promise rejects | `error: unknown, value: number \| string` |
| `fab-click` | Triggered when clicking fab button | `-` |

### TabBarItem Slots

| Name | Description | Prop |
| ---- | ---- | ---- |
| `default` | Custom `label` content; overrides `label` | `active: boolean` |
| `icon` | Custom icon | `active: boolean` |

### TabBar Slots

| Name | Description | Prop |
| ---- | ----------------------- | ---- |
| `default` | Bottom-navigation content | `-` |
| `fab` | Support for inserting a custom Fab button into a component | `-` |

## CSS Variables

The following CSS variables support customization with [ThemeProvider](#/en-US/theme-provider).

When `z-index` is omitted, the component consumes `--mp-tab-bar-z-index`. An explicit number or CSS string takes precedence. The default visual stacking level is `1`.

<!-- component-css-variables:start -->

Use these variables to customize the component. Defaults may vary by the selector condition shown. Each variable applies to the corresponding size, variant and interaction states.

<div class="token-reference-table" style="max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;">

| Variable | Default / condition | Affected styles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--mp-tab-bar-background-color` | `var(--mp-color-bg-2)` | `background-color` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-border-color` | `var(--mp-color-border-2)` | `border-top` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-fab-border-radius` | `50%` | `border-radius` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-fab-offset` | `4px` | `inset-inline-end`, `margin-inline-end` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-height` | `50px` | `height`, `inset-inline-end`, `margin-inline-end`, `margin-inline-start`, `width` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-item-active-background-color` | `transparent` | `background-color` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-item-active-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-action-primary)` | `color` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-item-focus-color` | `currentColor` | `outline` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-item-focus-offset` | `-2px` | `outline-offset` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-item-focus-width` | `2px` | `outline` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-item-font-size` | `var(--mp-font-size-sm)` | `font-size` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-item-icon-margin-bottom` | `5px` | `margin-top` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-item-icon-size` | `22px` | `font-size` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-item-inactive-color` | `var(--mp-color-text-2)` | `color` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-item-line-height` | `1` | `line-height` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-item-variant-active-background-color` | `color-mix(in srgb, var(--mp-sys-color-action-primary) 14%, var(--mp-tab-bar-background-color))` | `background-color` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-item-variant-active-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-action-primary)` | `color` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-item-variant-icon-container-border-radius` | `100px` | `border-radius` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-item-variant-icon-container-height` | `30px` | `height` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-item-variant-icon-container-max-width` | `58px` | `max-width` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-variant-height` | `66px` | `height` |
| `--mp-tab-bar-z-index` | `1` | Component styling |

</div>

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --mp-tab-bar-background-color: var(--mp-color-bg-2);
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

# Table

## Basic tables

### Basic table

Example source: src/table/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const columns = [
  { title: 'Name', dataIndex: 'name' },

  { title: 'Address', dataIndex: 'address' },
]
const data = [
  { key: '1', name: 'Jane Doe', salary: 23000, address: '32 Park Road, London' },
  { key: '2', name: 'Alisa Ross', salary: 25000, address: '35 Park Road, London' },
  { key: '3', name: 'Kevin Sandra', salary: 22000, address: '31 Park Road, London' },
]
</script>
```

### Order status and totals

## API

Native scrolling is the default. Set virtual-list-props to render a window of rows. Use application controls for filter values on mobile.

### Table Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------: |
| columns | Column info of the table | `TableColumnData[]` | `[]` |
| data | Table data | `TableData[]` | `[]` |
| bordered | Whether to show border | `boolean \| TableBorder` | `true` |
| hoverable | Whether to show the hover effect | `boolean` | `true` |
| stripe | Whether to enable the stripe effect | `boolean` | `false` |
| size | The size of the table | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `'md'` |
| table-layout | Table layout algorithm, matching CSS `table-layout`. Defaults to `fixed`; calculated column widths are not expanded by content | `'fixed' \| 'auto'` | `'fixed'` |
| loading | Loading state | `boolean\|object` | `false` |
| row-selection | Table row selector configuration | `TableRowSelection` | `-` |
| expandable | Expand row configuration of the table | `TableExpandable` | `-` |
| height | Table height; fixes the header and scrolls the body. Numbers are px | `number \| string` | `-` |
| max-height | Maximum table height; shrinks for short content and scrolls the body on overflow. Numbers are px | `number \| string` | `-` |
| fit | Remaining-space allocation; the table always fills at least its parent `width`. `true` assigns it to flexible columns without `width`; `false` expands columns proportionally to their base widths | `boolean` | `true` |
| pagination | Pagination properties configuration | `boolean \| TablePaginationConfig` | `true` |
| indent-size | The indentation distance of the tree table | `number` | `16` |
| row-key | Value field of table row `key` | `string` | `'key'` |
| show-header | Whether to show the header | `boolean` | `true` |
| virtual-list-props | Virtual-list props; providing them enables virtual scrolling. See VirtualListProps | `VirtualListProps` | `-` |
| span-method | Cell merge method (The index starts counting from the data item) | `(data: {  record: TableData;  column: TableColumnData \| TableOperationColumn;  rowIndex: number;  columnIndex: number;}) => { rowspan?: number; colspan?: number } \| void` | `-` |
| span-all | Whether to make the index of the span method contain all | `boolean` | `false` |
| components | Configure operation columns; see TableComponents | `TableComponents` | `-` |
| row-number | Reserved prop; currently does not generate row numbers | `boolean \| object` | `-` |
| load-more | Load children asynchronously; call done(children), or done() to allow retry | `(record: TableData, done: (children?: TableData[]) => void) => void` | `-` |
| hide-expand-button-on-empty | Whether to hide expand button when subtree is empty | `boolean` | `false` |
| row-class | Class for table-row elements | `string\| any[]\| Record<string, any>\| ((record: TableData, rowIndex: number) => any)` | `-` |
| draggable | Table drag and drop sorting configuration | `TableDraggable` | `-` |
| column-resizable | Whether columns can be resized; drag handles render only under `table-layout: fixed` | `boolean` | `false` |
| summary | Show footer summary row | `boolean\| ((params: {    columns: TableColumnData[];    data: TableData[];  }) => TableData[])` | `-` |
| summary-text | The first column of text in the summary line | `string` | `'Summary'` |
| summary-span-method | Cell Merge Method for Summarizing Rows | `(data: {  record: TableData;  column: TableColumnData \| TableOperationColumn;  rowIndex: number;  columnIndex: number;}) => { rowspan?: number; colspan?: number } \| void` | `-` |
| selected-keys | Selected row (controlled mode) takes precedence over `rowSelection` | `(string \| number)[]` | `-` |
| default-selected-keys | The selected row by default (uncontrolled mode) takes precedence over `rowSelection` | `(string \| number)[]` | `-` |
| expanded-keys | Displayed Expanded Row, Subtree (Controlled Mode) takes precedence over `expandable` | `(string \| number)[]` | `-` |
| default-expanded-keys | Expand row, Subtree displayed by default (Uncontrolled mode) takes precedence over `expandable` | `(string \| number)[]` | `-` |
| default-expand-all-rows | Whether to expand all rows by default | `boolean` | `false` |
| sticky-header | Sticky header relative to the page/outer scroller; numeric values are top offsets in px | `boolean \| number` | `false` |
| sticky-pagination | Sticky pagination relative to the page/outer scroller; numeric values are bottom offsets in px | `boolean \| number` | `false` |
| scrollbar | Whether to enable virtual scroll bar | `boolean \| ScrollbarProps` | `false` |
| show-empty-tree | Whether to display empty subtrees | `boolean` | `false` |
| extra-column | Append an extra final column, e.g. settings; slots supply its content | `boolean \| TableExtraColumnConfig` | `false` |

### Table Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| expand | Emitted when an expandable row is clicked | rowKey: `string \| number`<br>record: `TableData` |
| expanded-change | Emitted when expanded rows change | rowKeys: `(string \| number)[]` |
| select | Emitted when a row selector is clicked | rowKeys: `(string \| number)[]`<br>rowKey: `string \| number`<br>record: `TableData` |
| select-all | Emitted when the select-all control is clicked | checked: `boolean` |
| selection-change | Emitted when selected rows change | rowKeys: `(string \| number)[]` |
| sorter-change | Emitted when sorting changes | dataIndex: `string`<br>direction: `string` |
| filter-change | Emitted when filtering changes | dataIndex: `string`<br>filteredValues: `string[]` |
| page-change | Emitted when table page changes | page: `number` |
| page-size-change | Emitted when table page size changes | pageSize: `number` |
| change | Emitted when table data changes | data: `TableData[]`<br>extra: `TableChangeExtra`<br>currentData: `TableData[]` |
| update:columns | Emitted when column configuration changes; supports v-model:columns | columns: `TableColumnData[]` |
| cell-mouse-enter | Emitted on cell hover enter | record: `TableData`<br>column: `TableColumnData`<br>ev: `Event` |
| cell-mouse-leave | Emitted on cell hover leave | record: `TableData`<br>column: `TableColumnData`<br>ev: `Event` |
| cell-click | Emitted when a cell is clicked | record: `TableData`<br>column: `TableColumnData`<br>ev: `Event` |
| row-click | Emitted when a row is clicked | record: `TableData`<br>ev: `Event` |
| header-click | Emitted when a header is clicked | column: `TableColumnData`<br>ev: `Event` |
| column-resize | Emitted when a column is resized | dataIndex: `string`<br>width: `number` |
| row-dblclick | Emitted when a row is double-clicked | record: `TableData`<br>ev: `Event` |
| cell-dblclick | Emitted when a cell is double-clicked | record: `TableData`<br>column: `TableColumnData`<br>ev: `Event` |
| row-contextmenu | Emitted when a row is right-clicked | record: `TableData`<br>ev: `Event` |
| cell-contextmenu | Emitted when a cell is right-clicked | record: `TableData`column: `TableColumnData`<br>ev: `Event` |
| row-touchstart | Emitted for the touched row with the original native event. | record: `TableData`, event: `TouchEvent` |
| row-touchend | Emitted for the touched row with the original native event. | record: `TableData`, event: `TouchEvent` |
| row-touchcancel | Emitted for the touched row with the original native event. | record: `TableData`, event: `TouchEvent` |

### Table Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| ------------ | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------ |
| selectAll | Set select-all state | checked: `boolean` | - |
| select | Set row-selection state | rowKey: `string \| number \| (string \| number)[]`<br>checked: `boolean` | - |
| expandAll | Set all rows’ expansion state | checked: `boolean` | - |
| expand | Set expansion state | rowKey: `string \| number \| (string \| number)[]`<br>checked: `boolean` | - |
| resetFilters | Reset column filters | dataIndex: `string \| string[]` | - |
| clearFilters | Clear column filters | dataIndex: `string \| string[]` | - |
| resetSorters | Reset column sorting | - | - |
| clearSorters | Clear column sorting | - | - |

When columns are specified, `clearFilters` and `resetFilters` preserve other columns' filter state. Omitting the argument or passing an empty array applies to all filterable columns. The parent continues to own controlled filter values.

In radio mode, `select(keys, true)` selects only the first supplied key; an empty array does nothing. `select(keys, false)` removes the specified keys. `selectAll(true)` does nothing; `selectAll(false)` removes the keys of enabled rows on the current page. For controlled selection, the parent must receive and update `selectedKeys`.

The state argument of `select`, `selectAll`, `expand`, and `expandAll` defaults to `true`. `expand` accepts one or more keys and does not add duplicates when called repeatedly; `expandAll` applies to all data rows. `resetSorters` restores column defaults and `clearSorters` clears sorting; the parent continues to own controlled sorting.

### Table Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| ---------------- | :-----------------------------------: | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| th | Custom th element | column: `TableColumnData` |
| thead | Custom thead element | - |
| empty | Empty content | - |
| summary-cell | Summary row | column: `TableColumnData`<br>record: `TableData`<br>rowIndex: `number` |
| pagination-right | Content to the right of pagination | - |
| pagination-left | Content to the left of pagination | - |
| td | Custom td element | column: `TableColumnData`<br>record: `TableData`<br>rowIndex: `number` |
| tr | Custom tr element | record: `TableData`<br>rowIndex: `number` |
| tbody | Custom tbody element | - |
| drag-handle-icon | Drag-anchor icon | - |
| footer | Table footer | - |
| expand-row | Expanded-row content | record: `TableData` |
| expand-icon | Expanded-row icon | expanded: `boolean`<br>record: `TableData` |
| columns | Declarative columns; when used, override columns | - |
| extra-column-header | Extra final-column header content | - |
| extra-column-cell | Extra final-column cell content | record / rowIndex, etc. |
| header-cell-actions | Header-side actions for leaf columns; entirely controlled by the caller | column / dataIndex |

### TableColumn Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | :-----: |
| data-index | Column identifier matching a TableData field | `string` | `-` |
| title | Column title | `string` | `-` |
| width | Column width | `number` | `-` |
| min-width | Minimum column width | `number` | `80` |
| align | Alignment | `TableColumnData['align']` | `-` |
| fixed | Fixed position | `TableColumnData['fixed']` | `-` |
| ellipsis | Whether to truncate with an ellipsis | `boolean` | `false` |
| sortable | Sorting options | `TableSortable` | `-` |
| filterable | Filtering options | `TableFilterable` | `-` |
| cell-class | Custom cell class | `ClassName` | `-` |
| header-cell-class | Custom header-cell class | `ClassName` | `-` |
| body-cell-class | Custom body-cell class | `ClassName \| ((record: TableData) => ClassName)` | `-` |
| summary-cell-class | Custom summary-cell class | `ClassName \| ((record: TableData) => ClassName)` | `-` |
| cell-style | Custom cell style | `CSSProperties` | `-` |
| header-cell-style | Custom header-cell style | `CSSProperties` | `-` |
| body-cell-style | Custom body-cell style | `CSSProperties \| ((record: TableData) => CSSProperties)` | `-` |
| summary-cell-style | Custom summary-cell style | `CSSProperties \| ((record: TableData) => CSSProperties)` | `-` |
| index | Manually specify the option index | `number` | `-` |
| tooltip | Whether to show a text tooltip when truncated | `boolean\|object` | `false` |

### TableColumn Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| -------------- | :------------------: | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| filter-icon | Filter-button icon | - |
| filter-content | Custom filter-popup content | filterValue: `string[]`<br>setFilterValue: `(filterValue: string[]) => void`<br>handleFilterConfirm: `(event: Event) => void`<br>handleFilterReset: `(event: Event) => void` |
| default | Declare child columns for a grouped header | - |
| title | Title | - |
| cell | Cell | record: `TableData`<br>column: `TableColumnData`<br>rowIndex: `number` |

### Table structure components

`Thead` and `Tbody` render the header and body, respectively, with content from the default slot; their named slots customize the corresponding elements. `Tr`, `Th`, and `Td` are low-level renderers that depend on Table context, not standalone data tables. Usually, customize elements through the Table `tr`, `th`, and `td` slots.

During client rendering, list items in content and structural slots can combine `v-for`, `:key`, and `v-memo`.

**Server rendering** with the Vue 3.5.45 template compiler can generate a slot function in the application’s server bundle that references an undeclared `_cache`, leaving content out of the initial HTML. The published Table entry reproduces this for titles, cells, filter icons and panels, empty states, footers, expanded rows and icons, pagination, summary cells, drag handles, extra columns, and header actions. Custom `thead`, `tbody`, `tr`, `th`, and `td` slots are also affected, even when the list is empty. For SSR, keep `v-for` and a stable `:key` on the list item and remove `v-memo` from that node.

`TableColumn` entries declared in `#columns`, including grouped and dynamic columns, render their headers and data cells on the server. Columns can also be defined with the `columns` prop.

For `Tr`, `expand`, `empty`, and `checked` describe row state; `rowIndex` and `record` provide row context. `Th` accepts `column`, `operations`, `dataColumns`, and `resizable`. `Td` accepts `rowIndex`, `record`, `column`, `type`, `operations`, `dataColumns`, `colSpan`, `rowSpan`, `isFixedExpand`, `containerWidth`, `showExpandBtn`, `indentSize`, `renderExpandBtn`, and `summary`; these fields support Table layout and rendering.

### TableComponents

`components.operations` receives the current `dragHandle`, `expand`, and `selection` operation columns (undefined when disabled) and returns the operation columns to render. It configures operation columns rather than replacing arbitrary table elements.

### TableOperationColumn Props

| Field | Description | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| name | Operation column identifier | `string` |
| title | Column title | `string \| RenderFunction` |
| width | Column width | `number` |
| fixed | Whether fixed | `boolean` |
| render | Custom operation cell content | `(record: TableData) => VNodeChild` |

`isLastLeftFixed` and `_realWidth` are used for table layout and normally need not be set by application code. Import `TableComponents` and `TableOperationColumn` from the root or table entry.

### Pagination configuration type

`pagination.align` accepts `start` or `end`. The default is the inline end (right in LTR, left in RTL). Use `:pagination="{ align: 'start' }"` to align the bar to the inline start. The pagination bar appears below the table.

`TablePaginationConfig = Omit<PaginationProps, 'total'> & { total?: number; container?: string | HTMLElement; align?: 'start' | 'end' }`. When `pagination.total` is omitted, Table derives it from the effective data count. Remote pagination can still provide `total` explicitly. Existing `PaginationProps` objects remain accepted by Table; standalone `Pagination` still requires `total`. `TablePaginationConfig` is exported from root/table entries.

### Forwarded configuration precedence

Nested fields such as open in column filterable.triggerProps can override the filter popup state. Manage both popup visibility and filter conditions when controlling it from the application.

### TableSortable

A custom `sorter(a, b, { direction })` must return ascending or descending results according to `direction`; Table does not reverse the result again. `sorter: true` disables internal sorting. Without a function, the built-in comparison preserves the original order of equal values.

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :----: |
| sortDirections | Supported sort directions | `('ascend' \| 'descend')[]` | `-` |
| sorter | Sort comparator; `true` disables internal sorting | `((        a: TableData,        b: TableData,        extra: { dataIndex: string; direction: 'ascend' \| 'descend' }      ) => number)    \| boolean` | `-` |
| sortOrder | Sort direction | `'ascend' \| 'descend' \| ''` | `-` |
| defaultSortOrder | Default sort direction in uncontrolled mode | `'ascend' \| 'descend' \| ''` | `-` |

### TableFilterable

Filter content uses the column `filter-content` slot first, then the Table named slot identified by `slotName` when present, then `renderContent`, and finally the built-in `filters` options. If the named slot does not exist, the next source is used.

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :-----: |
| filters | Filter data | `TableFilterData[]` | `-` |
| filter | Filter callback, similar to Array.prototype.filter | `(filteredValue: string[], <br/>record:TableData)=> boolean` | `-` |
| multiple | Whether to support multiple selection | `boolean` | `false` |
| filteredValue | Selected filters | `string[]` | `-` |
| defaultFilteredValue | Default selected filters | `string[]` | `-` |
| renderContent | Filter-popup content | `(data: {    filterValue: string[];    setFilterValue: (filterValue: string[]) => void;    handleFilterConfirm: (event: Event) => void;    handleFilterReset: (event: Event) => void;  }) => VNodeChild` | `-` |
| icon | Filter-button icon | `RenderFunction` | `-` |
| triggerProps | Filter-popup configuration | `TriggerProps` | `-` |

| slotName | Named Table slot for custom filter content | `string` | `-` |

<!-- Source: src/tabs/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/tabs -->

# Tabs

Cedar and Maple expose the same simple Tabs / TabPane API and the same advanced TabsNavs / TabNav / TabsItems / TabItem composition. Bind `v-model` on Tabs and use explicit unique string or number `name` values on TabPane, TabNav and TabItem. Vue `key` is separate and is still used for list rendering. Both packages support six variants, controlled/uncontrolled state, lazy mounting, destroy-on-hide, keyboard navigation, RTL and opt-in swipes.

Put navigation and panels inside the same `Tabs`. Use `tab-click(name, event)` for tab click handling, external positioning for custom layouts, and `TabBar` for application-level navigation. The complete props, events, slots, methods and theme variables are documented below.

## Basic examples

### Simplest usage

For the simplest usage, place `TabPane` components with `title` directly inside `Tabs`; navigation and content are generated automatically.

Example source: src/tabs/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <mp-tabs default-value="overview" tab-list-aria-label="页面内容">
    <mp-tab-pane name="overview" title="概览">概览内容</mp-tab-pane>
    <mp-tab-pane name="details" title="详情">详情内容</mp-tab-pane>
    <mp-tab-pane name="settings" title="设置">设置内容</mp-tab-pane>
  </mp-tabs>
</template>
```

## Appearance and states

### Appearance combinations

Use this example for switching between peer content panels. Adjust variant, size and compare the component with the same data. Keep the content unchanged while comparing the available settings.

Example source: src/tabs/example/demos/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive as __demoReactive, computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef } from 'vue'

const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: 'line', size: 'md' })
const demoCompareFields = [
  { name: 'variant', values: ['line', 'card', 'outline', 'plain', 'capsule', 'enclosed'] },
  { name: 'size', values: ['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'] },
]
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef('variant')
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(
  () => demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)?.values ?? [],
)
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <mp-form layout="vertical">
```

### Orientation and indicator position

```vue
const componentOrders = ['nav-first', 'items-first'] as const

const indicatorPosition = ref<(typeof positions)[number]>('normal')
const componentOrder = ref<(typeof componentOrders)[number]>('nav-first')
</script>

<template>
```

Navigation props and state combinations:

Example source: src/tabs/example/demos/navs-review.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const editable = ref(true)
const addable = ref(true)
const autoSwitch = ref(true)
const active = ref('one')
const items = ref([
  { key: 'one', title: '标签 1' },
  { key: 'two', title: '标签 2' },
])
let next = 3
function add() {
  const key = String(next++)
  items.value.push({ key, title: '标签 ' + key })
}
function remove(key: string | number) {
  const index = items.value.findIndex((item) => item.key === key)
  items.value = items.value.filter((item) => item.key !== key)
  if (active.value === key) {
    active.value = items.value[Math.min(index, items.value.length - 1)]?.key ?? ''
  }
}
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space wrap>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="editable">允许关闭</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="addable">显示新增</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="autoSwitch">新增自动切换</mp-checkbox>
  </mp-space>
  <mp-tabs
    v-model="active"
    :editable="editable"
    :show-add-button="addable"
    :auto-switch="autoSwitch"
    @add="add"
    @delete="remove"
  >
    <mp-tabs-navs aria-label="交付审查标签">
      <template #prefix><mp-tag>动态标签</mp-tag></template>
      <mp-tab-nav v-for="item in items" :key="item.key" :name="item.key" :title="item.title" />
      <template #suffix
        ><mp-tag>共 {{ items.length }} 项</mp-tag></template
      >
      <template #add-icon><mp-tag>＋</mp-tag></template>
    </mp-tabs-navs>
    <mp-tabs-items
      ><mp-tab-item v-for="item in items" :key="item.key" :name="item.key"
        >{{ item.title }} 内容</mp-tab-item
      ></mp-tabs-items
    >
  </mp-tabs>
  <p role="status">当前标签：{{ active }}；数量：{{ items.length }}</p>
</template>
```

## API

TabPane, TabNav and TabItem all require unique names. Selection and navigation/panel association use `name`; Vue key controls only node reuse. Provide `:key` separately in loops.

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the selected tab name. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once without later resets or initialization `update:modelValue`. When provided, the parent value controls selection.

### Tabs Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value | `string / number` | `undefined` | Current selected name; controlled when provided |
| default-value | `string / number` | `undefined` | Initial uncontrolled value; defaults to the first available item |
| variant | `line / card / outline / plain / capsule / enclosed` | `line` | Visual variant |
| size | `xs / sm / md / lg / xl` | Global value or md | Size |
| tab-list-aria-label | `string` | `undefined` | Accessible name for the tab list; explicit aria-label or aria-labelledby on TabsNavs takes precedence |
| orientation | `Orientation`<br>`'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `horizontal` | Navigation orientation |
| indicator-position | `TabsIndicatorPosition`<br>`'normal' \| 'reverse'` | `normal` | Indicator on the content side or opposite side |
| editable | `boolean` | `false` | Allow closing tabs |
| show-add-button | `boolean` | `false` | Show the add button in editable mode |
| auto-switch | `boolean` | `false` | Switch to the last available tab after adding |
| lazy-load | `boolean` | `false` | Mount on first activation |
| destroy-on-hide | `boolean` | `false` | Unmount content when hidden |
| justify | `boolean` | `false` | Fill container height in horizontal orientation |
| animation | `boolean` | `false` | Content fade-in animation |
| item-class | `string / object / array` | `undefined` | Inner class for each panel; merged with built-in classes |
| item-style | `StyleValue` | `undefined` | Inner style for each panel; supports string, object or array |
| item-wrapper-class | `string / object / array` | `undefined` | Outer class for each panel; merged with built-in classes |
| item-wrapper-style | `StyleValue` | `undefined` | Outer style for each panel; supports string, object or array |
| tab-class | `string / object / array` | `undefined` | Outer navigation-label class, including title/close button; merged with built-in classes |
| tab-style | `StyleValue` | `undefined` | Outer navigation-label style; supports string, object or array |
| hide-content | `boolean` | `false` | Hide the content area |
| trigger | `click / hover` | `click` | Mouse trigger mode; touch always uses click |
| scroll-position | `TabsScrollPosition`<br>`'start' \| 'end' \| 'center' \| 'auto' \| number` | `auto` | Selected-tab scroll position; numbers are start offsets |
| scroll-buttons | `boolean / auto` | `auto` | Show arrows on overflow; auto hides them on touch devices |
| activation-mode | `automatic / manual` | `automatic` | Whether arrow keys immediately select |
| swipeable | `boolean` | `false` | Horizontal swipe between content panels; no looping |

### Tabs Events

| Event | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | name: string / number | Request a selected-value update |
| change | name: string / number | Notify on selecting a different available item; controlled mode still requires parent modelValue updates |
| tab-click | name, event: Event | Click an available item, including repeat clicks; hover/arrows/swipes do not emit click |
| add | event: Event | Request adding a tab; the caller updates data |
| delete | name, event: Event | Request removing a tab; the caller updates data |

### TabPane Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name **(required)** | string / number | — | Unique business identifier matching modelValue |
| title | string | undefined | Navigation title |
| disabled | boolean | false | Prevent selecting and closing |
| closable | boolean | true | Show the close button in editable mode |
| item-vertical | boolean | false | Vertical icon/text layout |
| lazy-load | boolean | undefined | Inherit Tabs; explicit false overrides it |
| destroy-on-hide | boolean | undefined | Inherit Tabs; explicit false overrides it |

### TabNav Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name **(required)** | string / number | — | Unique business identifier matching modelValue |
| title | string | undefined | Title |
| disabled | boolean | false | Prevent selecting and closing |
| closable | boolean | true | Show the close button in editable mode |
| item-vertical | boolean | false | Vertical icon/text layout |

TabNav/TabItem associate through the same `name`. Names are unique within a group; number `1` and string `'1'` differ. Vue `key` controls node reuse only; provide `:key` in loops independently. It does not determine selection.

### TabItem Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name **(required)** | string / number | — | Unique business identifier matching modelValue |
| lazy-load | boolean | undefined | Inherit Tabs; explicit false overrides it |
| destroy-on-hide | boolean | undefined | Inherit Tabs; explicit false overrides it |

Inactive panels always have hidden. The above props determine whether internal state survives. destroy-on-hide overrides lazy-load; active content remains mounted. TabsNavs/TabsItems have no business props.

### TabItem Slots

| Component | Slot | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tabs | default | TabPane list, or TabsNavs/TabsItems for advanced composition |
| TabPane | default / title | Panel content / custom navigation title |
| TabsNavs | default | TabNav list |
| TabsNavs | prefix / suffix / add-icon | Navigation prefix/suffix areas and add icon |
| TabNav | title / default / icon | title/default slots customize the title; icon supplies an icon |
| TabsItems | default | TabItem list |
| TabItem | default | Panel content |

### TabItem Methods

`TabsNavs.resize(): void` remeasures overflow and scrolls the selected tab into view. ResizeObserver watches size changes automatically.

### Keyboard and direction

Arrow keys skip disabled items and wrap; Home/End reach first/last. Delete requests closing editable tabs. Horizontal uses Left/Right, vertical uses Up/Down. Manual mode moves focus only; Enter/Space activates the native button. `dir="rtl"` supports right-to-left layout. Give TabsNavs an `aria-label` to name navigation.

After a close request, if the focused tab is removed, focus moves to an adjacent enabled tab unless the user has already moved focus elsewhere. When changing panels, focus moves to the new tab only if it was inside the panel being hidden. Horizontal start, end and numeric scroll offsets follow reading direction; the start is on the right in RTL.

In TabPane mode, use tab-list-aria-label to name the tab list. In advanced mode, TabsNavs accepts aria-label or aria-labelledby directly. When using navigation without TabItem, the application is responsible for associating and making external panels accessible.

## Types

Exports TabsName, TabsVariant, TabsTrigger, TabsIndicatorPosition, TabsScrollPosition, TabsActivationMode and Props/Instance/runtime props/`_XxxComponent` for all six components. Both platforms use the same prop definitions.

## Usage notes

Supports xs / sm / md / lg / xl sizes. Cedar inherits ConfigProvider size / rtl. Maple defaults to md and supports setPropsDefaults, explicit size and DOM dir. Inactive panels are hidden, and InfiniteScroll follows panel visibility.

Public types include TabsEmits, TabsSlots, TabPaneSlots, TabsNavsSlots, TabNavSlots, TabsItemsSlots, TabItemSlots and TabsNavsExpose. Only TabsNavs has its own method, resize(). Other members have no own imperative methods/notification events; selection/editing events belong to Tabs.
### Configuration

Matching token suffixes have matching meanings on both platforms, with platform-specific defaults. The variables and their defaults are listed below.

# Tag

### Intro

Tag is used for marking, categorizing, and filtering. The API aligns with Cedar Design Web (PC) Tag, with mobile-friendly extras such as round shape and custom text color.

## Basic examples

### Theme Color

Set the theme color with `status`. Options match Button: `default` `primary` `secondary` `tertiary` `info` `success` `warning` `danger`.

### Appearance configuration comparison

Choose a dimension to compare all its values side by side while keeping other settings and content identical. Change the other settings to inspect combinations; input specimens share one model.

<details>
<summary>Configuration details and limits</summary>

#### Size

Set size with `size`: `xs` `sm` `md` `lg` `xl`.

#### Outline

Use `variant="outline"` for the outline style.

#### Appearance combinations

Use this example for short labels and category markers. Adjust variant, status, size and compare the component with the same data. Keep the content unchanged while comparing the available settings.

</details>

Example source: src/tag/example/demos/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive as __demoReactive, computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef } from 'vue'

const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: 'default', status: 'default', size: 'md' })

  { name: 'variant', values: ['default', 'outline'] },
  { name: 'status', values: ['default', 'primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'info', 'success', 'warning', 'danger'] },

  () => demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)?.values ?? [],
)
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="16">

            { label: 'default', value: 'default' },
            { label: 'outline', value: 'outline' },

          size="sm"

      </mp-form-item>

            { label: 'secondary', value: 'secondary' },

          aria-label="status"
        />
      </mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="size">
        <mp-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['size']"

          :options="[
            { label: 'xs', value: 'xs' },
            { label: 'sm', value: 'sm' },
```

## Interaction and control

### Closable

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | Theme color: `default` `primary` `secondary` `tertiary` `info` `success` `warning` `danger` | Closable, Loading |
| `show` | Visibility (v-model) | Closable |
| `closable` | Whether closable | Closable |
| `round` | Whether to use a pill shape | Closable |
| `loading` | Loading state | Loading |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Close buttons support Space / Enter without selecting the tag. Selectable tags also support Space / Enter. Controlled checked is accepted by the parent; otherwise the component stores its state. Loading blocks selection.

Show a close button with `closable`. Use `v-model:show` or manage a list yourself.

Example source: src/tag/example/demos/closable-tag.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const show = ref(true)
const dynamicTags = ref(['Tag 1', 'Tag 2', 'Tag 3'])
function removeTag(tag) {
  dynamicTags.value = dynamicTags.value.filter((item) => item !== tag)
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space wrap :size="['2.666vmin', '2.666vmin']">
    <mp-tag v-model:show="show" closable close-button-aria-label="移除标签" status="primary">标签</mp-tag>
    <mp-tag v-for="tag in dynamicTags" :key="tag" closable round status="info" @close="removeTag(tag)">
      {{ tag }}
    </mp-tag>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Loading

Show a loading state with `loading`.

Example source: src/tag/example/demos/loading-tag.vue

```vue
<script setup></script>

<template>
  <mp-space wrap :size="['2.666vmin', '2.666vmin']">
    <mp-tag loading status="primary">加载中标签</mp-tag>
    <mp-tag loading status="success">加载中标签</mp-tag>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## API


Loading preserves the checked state and exposes disabled and busy semantics on checkable tags. If loading starts while the close control has focus, focus moves to the tag. Independent interactive controls in the content do not toggle the tag.

The close button name defaults to the current locale’s close text and can be overridden with `close-button-aria-label`. The tag root remains single-line; `nowrap` mainly enables the inner truncation wrapper and does not control multiline wrapping.

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is a selectable tag's boolean checked state. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once; later changes do not reset it. Explicit binding takes precedence, without initialization `update:modelValue`.

### Tag Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | Theme color: `default` `primary` `secondary` `tertiary` `info` `success` `warning` `danger` | _string_ | `default` |
| `variant` | Variant: `default` (filled) / `outline` | _string_ | `default` |
| `size` | Size: `xs` `sm` `md` `lg` `xl` | _string_ | `md` |
| `round` | Whether to use a pill shape | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `show` | Visibility (v-model) | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `default-show` | Default visibility | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `loading` | Loading state | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `closable` | Whether closable | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `close-button-aria-label` | Accessible name of the close button; defaults to the current locale | `string` | `—` |
| `checkable` | Whether checkable | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `model-value` | Checked state when checkable (v-model) | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `default-value` | Default checked state when checkable | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `nowrap` | Whether to enable the content truncation wrapper; the root remains single-line | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `color` | Custom background (border color when outline) | _string_ | `-` |
| `text-color` | Custom text color | _string_ | `-` |

### Tag Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `update:show` | Visibility changed | `(show: boolean)` |
| `update:model-value` | Checked state changed (checkable) | `(checked: boolean)` |
| `close` | Close button clicked | `(event: MouseEvent)` |
| `check` | Checked state toggled (checkable) | `(checked: boolean, event: MouseEvent)` |

### Tag Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | Tag content |
| `icon` | The prepend icon of alert |
| `close-icon` | Custom close icon |

## Types

```ts
type TagStatus = 'default' | 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'tertiary' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger'
type TagSize = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'
type TagVariant = 'default' | 'outline'
```

## Usage notes



The application updates controlled show / checked values. Hiding retains the fade-out effect; class / style apply to the actual tag. CSS variables customize mobile touch sizing.

### Color override boundaries

Preset outline stays transparent; loading does not trigger preset fill hover. Dark backgrounds consume bg/bg-hover with instance overrides. Preset icon-color is separate from text-color. Unchecked presets remain neutral, while an explicit color still applies. Preset/custom colors do not guarantee contrast on arbitrary backgrounds.

## CSS Variables

The complete public contract is the `--mp-tag-*` set in `style/token.less`. Customize it with [ThemeProvider](#/en-US/theme-provider). Cedar uses the same logical names with a different brand prefix.

Status text and outline borders use the corresponding theme semantic colors with light colored fills. Unselected tags remain neutral; selected status colors take precedence over hover. The neutral background switches between fill-2 and fill-3. color takes precedence over status. Keep text readable on custom backgrounds and set text-color when needed.

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --mp-tag-blue-border-color: transparent;
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

### Motion

Built-in motion follows `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Reduced motion does not prevent loading-state or close-event updates.

<!-- Source: src/textarea/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/textarea -->

# Textarea

Native inputs always use `autocomplete="off"`; native attribute bags cannot enable autofill.

### Introduction

A multiline plain-text editor for comments, feedback, and other longer content.

## Reading direction

The textarea inherits source `dir`, aligns text to inline start and its counter to inline end. Runtime direction changes retain the native editor, focus and selection; native caret and newline keys keep their meanings.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage and value models

Use `v-model` for a controlled value and `default-value` for an uncontrolled initial value.

`v-model.trim` follows Vue model event rules: `update:modelValue` is trimmed during input, while `input` reports the original text after length normalization. An uncontrolled editor may retain surrounding whitespace while editing and normalizes its local display on commit; committing does not repeat the same model proposal already reported. Controlled display follows the final parent value, and `change` still denotes a commit.

Default length counts UTF-16 code units (an emoji usually uses 2). Default truncation never splits a valid surrogate pair; a character that does not fit is omitted entirely. For grapheme-cluster counting and slicing, provide matching `word-length` and `word-slice` functions; custom slicing remains application-controlled.

Example source: src/textarea/example/demos/en-US/demo-1.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('')
const trimmed = ref('')
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column">
    <mp-textarea v-model="value" clearable placeholder="Enter multiple lines" aria-label="Controlled text" />
    <p role="status">Current value: {{ value || '(empty)' }}</p>
    <mp-textarea default-value="An uncontrolled initial value" aria-label="非Controlled text" />
    <mp-textarea
      v-model.trim="trimmed"
      placeholder="Enter surrounding whitespace and inspect the model"
      aria-label="Trimmed text"
    />
    <p role="status">Trimmed value: {{ JSON.stringify(trimmed) }}</p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```
